tei:div.tei:p: tswakho snang shes thal 'byin phrin las rnam bzhi bdud dpung dbyings sgrol bzhugs/rdokho sa chog ni: dkar gtor rnam lngas brgyan pa sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs te: o badz+ra ku ma ra /: zhes rdo rje khros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gzir tsan dbang chen sa yi lha mo la sa bdag klu gnyan gtod 'khor gyis bskor ba dang bcas pa spyan drangs la: rkye: sngon nas dam 3ga mnos pa yi: byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mchog ni: dbang chen sa yi lha mo khyod: sgrub pa mchog gi grogs mdzod cig rkye: 'byung lngar dbang ba'i sa bdag dang: klu gnyan gtod sde 'bangs 'khor bcas: dam tshig mchog la gus pas byon: sa glud gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'gogs pa gang yang mi mdzad par: rnal 'byer thugs bzhed ltar du stsol: sa tshon lnga yi bdag po yis sa la byin phob gzi brjid bskyed: mdzes pa'i mtsho sman rgyal mo yis bkra shis mi 'dzad chag chag gdob las bzhi lhun gyas grub pa'i phyir: dam tshig can rnams grogs mdzod cig

skye bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa e dam bā ling ta khā hi: kye: bkra shis gser gyi sa gzhi na/ rab mdzes lha yi ze'u 'bru'i khar rgyal ba bskyed pa'i dam 'dzin pa: sa yi lha mo khyod la bstod bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i phyir: bdag gi 'phrin las 'di sgrubs mdzod: zhes brjod tshe la mo des 'dzum mdangs byungs ste khyed ni shākya seng ge'i sras: bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tsho chen po ste byang chub sems kyi shing rta la: drangs ba'i thugs bzhed phan bde'i dpal: bdag gi yid bzhin sgrub par byed: zhes gsung nas phyag byas nas sa la thim par bsam mo: tshon byin rlabs na tra: rin chen sna bdun mdzes pa'i yol ko phu 'byung ba rin chen sna bdun rdul gyi 'phreng: sngon po hūṃ:las mi bskyod rdo rje che: dkar po oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad zhal: ser po traḥlas rin chen 'byung ldan dal: dmar pos las snang ba mtha' yas gsal: ljang gu hā:las don yod grub par shes: rigs lnga'i thugs sgog las spros 'od zer gyis: dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras bcas span drangs bsnyims: sa ma ya dza dza hūṃ baṃ ho: sa badz+ra prakhye sogs shabyu pa3 a mṛ ta rak+ta bā ling ta khā hi: hūṃ
na las dngos bcom ldan ya nus ldan dpa' bos so

༷ phur ba lha nag spu gri'i rgyud kyi cha lag 'dod 'byung lhun grub bzhugs hūṃ —sne ta krita phaṭa: rang mdun dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba'i 1nga: tsha bsregs ngar ldan rta bdun dbang po'i khar: 'jig byed 'jigs pa'i mthu mnga' bdud rtsi 'khyil khro chas rab rdzogs rdo rje sdig mdzub mdzad zhabs bsgrad gyad kyis dam sri pho mo gnon: khro gtum gar dgus nyams rdzogs sdang mig 'bar thugs gar nyi steng hūṃ:ljang sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis 'od zer ljang nag spros: ye shes khro bo khro mo'i rdul sprin 'khrigs:'byung po skab blta glag tshol byed rnams 'thar: mchod rdzas bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i a dṛ ta: byin rlabs nus mthu grub pa bzhi ldan dmigs: nyu bhi ta krita tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa:'od zer spro bsdu 'byed bzhin tso brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig brjod (ཿ 'thar byed gzhon nu rdo rje khro bo rgyal ye shes bdud rtsir 'bebs mdzad khyod la 'dud: gang brtsam las rnams lhun gyis grub pa dang: bdud bgegs dam sri nye mi nus par mdzod: zhes bskul mthar lha nyid 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rol par dmigs: mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni trī chos dbyings nam

mkha' mdzod kyi dpal mtsho phu gang shar rang grol kun bzang rig pa'i rgyan ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i dga' ston gyis dkyil 'khor gsum ldan phur pa'i lha tshogs mchod: tshe badz+ra pū dza spra ra ṇa khaṃ: sbos byung ni hrī bzang po'i dri mchog mkha' khyab spos kyi sprin: kun nyon las dang bag chags sbyongs byed cing: rgyal ba'i dgyes bskang tshul khrims dag pa'i dris: gdul bya'i zhing bkang ma lus yongs khyab gyur: rgo badro dhu pe pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spra ra ṇa sa ma ya ྅ rol mo byin rlabasani hūṃ hrī 'aspyo ra 'das dag mnyam thugs kyi rdo rjer bsgrub: ma rig dbyings dkrog ye shes dril bu dkrol: rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid kyi rnga bcu drug ltag sprod bya byed rnam dag rdzas ye shes dbyings bskul sgra snyan mkhar rnga dang: dga' ba bcu drug dbyangs snyan gling bus bskul: stong nyid bcu drug 'od gsal mnyam par sbyor: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dgyes sprin kha grags dung pho nya dam can 'bod ba'i rkang gling zung: mtshan rtogs dbyings sprol dung chen skad po che ma sring snyan gsan phul ba'i bsad pa brda: mdor na stong gsum chos kyi

8kho 'khor lo phu dag smin rdzogs pa'i kun bzang rol mo'i sprin: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing kun yongs khyab gyur: sa badz+ra gharnye dharma shabha ri ti āḥ/: phreng babyin rlabs ni skyes sarba dharma ga ga na a: phreng ba rnams dbyangs kyi rang bzhin khro mo'i tshogs dang gsal byed kyi rang bzhin khro bo'i tshogs su mos la yab yum rnams rol ba chen po'i gar la snyoms par zhugs pas: ma dag pa'i khu rdul rlung sems dbyings la gtor zhing dag pa snang stong zung 'jug brjod pa na da'i rol mo dran rig ye shes chen por sad nas rdzong 'phrang sgog gi gdeng chen po thob par mos la ma ru ci ra ma ṇa pra warta na ye swā hā: nyer gcig brjod la byin gyis rlabs hū trī sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung rdo rje khros ba'i gar: rgod dang gshe ba drag shul ldan pa'i gsung: snying rje rngams zhi mnyam par rol pa'i thugs: lhun rdzogs srid pa rdo rje'i bkra shis shog: zhes spro na shas brjod byaḥ

rten phur ba lha nag spu gri'i rgyud kyi skyabs yul bskyed pa ni rang mdun nam mkhar pad sdong 'dab rgyas steng: 'ja' 'od gur phub ze'u 'brur zla nyi'i khar: thal 'phrin 'byin las dbang phyug thod phreng rtsal snang srid zil gnon dpa' bo mkha' 'grosabastod dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig 'dzin 'du ba rgyas: g.yas phyogs skal bzang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong: rgyab tu lung rtogs dam chos glegs bam tshul: g.yon nu nye sras byang sems rgya mtsho dang: mdun du rig stong rdo rje gzhen nu la: sras dang phyogs bcu'i khro tshogs bka' nyan bcas: byin rlabs sprin 'thibs dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs: skal ldan byin gyis rlabs byir bzhugs par dmigs: khyed shes dad pas skyabs gsol gdab par bya: rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs bstims skyabs sems tshogs bsags rgya cher spro tshogs zhing 'od zhu bya ba ni dzaḥsdosaboḥhoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rgyud sbyangs shing dag par bsam mo: 'di' bsgrub pa' cha lag tu gter ston ra rga sbyar ba ni ya ge'i mthun rkyen 'gyur rdor te bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel gyur cig sarba masgo le

rdo me skyabs sems 31gas bsags bsdus pa bzhugs:dzaX skyabs sems tshogs bsags bsdus pa ni oṃ ābs nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' ga ba yi bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : srid pa rdo rje sdodakyil 'khor la: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi lan gsumaḥ ho semasanyid ye nas sangs rgyas rang bzhin kyang: glo bur mu bzhis 'khrul snang rab rib kun:'dzin dag pa chos skur sangs bya'i phyir: phun tshogs lnga ldan byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum na so srid pa rdo rje snang shes thal 'byin la: ngo mtshar rang ngo rig pabagyi'o: gang shar rang grol kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: rlung sems bdag gnyis dri ma dbyings su bshags: rig pa ye shes phur par rjes yi rang : byang chub semasabade stong chos 'khor bskul: 'khor 'das ma phyed mi phyed gnyug mar bzhugs: dge tshogs gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: nang gsal he ru ka dpal mngo
spyo rang lus rtsa 'khor bde stong dbang ṇa sa ma ya ho: nus ldan rdo rjes sbyar

dzo dam chos thugs kyi gter kha las:brgyud 'debs thugs rje'i nyi ma bzhugs:lja|: na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye: rkad yithozwa/ e ma ho:'og min chos dbyings klong yangs pho brang nas:dpal ldan kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs:gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs:'od lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas sgyu 'phrul rigs lnga yab yum la gsol ba 'debs:phung po phyag rgyar smin par byin gyis rlobs:rang gsal bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs:rang rig rang ngo 'phrod par byin gyis rlobs a rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling dbus nas:rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng la gsol ba 'debs:don dam rtsal dbang thob par byin bsgrags kyi gro lung bde ba'i yang dben nas:gsang yum ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs:lhan skyes dga' bzhi 'bar bar gnam mtsho sngags kyi yang rdzong dben phug nas:lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas

'gro don phyogs med 'byung bar gar bzhugs ma nges phun tshogs gzhal yas su: rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje la 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin rang / rtsa khams dag pa'i gzhal yas su yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu la bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod par sems nyid stong gsal 'od kyi gzhal yas su: sras mchog gī la 5 snang shes thad gar grol bar gang snang gang shar dag mnyam pho brang nas: phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor snang gsum spros pa chod par phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pho brang nas: bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs la bstan pa phyogs med rgyas par byin gyis rlobs 'od gsal snang bzhi mthar phyin pho brang du: nang gsal kun bzang he / thob nas: 'khor 'das gzhir rdzogs 'og min chen po dza/ thams cad mnyam nyid ye shes sang thob sgo ga: gsol 'debs mthong thos rnam grol 'di skal ldan bu dang phrad par shog sa ma rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham 3nazhes pa'ang chos bdag shes rab me 'bar gyas rin chen mchog da bkra shis lha regs sgrub pa'i me tog dang bcas te bskul ba dang nye gnas dhe was shog gu'i mthun rkyen dang grogs rat+na sa

tswakho phur ba lha nag spu gri'i rgyud las byin dbab thugs rje'i nyi ma bzhugs:na rmo gu ru ya byin dbab pa'i rdzas dang yo byad spros la rnal 'byar ba'i dad mos tshad med bskyed nas rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sted pa rdo rje'i phyag rgyar bzhengs nas bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la byin chen dbab par bsam la: hū dzaḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshamasasangs : thams cad rdo rje phur ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: srid zhi ro mnyam sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: ki la ya yi dbang byin char ltar phob: rlung sems bdag gnyis /: bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma mtha' bral dbu mar grol: ma rig rtog gsum rig pa chos skur smin: 'gro drug gnas stong kun gzhi chos skur sangs: gdod 5ngon gyur mdzod: rte( badz+ra ku ma ra sa ma ya phe tho a be sha ya a ā: zhes bskul nas byin bsdu ba ni hu hu hu nam mkha' gang ba'i rgyal ba sras bcas rtsa gsum

zhi khro rdo rje phur ba'i lha tshogs rnams bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas dag smin rdzogs par bsam la: nyams dga' dwangs spro skyo ba med par byin chen pheb pa'i drod rtags khyad par can 'byung ngo 'di yang nus ldan pas 'khrul nyams yig gzugs su bkod pa'o sarba masgo li
:༷ dam chos thugs kyi gter kha las: phur pa lha nag gsang ba spu gri'i 'khor lo dam sri tshar gcod zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

dzā dza thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo rkalhunajurtanadza/ skal ldan sgrub la snyi rus can bdud dang dam sri las rgyal phyir phur pa gsang ba spu gri 'di rin chen srog gi gta' ru zungs 'di la sbyor dngos rjes dang gsum dang po bde ba'i stan la gnas bsam gtan tsher ma dang bral bar lha sngags chos skur khyer so bcas dag pa rabs 'byams nyid du bsgrub sa ma mā mdun bskyed gtor ma nyid dpal rgya rdzas mchog phur pa dang rtsa ba lus kyi da la ste dkyil 'khor gsum ldan bsgom par bya sa ma yu lta ba'i mtshams gcod bya ba ni hū trī snang srid thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i dal: rnam dag dusems kyi dkyil 'khor du: thabs shes spyod pas 'gro don bsgrub pa la: gnyis snang bdud bzhis 'tshe ba'i 'tshams chod cig: badz+ra yak+ka khros pa'i khro tshogs kyis:'das dam log snying bsreg brlag par byed: tshe badz+ra yakru kro dha ka la rū pa ha la ha la hūṃ phaṭa: srung 'khor na hūṃ hrī steng 'og phyogs mtshams ye shes khro bo'i dal phyogs

'tshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun grub gyur: dzñā na dhartu rak+ta rak+ta: brda sgo dbye phyag dam bca' ni hū hrī: ye nas dag mnyam chos sku ma rtogs pas: glo bur mu su gsal: srid pa rdo rje phur bur brda phyag 'tshal: lhag pa'i lha khyod srog gi gta' tu 'dzin: sa ma ya phaṭa: sa ma yā na mo: badz+ra tsit+ta (: byan 'beb ni hūṃ hrī:nga mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor kun: mi gnas mi dmigs ye shes thugs kyi dal: srid pa phur bu'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs la: gnas 'dir byin phobs byin skur: rdo rje phur pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: snang grags dran rig rdo rje gsum rgyas thob skyabs las li g.yel dbyar dam gcig pa'i was: bsgrub bya / gzi byin phob: tshe badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra sa ma yā ho: sa ma tswa: mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni ho: gsang ba bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rmad byung bkod mchod sprin: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor srid pa phur bu'i dal: 'gro ba'i bsod nam spel phyir 'bul bgyi'o: badz+ra pur+sha (: khro badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ: tshe badz+ra a lo

ke / ma badz+ra gharnye /: badz+ra ne wi te / tshe badz+ra shabha hūṃ: rgo āḥhūṃ ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ hrīX 'iḥ sa āX hūṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hrī 'i: slo āḥhūṃ ma hā bā lirte te dz+wa bha 'a la bha ti gu h+ya sa ma ya hūṃ trī thā: tsho( bho dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya pra na sarba pu dza sa ma yā ho: de dag sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o sa ma mā gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsgom pa dang ཿting 'dzin gsum gyis khog phub nas bar do' tha snyad kun de bag nyid du sbya bar bya sa ma yā hūṃ rdo dzikhros pas zhe sdang gcod: mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba yis: nam mkha'i dkyil nas thig pa shar: sgog gi go ru 4las: snying gi go ru bsgom par bya: nyu: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam drig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: phung po rdo rjer gtam byas nas: rnam par shes pa rdo rjer ngashā: rdo dzigazhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rje grub mdzod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur ba'i lha: ye shes khro bo grub mdzod cig: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : gīyis dngos grub stsol hūm̐ spra ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ (: chos sku tshora'agyur e:yi klo : rab g.yos ba dan bya grub ye: gsal dag ra las rgya mtsho 'khyil: sra

sdo sumaḥlas zhing g.yang brdal: ka75sa rus pa'i ri rab brjid: rab 'bar ram:las me lnga 'phro: sneḥlas thod mkhar gru bzhi brjid: kā ba ka zhu gral phyam dang: sgo bzhi khyams dang rta bab ldan: drwa phyed mdzes pa'i za ra tshag: thog dang thog phub gdugs tog 'bar: gdugs 'phan rgyal 'tshan rnga yab bsgreng: me chu'i shel gyi sang skar bkra 'dod yon lha mo sprin ltar gtibs: rgya che khyon yangs brjid ldan rdzogs: dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa ldan:sha za ro langs lce spyang 'tshubs:shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog kyang: rten dang brten pa lhun gyis grub e yeḥr saḥkoḥreḥhūṃḥspra ra ṇa phaṭa: se hā ra ṇa nyu bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni hū mthing nag gru gsum e yi klong: rin chen khri rkang pad zla nyi bdud bzhi spyi chings bsnol ba'i khar: mthing nag hūṃḥgi spro bsdu las: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhen nu ni be+eḍūr ya yi gzi byin 'byugs: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar gar dgus 'khyud: zhal gdangs ljag 'dril mche bzhi gtsigs smrar smin kha spu me ltar 'bar: mthing nag ral brdzis rdo rjes brgyan thod skam dbu

brgyan dar sna'i 'phan nyi zla'i snyan cha dpal chas klubs rdo rje rtse dgu rtse snga g.yas: 'bar ba'i me dang kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: zhabs bsnye pas bdud sde gnon: 'bar ba'i 'od zer kun nas 'phro sbyor yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: bde dang stong pa'i gzi byin 'byugs kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan dmar 'byud stobagayon bskum g.yas brkyangs srid sgo gnon g.yang gzhi gzig shams thod sbrul brgyan: in+ta'i ral pa sku rgyab 'phyangs: zhi ma khro sgegs chags bde 'bar: bdagaba'i go cha'i lha: dpral bar hūṃ dkar phur pa 'drilaḥ mgrin par dbang chen ral gri zhagasaḥ thugs ga'i cha smad rnams par rgyal srid lter gshin rje dgra stu khrag:bar bdud 'khyil rgya gram sbrul: dpung g.yas dbyug sngon be con rlung: g.yon par mi g.yo spu gri me: brla g.yas 'dod rgyal ba dan mdung: g.yon par khams gsumada': bsnol mtshams stobs chen tho ba gtun: kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag khro: dur khrod chas klubs yum dang rol: sprul pa za gsod khra thabs 'gyed: phyogs skyo

ṇ+ḍa zil gyis gnon:yan lag bzhi la 'phrin las lha: pu shud ga srin bya khra: phur srung ma mo bcu gnyis dang :skyes bu ging bzhi dbang phyug ma:til ba phyur bzhin ma 'dres shar 67 badz+ra shī li gī la ya: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho:ka rta ka ye dza ye: snyi dza ye a tsi te: a pa ra dzi te:ma ra sa na pra marta na ye hūṃ phaṭa:gnyis pa phur pa sras kyi da'akhor gsal ba ni hū gru gsum e 〈snang 'bar ba'i dbus: rū tra pho mo bsnol ba'i khar: bdag nyid thugs las ::spros pa: gnyis med sras phur thal zhags khrag: rtagasargyan dang ldan pa nyid rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i sgra: añdza li dang ra ga hos: byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las sras mchog badz+ra ki la ya: mthing nag zhal gcig thaganyis pa:sgrol byed phur pa lcags kyu 'dzin:zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan gsum bsgrad:lcags ral gzengs shing thod skam dang :dar sna'i cod paṇa rnam par brgyan:mdud gong mar hūṃ ka ra phra men za gsod yum dang bcas: log la gī la rigs bzhi dang :'chang zungs zur brgyad khro chen brgyad: rang rang dgyes bskyed za gsod bca

sgrol byed las kyi phur pa 'dril: rgya mdud 'og mar stobs chen yum: sgo skyong ma bzhi za gsod bcas: chu srin zhal la skyes ging bzhi: dbang phyug ma tshogs glogs ltara'akhyugs: dbal la ma mo bcu gnyis dang : sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i pho nya 'tshubs: sku 'gyings gsung sgogs thugs g.yos pas: khams gsum 'khor ba dbyings su sgrol:37 badz+ra ke la ya gī la ya phaṭa: āX pad+ma gī li gī la ya phaṭa: hūṃ tsit+ta gī li ki la ya phaṭa: shā: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: 'phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i gar: sku gsung thugs su mnga' gsol lo: ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur zhig: sa hūṃ swā e hā: hūṃḥle me pyo ཿte: kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gsum pa khro bo rol pa' dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni hūṃ chosasku mi 'gyur e yi klong: bhan+ta skam rlon rtid pa yi: thod mkhar sgo gru rta bab ldan: rak+ta'i skyin thabs sbyar ba las: gnam lcags 'ur mo'i gzer gyis gdab gza' klu lha chen rnam brgyad kyi: ka ba ka zhu ka gdan byas rgyu skar gral kheb mig bar tshag: khyung tshang rus sbal ya them dang : dug sbrul ma them seng mgo'i pad tsit+ta'i pho to sgyu ma yi lda ldi

tswakho mig gi drwa ba 'phyangs: zhing gi bla bre mgo bo'i tog: sur+ya tsan+t+ra'i skar khung bkra: tshad med sgo dang rta bab brgyan: ri dwags chos nyan chos 'khor gdugs 'phags lam yan lag brgyad dang ni: rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi byang chub phyogs: yang dag sum cu rtsa bdun kyang : brda' dang rtags bkod phun sum tshogs: de dbus rin chen khrirkang dang : pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i khar: : yig mthing nag zhu ba las: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mar gad mdog 'bar khro zhing gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'drilamache ba gtsigs dmar zlum spyan 'khrugs ral mthing brdzis sma smin me 'bar khro gnyer chags: rdo rje rtse dgus sa dgu mtshon rtse lnga yis ni rgyud lnga 'dren: kha ṭ+wāṃ dugagasum gdon 'dul mtshon: me yis gzung 'dzin mtshan ma bsregs ri rab phur pas khams gsum sgrol: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa gdengs: chos dbyings mkha' la thogasamed bgrod thal tshom bkod pas gdug pa 'dul khrag thig sbyar bas mkha' 'gro bskul zo ris 'khyud pas rū tra sgrol: glang gos nga rgyal 'khrul ba gzhom: g.yang gzhis

'dod chags rtsad nas gcod: stag gi lngags pas zhe sdang 'dul: mi mgo'i 'phreng bas kun rtog grol: sbrul dos gti mug 'khrul ba sangs: zhabs bgrad bdud bzhi'i kha lo bsgyur: skye ba rnam bzhi dbyings su sgrol: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum gyis 'khyud: sngo skya ut+pal dung khrag stobs: gzig shams rus rgyan g.yang gzhi klubs: zhal spyor drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs: phyogs bzhir gī la rigs bzhi yang: mthing nag lcags phur bdud la gzir: phyi rim 'khor lo rtsib bcu'i khar: mthing nag hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las: steng phyogs hūṃ:dkar sgra 'byin ma sprul pa phag dang smig bu'i mgo: zhi badz+ra kro ta hūṃ ka ra hūṃ: lharnga gardza hūṃ phaṭa: shar phyogs rnam rgyal mda' bsnyems ma: sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo: badz+ra kro ta bī dza ya hūṃ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: shar lhor dbyug sngon sder mo ni: sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo: o badz+ra kro ta ni lan+tan+t+ra 〉 da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa: lto ru gshin rje dur khrod bdag: sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: rlu badz+ra kro ta ya marnya ka lha: pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa: lho ru mi g.yo gtun khung ma: sprul pa gzig dang khā ta'i mgo: badz+ra kro ta

tswa kho ar+ya a tsa la hūṃ: bhan+ta bhan+ta hūṃ phaṭa nub tu rta mgrin rdo rje gtum: sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: o badz+ra kro ta h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa hūṃ: hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: nub byang 'dod rgyal mda' snyem ma sprul pa spyang gu khra yi mgo: ma badz+ra kro ta a pa ra tsit+ta hūṃ: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa: byang du bdud rtsi rlung 'byin ma sprul pa seng ge pha waṃ mgo: ma badz+ra kro ta a dṛ ta kurnya li hūṃ: tshirnya tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: byang shar khams gsum gsod byed ni: sprul pa dom dang sre mo mgoX yo badz+ra kro ta ) lo kya bi dza ya 〉ཿ bin+ta bin+ta hūṃ phaṭaḥ 'og phyogs stobs chen skul byed maḥ sprul pa dred da byi ba'i mgo ma badz+ra kro ta ma hā bā la hūṃ: sbo ṭa spro ṭa hūṃ phaṭa: kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag la: khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud: dur khrod dpal chas rgyan du klubs: phyag gnyis gdab pa'i phur bu 'dril: khro chung bu yug ltar du 'tshubs spyor sgrol 'dren pa'i 'phrin las byed: sgo bzhir sgo skyong mkha' 'gro bzhi pu shud ga srin bya khra shwa na bdag nyid sa bdag ma bse lcags dung gi skyes bu dang : dbang phyug ma sring 'dzadar bcas gsal: cha badz+ra gī li ki la ya:

ka rta ka ye dza ye: snyi dza ye a dzi te: a pa ra dzi te: mā ra sa na pra marta na ye hūṃ phaṭa: dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ thabs kyis spyod pa'i 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes ba: sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad phyir: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig: rgo hūṃ swā e hāḥ hūṃḥle me pyo hūṃ: hūṃḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi:ra gsum gyi lha tshogs las: gsang ba gsum du dbang skur zhing: ye shes lnga yis rgyas gdob cig kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: rtsa ba'i lha dang phur pa sras phyogs dkyil 'khor gyi: sgog las 'od zer dpag yas spros khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi: las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags bsregs: rdo rje gsum du rgyas oṃ ā 〉ཿlan bdun : rang srog dam tshig gi lcags kyus bskul te 'og min gyis gnas nas:rdo rje phur pa ye shes gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum ldan gyi rngogs rnams sprin ser rlung gis bskyod pa ltar spyan drangs nas: dam tshig bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor la sib sib bstim mo oṃ dṛ badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa

lhakhri ma ya dza dza: e a ra li hrī trī phem phem: spyan 'dren ni huX chos sku skye 'gags 'gyur ba med pa nas: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa: mi gnas mi dmigs rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: sras dang sprul pa khro tshogs dpung dang bcas ye shes sgyu mar rol pa'i rgyar bzhengs la snang srid dag mnyam rol par rgyas gdab phyir: khro rgyal 'bar ba 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bstan pa dang : ki la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: tshe badz+ra gī li gī li ya sa pā ri wa badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni hūṃḥ ye shes khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs nas/ kyang rtags dang mtshan ma dus su ston pa dang : srid pa rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol bya'i phyir dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par bzhugs: sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya ste: phyag 'tshal ba ni na mo: nyon mongs 'khrul rtog ma lus gzhom pa dang : snying rje'i 'gal zla bdud dpung tshar gcod phyir rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis phyag bgyi'o: a la la na mo ho: mchod pa ni hū hrī rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje gzhon nu la:

gling rnga: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i bye brag dang : rgyu long snying ldang pho ba mkhris pa drug glo mtsher mkhal mchin tsit+ta rnams pa lnga: ko ro tsa na ke ni ri ti sogs phyi nang 'byung khams tshogs yul rten 'brel chos: 'dod yon lha mos mdzes pa'i gar dang bcas: nam mkha' rab 'byams khyon rnams yongs bkang nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang bar bgyi: bdag gzhan bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shog: tshe badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra ma hā a: sogs shan+ta ru pa spasne me sa rak+ta tsit+ta ko ro tsa na ke ni ri ti ba su ta ma hā gha na khaṃ tsa khug lpags tsa la kha ram̐ khā hi: ma hā rā ga badz+ra ho haṃ garma mu tra sarba byu dza ho: sman mchod ni hūḥ rang byung rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos rgyu drug sems can gnas nas sgrol dug lnga rnam par dag byed pa'i: byang chub sems ni rdo rje che: sha chen mchod pa rin po che:

pad+ma me tog yang dag ldan: rdo rje'i chu ste las kyi mchog: zas mchog tshe yi dri chen po ka pur shel gyi spos phor sgrom: rin chen me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od: ma 'dus pa'i thig le che gcig tu dpa' bo'i ro rnams dang : gnyis su med par mnyam sbyar nas bdag nyid chen po mnyes par bya: rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams de la dgyes:tha pa'i sgrub rdzas rmad po che: 'phrin las dkyil 'khor skong phyir 'bul: tshe āḥ/ sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ hrī:thaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ rgyal dgongs brda' snyan shog ser tshig gi brgyud: kun 5 ngo bo bla ma pad 'byung la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mthing nag e klong bdag nyid rtsa ba'i sras dang sprul pa khro tshogs bka' nyan la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ljang nag gru gsum bsnol ba'i khar: phur pa sras kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

sa steng 'og dbus la mnga' mdzad pa'i:ye shes khro bo rol ba'i lha tshogs la:rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang ba stsol:pho brang sgo bzhi khyams la dbang bsgyur ba'i:tshad med sgo ma phur srung bcu drug la:rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul:thugs rjes brtser ra dang dngos grub stsol:sarba pañtsa amṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi:sa lce yi dam tshig rdo rje pad+mo la rdo rje spyan gyi gsang bar hūṃ bsgom nas:thabs shes mtheb srin sbyar ba'i bris pa bzhin du zla dkyil 'bru lnga las gsang gsum snying po spyi mgrin snying gar gtug:sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par 57sa phan dang nus par ldan 5:dang du ma blang rtog pas spangs len bgyis:lta spyod gzhung dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags:mu tig dkar po thig le dri ma med:tsan dan skrug po rma med gnyis med bde sbyor bde ba'i mchog tu gnas:bse phor bkra shis mtshan ldan snod du bskyil:bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyu ni byang chub sems:bdud rtsi'i ngang ni

8 6 mnyam pa nyid du gnas:bdud rtsi'i don ni skye 'chi gzhom gzhig bral:bdud rtsi'i las ni rnam rtog gnyis snang 'joms:bdud rtsi bsgrubs pas tshe stobasaye shes 'phel dngos kun dwangs ma bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor bsgom kā ya sidhi tshe:wāk+ka sirnyi ā:tsit+ta sirnyi (:sarba sirnyi hrīḥgator ma 'bul ba ni / snang ba snye da kyi 'jin rtenagazhong pa dra srid pa bcud kyi dpal yon gtor chen bkod:'dod yon lha mo mdzes pa'i gar dang bcas:dkyil 'khor gsum ldan rdo rje phur pa'i lha:shwa na sa bdag bdaganyid skyes ging rnams:dam rdzas bā ling rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes:mthu dang rdzu 'phrul byung ba'i dus la bab:tshe ma hā bā ling ta hi:rak+ta 'bul ba ni hūḥdam chig chen po'i dusal bab dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i bgegs:lha yang rung ste bdud da sri:yud tsam gyis ni bsgral bar mdzod:tshod ma hā rak+ta khā hi:bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs sngon chad dam mnos ji bzhin du:khro bo chen po'i bka' bsgos ltar:mngon sprod tshul bzhin grub par mdzod:ma hā rak+ta khā hi brdung shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun:bka'

las 'das byed sdig can rnams: rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg nas: lus ngag rdul du brlag pa dang : mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par mdzod: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: kha the kha the: hā na han hūṃ phaṭa dngos grub na hūṃ hrīḥ srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : ki la ya yi dngos grub stsol: sgrol mchod na (ཿ dam tshog chen po'idus la bab: snying rje'i 'gal zlar gyur ba'i dgra bsad cing mnan pam yin te phung po rdo rje gtam byas nas: rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom: e ma ṭaṃ ru tra pra be sha ya phaṭa: me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha hi: sbyor mchod ni (ཿ yeshes khro bo chen po yis rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'khor lo lnga yi da la rtsa dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor mar: kun+dha mnyam sbyor dga' ba bzhis: dgyes nas ye shes bde chen dpal skal bcan gyis nyams su myong mtshan ma'i spyod pa rnam dag nas: mkha' spyod mkha' la dbang bsgyur regag: sarba tā thā ga tā ma hā a nu rā ga na a bṛ ta kurnya li ho: a3 li ma hā su kha

8kho byu dza ho:bstod pa na hrīḥbadag nyid chen po 'bar ba'i gar dgus 'byud:gnas rnams khro bo khro mo las byed 'tshubs:sgo skyong ma mo bse lcags ging rnams rdzogs:brin las rtsa ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:gru gsum mthing nag e yi 1nga dkyil du:dpal gyi sras mchog badz+ra ki la ya:rigs bzhi khro bo yab yum bka' 'khor bcas ma lus lhun grub sgrol byed chen por bstod rab 'jigs pho brang bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i khar:rgyal kun 'phrin las chig rdzogs ku ma ra:mar gad mdangs 'bar dur khrod dpal chas klubs:gar dgu'i nyams stobs rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:mi 'jigs dpa' rtags rtse dgu rtse snga gdengs dug gsum dbyings sgrol me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams:skye ba rnams bzhi'i kha lo zhabs kyis bsgyur:mdzad pa'i 'phrin las 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod:sbyor ba'i yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma:ut+pal mdangs 'bar in+t+ra'i ral pa 'phyangs kha ṭī mgul 'khyud bhan dmar yab la stobs:rol pa chen po'i gad rgyang sgrogs la bstod:sa bcu'i dbang phyug ye shes khro bo bcu:pha

ja mnga' brnyes khro mo bcu: rlung sems dbyings sgrol za gsod pho nya 'gyed: bse lcags dung sogs bka' 'khor bcas la bstod: bdag nyid phur pa sgrub pa'i / srid pa rdo rje byang chub sems kyi dal: rig pa ye shes rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal: tshe 'di nyid la mngon du gyur bar shog: ༅gas pa ni sno rang rig ye shes blo dang rtags dang mtshan ma dus su ma gsal zhing : bsnyen sgrubs ting 'dzin g.yel ba'i nongs pa sogs: mi 'chab ye shes lha la bzod par gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya a:sngags ni spre badz+ra phaṭa 'dzab bskul ni hūṃḥ thugs dam chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir gsang ba ye shes dpal ze'u'i sgo: bsnyen sgrub 'dzab kyis bskul lags na:/ po 'byung ba'i phyir: srid pa rdo rje deng 'dir stsol: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: phung po rdo rjer gtam byas nas: rnam par bsgoms: bsnyen 'dzab ni bdag yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi zla'i dal mtheb lung tsam gyi lte ba la ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba phur pa 'dril ba

gyis bskor ba ye shes sems dpa'i sgo srung dpal rta mgrin gyis byed par gyur: sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes mchod 'bul: dbang byinadangos grub thams cad bsdus te bstims: 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyi las sgrib sbyangs: tshe dpal bsod nams 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud thams cad 'phrog labakug: gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad nye 'du mdzad bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i 'od gsal rab tu 'bar: dam can thams cad las la 'chun dgrabagegs bsgral ba'i dgongs pa la bzhugs tshe dang ye shes rig pa rang byung gi dkyil 'khor la mnga' dbang 'byor bar bsam la: tshe badz+ra gī li ki li ya sarba bisne baṃ hūṃ phaṭa:gzugs su snang ba thams cad he ru ga'i sku sgrags ru grags pa thams cad drag po chen po'i gsung dran rtog thams cad thugs ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du blta ba grub mtha' dang ting 'dzin bla na med pa yin no gsang sngags snyang

po'i sgra dal che na las 'khrung gdeng mtho na bka' chad 'bebs myur bar 'dres na 'dzan las kyi rno nyams shub bur bzlas na rtags mi 'byung bas skyon bzhi bsal la sgra grwa zur ma nyams par si li li bzla bar bya'o bsgrub 'dzab ni bdag bskyed kyithugs ga'i sngags 'phreng 'khor bzhin pa las 'od zer bar ma chad par sna bug g.yas nas 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar byung: sras mchog gi sna bug g.yon par zhugs: thugs gar sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal yon dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te bstims pas 'phrin las kyi spyi dpal chen por mnga' gsol: gdag phur 'ben gsum gyis mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par bsam la badz+ra yaka kro dha ki li ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa: ci nus su bzlas yang gras mchog dzaXthugs ga'i sngags 'phreng 'khor bzhin pa las 'od zer bar ma chad par byung: sna bug g.yas nas bdag nyid kyi sna bug g.yon par zhugs thugs srog sngags 'phreng dang 'dres pas sras mchog gi gsang srog la dbang bsgyur khams gsum gyis sems can dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus mthu thob: rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las rab

dzaX 'byams la thogs pa med pa'i yon tan gyi 'jug pa dang ldan par bsam la: ka badz+ra gī li ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa: skabs da bstun nas ci 'grub brjod par bya 'di'i dus su phur ba 'phur ba dang 'brab pa dang g.yo ba dang gsung sgrogs pa dang gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba dang dri bzang po 'thul ba sogs grub pa'i rtags mtshan bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'byu— ngo sgrub pa dngo sa ni bdag dpal chen po'i thugs ga'i sngags 'breng las 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar yab yum gyi zhal gsang bar lu gu rgyud du 'khor bas bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i 'od gsal mchog tu 'bar: snang grags dran rig thams cad lha sngags chos sku'i yo lang chen por sad par mos la: ma badz+ra kai li ki la ya sarba bisne baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: dza hūṃ ā:mi tshag gis bar mi gcod stan gyi drod ma bral bar bzlas pa la 'bad par bya'o yang bdag mdun gyi zhal gsang bar du sngags phreng 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar lu gu rgyud du bar ma chad par 'khor bas: 'khor 'das kyi stong sgog 'phrog: 'byung lnga'i dpal yon bstims: tshe dang bsod nams rig pa ye shes kyi gter chen po la mnga' dbang 'byor bar mos la: ma

badz+ra gī li ki la ya: dza hūṃ baṃ ho: ka rta ka ye dza ye: bhi dza ye a tsi te: a pa ra dzi te ma ra sa na pra mar ta na ye sarba bisne baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: 'ad ltar bzha snying gcig tu dril ba'i gsang sngags rgyal po 'di bzlas pas srid pa g.yo 'gul byed lhag pa'i lha'i zhal gzigs lung bstan pa rabs 'ja' zug ge sar rang 'bar bum chu khol ba sogs 'bring rmi lam du mkha' la 'phur ba phyag mtshan rted pa khrus la zhugs pa rirtser phyin pa gdug pa'i gcan gzan bkol ba sogs tha ma'i rtags tshad du 'byung bar 'gyur ro sa ma mā de nas las sbyor gyi 'dzab dmigs ni bdag dpal chen po'i sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas: 'od zer me rlung thun mtshon khro chung bu yug ltar steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'phros pas: dam can ma mo bcu gnyis bse lcags dung gi skyes bu'i tshogs thams cad la phog pas sngon gyi bka' tha tshig rjes su dran nas las la 'du zhing dpa' bo chen pos bka' stsol cig dang : bdag cag gis 'phrin las rab 'byams sgrub po zhes dam mnos: de ma thag par lings pas ri dwags la lings khyi bkye ba ltar rngams pa'i hab sgra ti ri ri song: dmigs bya gang yin pas 'gra bgegs gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad cing rdul du blag

: tshu pa dang : gzhan yang 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi rgyun tu bsgrub pa la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad de bzhi snying gcig tu dril ba'i sngags gyi mthar sham gi mthar 'dog go (sdedzña (jo/ wā shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: de yi dus su ta nge 'dzan rtse gcag du bzlas pas sgra grwa zur ma nyams par ti ri ri sgrogs pas: dam can gyi tshogs 'du ba'i sgra sna tshogs pa dang bse lcags dung gi skyes bu' bshugs glu'abud pa mna' tho bor ba mthos khol mngon gsum du 'byu ba sogs rtags kyi yon tan tshad gzung dang bral bar 'byung ngo skabs su sto tshag gis mchod bstod bya ba la dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snyang brjod mthar thod rnga dril bus sgras bskul te hūṃ hrī mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: srid pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: 'dzab dgongs grangs zem sman raka gtor tshogs 'bul sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs la bstod: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig chags nyams bshags: rang rig dpang btsug gzhung bzhin bsgrub lags na: mchog dang thun mongadangos grub dus 'dir stsol: yi/ badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wā ra ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta khā tī: ma hā rak+ta kha tī ma hā bha ling ta kha tī: hā tre+e bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil

nas dpal chen mngon rdzogs rdo rje gzhon nu dang : phur ba sras dang phyogs bcu khro bo'i dal: bka' nyan pho nya yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: dus su dngos grub bskul ba ni skabasa'adi 'don nyu: rdo rje gzhen nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: chos dbyings mi 'gyur thugs klong nas: ye shes gsal ba'i gzigs pas dgongs sridapa rdo rje phur bu'i lha:khro bo grub mdzod cig: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : ki la ya yis dngos grub stsol: deng sang skya rangs dang po shar rdo rje srin po'i nam langs nye: dngos grub stodus la bab thugs la le lo mi mdzad par mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u nas: ye shes gsang ba'i nyi ma shar sgyu lus zhu bdes dwangs mar smin bde ba chen po mngon tsukhams lnga gsang gadza/ma smin pa'i 'bras: he ru ka dpal mngon gyur mdzod: snyen phro badz+ra ku ma ra sarba sidhi pha la a la la ho: de dag dngos gzhi'i rim pa'o sa ma yā gsum pa rjes kya chos skyongs srung ma'i bsgang gsol ni gtor skyems byin gyis brlabs pa la na mo: rig 'ardzan grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : yi dam rdo rje gzhon sdo

sdod chos skyong ba'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyis bden pa dang : bden gnyis basmu ba med pas bden stobs kyi mthus: bstan pa dang bgegs zhing bcu tshangs ba thams cad sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: dzāḥhūḥboḥhe gtor ma rnams sha khrag rus pa'i phung po 'dozag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur: 37 āḥhū ha ho hrīḥ a ka ros sngags lan gsum gyis spel la srung ma rnams spyan 'dren pa ni hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol khro rgyalartags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : ki la ya yi dngos grub stsol: hūḥ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: sngon tshe dpal chen spyan snga dza khas

: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur byon: bdud dang dam sri 'dul ba dang : skal ldan rnal 'byor grogs mdzod cig: o badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥdza hūṃ baṃ phur bu'i lha tshogs thams cad sprin ser rlung gis bskyod pa ltar nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad gang bar bun ne thibs se byon par bsam hūṃ hrī ye shes kur ba'i gas sras 'khor bcas: bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa la: phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor tshogs 'bul sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las dgyes pa ngas rtsa ba yan lag dam tshigs nyams chags bshags rang dam dpang btsug bka' bzhin sgrub lags na: sku gsung thugs gyi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol tso badz+ra ku sa pā ri wa ra sarba pañtsa amṛ ta la kha tī: ma hā rak+ta la kha hi ma hā bha ling ta la khā hi: ma hā me sa ko ro tsa na ko ni ri ti bā su ta la khā hi: bstod bskul ni hūṃ dza mthing nag ra bas yi klong dkyil nas: dpal chen mngon rdzogs rdo rje gzhon nu ni: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs bsgrad: rtse dgu rtse lnga kha ṭ+wāṃ me dpung dang : ri rab

༷|༷ phur pas khams gsum dbyings su sgrol:mi sdug sgegs pa 'jigs rung sku yi gar:dgod gshe drag shul ldan pa rdo rje'i gsung:snying rje rngams zhi phyogs klang bral ba'i thugs:chos sku mtshan ma med pa don dam zhal:longs sku rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dpal:sprul sku khams gsum yong sa sgrol he ru ga bdud bzhi gdan du bting ba'i dpa' brjid can:'phrin las ku ma ra la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:bdud dang dam sri rgyal po'i cho 'phrul bzlog:mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags byad phur rbod gtong bzlog bh+yo:sbyor ba'i yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing be+eḍūr+ya ral pa sku rgyab 'phyangs:ut+pal la dang dmar chen bhan+ta stobs:g.yang gzhi gzig shams thod sbrul mdzes pas brgyan:dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril sbyor gad rgyang sgrogs:dbyings yum kun tu bza mor phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags byad phur rbod gtong bzlog: dza:dam tshig thugs dam chen po'i dus la babs:ljang nag 'bar ba e

yi 1nga dkyil nas dpal chen sras mchog badz+ra gī la ya: mi phyed rdo rje ut+pal mdog 'dra zhing : dbu la rigs lnga thugs sgog hūṃX du 'bar: sgrol byed phur pa 'dzin byed lcags kyus gzir: khro chung phra mos sku la rnam par gtams: tshe sgog len phyir dbal phur rtse mo e: thod sbrul rgyan 'chang rdo rje'i gshog pa brkyang: hūṃ mdzad la sogs khro bcu za gsod rdzogs: bdag nyid shwa na bse lcags 'du 'phro 'gyed: srid par 'khyams pa'i sems can ma lus pa: thabs kyis bsgral ba'i skal dang mi ldan yang: shugs kyis sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzad slad du: sras mchog gī la ya la phyag 'tshal bstod dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags byad phur rbod gtong bzlogahūṃ sbyo: pha rol phyin bcu'i mdzad phrin 'gyed mdzad pa'i ye shes khro bo hūṃ gar rnam par rgyal: gshin rje rta mgrin bdud 'khyil dbyug sngon can: mi g.yo 'dod rgyal khams gsum stobs po che: sna tshogs mtshon cha gdab pa'i phur bu gzir: rngams pa'i zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche bzhi gcigs: drag po'i gad rgyang nam mkha'i 'brug ltar

dza/ sgrogs: phyogs skyong zil gnon phyogs bcu'i gdon bgegs sgrol: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dur khrod dpal chas klubs ye shes khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshel bstod dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags byad phur thod gtong bzlog hū: pha rol phyin bcu'i don rtags 'chang mdzad cing gdul bya ma lus thabs kyis 'dren mdzad pa'i: dbyings kyi yum chen sgra 'byin snyem ma dang : dur bdag gtum mo rlung 'byin sder mo yum: gtun khung mda' snyems gsod byed bskul byed rnams: kha tog thab kyi cha 'dzin khro 'dzum sgegs: dmar ser ral brdzis thod sbrul g.yang gzhi klubs: chos dbyings mkha' la thugs rje thogs med 'gro: gri gug mgul 'byud bhan+ta thabs la stobs bde dang stong pa'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar: phyogs skyong mo bcu zil gnon mi dge spongs dge bcu'i khrims srung yang dag don la gnas: shes rab khro mo bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags byad phur rbod gtong bzlog bya za byed chen po

rngams pa'i mche bde gas ldan sku mdog yab kyi cha 'dzin rdzu 'phrul thobs mgo brnyan phag dang stag mo sha ba'i mgo:byi la seng ge g.yag dang gzig gi gdong:spyang khu dom dang dred kyi zhal ngoms shing:cir yang bsgyur bas mtshon cha thogs nas su: dpal gyi bka' nyan phyogs mtshams dgra bgegs sgrol: rlung sems dbang bsgyur thogs med bsgrod stobs can: za byed dpa' bo bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags byad phur rbod gto bzlog sa:gsod byed chen mo mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal can:kha tog yum gyi cha 'dzin ha ha rgod:rdo rje phra min smig bu bya rgod mgo srin bya pu shud pha waṃ bya rog mgo:bsgren mo khā ta khra dang sre mong mgo:sa 'og dbang bsgyur byi ba'i mgo bo can:sha chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed:sti ra 'thung zhing rten 'brel spyod pa can: dgra dang bgegs la bka' chad ston mdzad ma:gsod byed phra min dpa' mo bcu la bstod:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mtha' ma'i rdzas sngags byad phur rbod gtong bzlogaḥdza dkyil

rdokho 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi skyong mdzad pa'i:pu shud ga ga srin bya khra yi mgo lcags zhags sgrogs dril gdab pa'i phur ba 'dril:snying rje byams dga' btang snyoms ngabhe la gnas 'jigs pa'i phyogs zhi tshe bsod dpal spel zhing:'khor 'das dbang bsgyur dgra bgegs srog 'phrog pa'i:tshad med las mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags byad phur rbod gtong bzlog:dza bh+yo dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis:bka' gsang 'khor na gnas mdzad pa'i:ma mo bcu gnyis skyes ging bzhi:rdzu 'phrul can rnams da tshur 'dus:bh+yo:shar phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng tu:lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma de la lcags kyi mi mos zhon:mthing nag lcags phur dgra la 'dril:rak+ka thun gyi pho nya mo:sngags pa'i las la drag tu bskul:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mtha' mi kla kle'i cho 'phrul bzlog bh+yo:lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsib steng na:gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad ma de la bse yi mi mos zhon:ser nag ral ba rlung gis g.yeng:mkha' la

thogs med sgrod stobs can gser phur 'bar ba dgra la 'dril: gdug pa 'dul ba'i pho nya mo: drag tu bskul lo da tshur byon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mtha' mi kla sgo'i cho 'phrul bzlogaX bh+yo: nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsib steng tu: zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum ma: de la zangs kyi mi mos zhon: gcer bu ral ba thor cog bcing:dmigs pa'i yul la skad cig sleb: thogs med las kyi rdzu 'phrul can byi ru'i phur ba dgra la 'debs sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i dgongs spyod can: drag tu bskul lo gnas 'dir byon: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla sgo'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ bh+yo: byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng tu: g.yu yi khyi mo ral pa can: de la mchong gi mi mos zhen: mthing nag lcags kyi ral ba bsigs: king gang thog ser bu yug 'tshubs: sgrol byed las kyi phur ba 'dril: gdug pa'i snying 'byin drag shul can: sngags pas 'bod do da tshur byon: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla kla'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ bh+yo: shar stod 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na: dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti:

tshu chibs su dril rta rkang gsum chibs: mtshon gyi gru gu dgra la 'debs: ye shes thugs kyi phur ba 'dril nam mkha'i khams la dbang bsgyur la nad dang rim gyi char ba 'bebs ma mo chen mo da tshur byon: 'khu sdog gdug rtsub mi mdzad par brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla kle'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ bye lto stod 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na dpal ldan lha mo re ma dza: rdzu 'phrul g.yu 'brug chibs su bcibs: nam mkha'i khams nas glog 'gyu ma: bar snang khams nas ngar sgra sgrogs sa gzhir thog dang ser ba 'bebs: nad kyi rkyal ba dgra la sdebs: sgrol byed mchog phur bgegs la gzir ma gdung bu la brtse sems can: tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do byon: cho 'phrul gdug rtsub mi ston par: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla sgo'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ smyo nub stod 'khor lo'i rtsib steng su: dpal ldan lha more ma dzu: chibs su slog dmar 'jigs la chibs skad cig nyid la stong gsum bskor: sna tshogs 'phrul gyis bsgod stobs can: nyes can khram la 'debs pa mo: zhing bcu'i

tsit+ta phur dbal dril: las kyi pho nya gshegs su gsol : brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mtha' mi kla sgo'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ bh+yo: byang stod 'khor lo' rtsibs steng na:sgrol byed las byed re ma dzi: chibs su chu srin snyir la chibs: gdug pa rtsis 'debs shwa rdil thogs: dbang gi mi lag mchog phur 'dril: zhing bcu yan par mi 'chor bar:myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis byon: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla sgo'i cho 'phrul bzlogaX bh+yo: shar smad 'khor lo'i rtsib steng tu: rdo rje ya phyin rdzu 'phrul can chibs su bse stag dmar bkra chibs: gdug pa bdud kyi don snying 'byin: sha khrag sgog la dbang mdzad ma: phyag mtshan gser zor lcags phur 'dril: dam la gnas bzhin da tshur 'dus brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla kle'i cho 'phrul bzlogaX bh+yo lto smad 'khor lo' rtsib steng na: sa bdag de phyin mthu mo che:chibs su sman sha yu chung chibs: lo tog bcud la dbang za zhing: 'bar ba'i rkong bu lcags phur 'dril: srid pa gsum la dbang za zhing: sna tshogs thun 'debs pho nya mo: mthu

dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mtha' yas: phur ba sgrub pa'i grogs su byon: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla sgo'i cho 'phrul bzlog ༷ bh+yo: nub nga lo'i brtsibs steb tu: rdo rje bse phyin dbang mo che: chibs su rnga mong kwa pa bcibs: byad ma bcing bsdam zhags pa dang : sgrol byed thun shing phur ba 'dril: gdug kyi snying 'byin zhing : sbyor dang sgrol la mnga' brtes pa'i: phur 'debs chen mo da tshur byon: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla kle'i cho 'phrul bh+yo: byang smad 'khor lo'i brtsibs steng tu: rdo rje phag phyin rdzu 'phrul can: chibs su lcags kyi spyang mo bcibs sgrub gnas gtsug lags kun tu nyul: rnal 'byor mel rtses skyongs: phya dang g.yabhe ga char 'bebs ma: phur ba sgrub pa'i grogs mo che: skad cig yud tsam gnas 'dir byonaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:kla 1'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ dza: shar phyogs sgo nang dgra bgegs steng dung gi skyes bu mi bzad pa: sku la spyang dkar slag pa gsol: chibs su seng ge dkar mo

thogs med glog gi zhags pa dang : sgrol byed dung gi phur ba 'debs: gsang sngags rgyud srung tha tshig can gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon brgyan pa'i mchod bzhes la: mtha' mi kla kle'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ dza: lho phyogs sgo nangadagra bgegs steng: lcags kyi skyes bu mi sdug pa: sngo nag lcags kyi ral ba gzing: rta nag rting sa su bcibs: srin po'i dmag tshogs las la 'gyed: ru mtshon phyar zhing lcags phur 'dril: thogs med stobs kyis 'dir gshegs la: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor la mtha' mi kla kle'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ dza: nub phyogs sgo nangadagra bgegs steng bse yi skyes bu khro 'dzum sgegs: dbang gi dar ber 'khor gsum brgyan:sa zangs phur dgra la 'debs: chibs su me rta rlung gshog bcibs: bsam pa'i yul la skad cig sleb: myur mgyogs stobs kyi rgyal bo khyod: skad cig nyid la da brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla sgo'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ dza: byang phyogs sgo nangadagra bgegs steng da ki nag po me dbal 'jigs: sku mdog

lha mthing nag 'bar ba la: na bza' dar sngon ber chen klubs thod pa'i 'phreng ba se ral spras me rlung thog ser bu yug 'tshubs dgra bgegs nyes can gshed po che: gang nas bos kyang skad cig slebs: phur pa sgrub pa'i grogs po byed: rnal 'byor zhabs pad spyi bor len: bka' 'khu dam la 'gras pa'i bdud: tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do byon: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla kle'i cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ phud 'bul ba ni oṃ āḥhū sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ trīḥthaX ho dgongs su gsol lo lan gsum sku gsum dag pa'i pho brang nas: pha bka' rgyud kyi bla ma: yab rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu: rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa: rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa: gangazag snyan khung brgyud pa re ga ser tshig gi brgyud pa: bka' babs don gyi brgyud pa: smon lam las 'phros brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol mchod pa 'bul: phrin las bcol: dngos grub stsol cig ho: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: yab dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu: yum 'khor lo rgyas

'debs ma: thugs kyi sras mchog ki la ya rigs bzhi: ye shes kyi khro bo bcu: khro mo bcu: za byed pha bcu gsod byed ma bcu: khra thabs nyer gcig: sgo skyongs ma bzhi dbangaphyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mchod pa 'bul phrin las bcol: dngos grub stsol gcig: ho rdo rjephur bu'i srung ma shwa na ma bzhi re ti chenamo mched bzhi: sa bdag bse mo bzhi: bse lcags dung gi skyes bu bzhi: dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol mchod pa 'bul: phrin las bcol dngos grub stsol cig: ho: slob dpon rgyud kyi srung ma pha phyes rgyud kyi srung ma: dben gnas gnyan gyi srung ma nya stong dus drug gi bsrung ma: sgrub gnas gtsug lag gi srung ma: rnal 'byor yongs kyi srung ma: rin chen gter gyi srung ma: skye ba sngon nas 'brel ba rang bzhin shugs la 'khor ba'i bka' sdod dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol: mchod pa 'bul: brin las bcol: dngos grub stsol cig: sa dam tshog dus la bab so: bcol ba'i las mdzod cig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung

lhakhri shig:snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs cig:grags pa'i ba dan phyor cig:phya g.yang gi gter sgo phyes cig:dngos grub gyi sbrang char phob cig:nyams rtogs gyi sgon me sbor cig:dge mtshan gyi lho sprin bsdus shig:dpa' rtags gyi rgyal rnga brdung shig bdag rnal 'byor ba su la'ang mi re khyod la re'o su la'ang mi ltos khyod la ltos so:rje mi 'gyur ba gser gyi pha wong de khyed yin:'bangs mi 'gyur ba g.yu yi kā ba de bdag yin:rgyal mtshan du khyod 'dzug go dpa' dar du khyed phyar ro sdang ba'i dgra thul cig gnod pa'i bgegs chom cig:bar chad kyi rkyen sol cig za ba'i 'dre thul cig phung ba'i sri gzhom cig:gang bsam pa'i don thams cad bsgrub cig ci re ba'i smon pa yid bzhin du 'byung bar mdzod cig:gter srung skong gsol ni hūḥrdo rje pad+ma thod phre gi:bka' rtags spyi bor bcing bzhin du:dam tshig thugs la gnas pa yi:bdud btsan klu yi sbu gri ni:mkhar chu gsang ba'i gnas mchog dang :ldong lha gnyan gyi brag phug nas:ma thogs gnas 'dir yud tsam 'dus:sngags pa'i 'phrin las gang bcol sgrubs:

na gtor ma 'di bzhes la sku mched chen po khyed rnams kyis: nyon mongs las skyes dgra dang bgegs: dug gsum 'khrul snang rdul du rlog: tshe ye ye: zhur zhur dmag dpon chen po 'khor dang bcas pas dgra bgegs kyi me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā hi: 'phrin bcol ni hūṃ bh+yo: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang : phur ba sras bcu khro bo dal: bka' nyan pho nya'i 'khor tshogs khyed rnams kyis bdag nyid phur ba sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: tshe chos bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub stsol: dgra sris rgol ba mi 'byung bar: dur khrod g.ya' gangs sgrub pa'i gnas mchog tu stag mos ri sul 'grims ltar spyod skyong tshe: rnal 'byor lus dang gris ma bzhin du nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel: sgrub 'bras mi g.yel dus su 'byung ba dang : rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sa zin nas: o rgyan mkha' 'dza'i spyod pa dang : bla ma'i zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi nod sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan rtsal rdzogs de: 'gro ba'i 'dren ston dam par bdag gyur cig: bzod gsol ni

86 ho rab 'byams rgyal kun brin las gcig bsdus pa: rdo rje gzhon nu gtso 'khor sprul bcas dgongs bdag rmongs sor byang sngags sdom nyams pa kun mi 'chab gnong 'dzamad sdom sems bcas te bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya ā: yag brgya bzlos la lag chad bskang bar bya'o de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni bza' ba du mar 'tshogs pa'i tshogs rnam rtog logartog gcod pa'i 'khor ro mnyam rdo rje'i dga' ston la gtsang spe gnyis 'dzin rtog pa sbongs sa ma mā tshogs byin gyis rlabs pa ni hū snyisno ta kri ta phaṭa sarba pra phyam shwa dha ni hūṃ phaṭaḥswā hā: hū ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa'i: sku gsung thugs las 'byu gsum spros: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin bsregs sbyangs bkrus: zag med ye shes bdud rtsiraspel: 'dod yon lha mo dpag med bcas nam mkha' rab 'byams khyon bkang gyur yin āḥ/ཿnam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum gyis spel la tshogs zhang spyan 'dren pa ni hūṃ hrī chos sku skye med spros dang bral ba nas gzug sku 'gags med rdo rje phur ba'i lha yab yum sras 'khor sprul ba bka' sdod bcas: 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rmad

byung rtags mtshan bzang po bstan pa dang :nyi la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol:mdzes pa'i gzugs kyi bye brag bsam mtha' yas:snyan 'gyur rol mo'i brda glu ti ri ri tshul khrims dri bsung bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs:lha yi zhal zas sha lnga bdud rtsi spungs:na bza' lhab lhubs 'ja' sprin bkod mdzes bsgrigs:chos kyi dga' ston chosanyid yangs pa'i 'phrul:'di na sna tshogs bkod pa lhun gyis grub:rgo ā ༷ka:kaka bīr+ya dha ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza tshogs phud dbul ba ni hūṃ trī:lce gas gzhong rat+na mdzes pa'i sgodayangs par:sha lnga bdud rtsi 'dod yon lnga ldan gter mdzes pa'i lha mo du mas gar dang bcas:rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje phur ba'i lha:shwa na sa bdag re ti skyes gingatshogs:dga' ston 'dod yon mchod pa bzhes su gsol:skyong ma hā a dṛ tā khā hi ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa ho bskang ba ni hūṃ snang srid phur ba gdab pa'i phyir:rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugasadam bskangs:thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i 'khor lo rgyas 'debs thugs dam bskangs nyon mongs dug lnga gnas sgrol ba'i:ki la rigs lnga'i thugs dam

rdokho bskangs:mi dge bcu po rtsad gcod pa'i:khro bo bcu yi thugs dam bska sa:dge bcu chos nyid don dang ldan:khro mo bcu yi thugs dam bskangs:sems rtogs pa dbu mar bza':za byed pha bcu'i thugs dam bskangs:mtshan ma'i snang ba chos skur gzhig:gsod byed ma bcu'i thugs dam bskangs: tshad mengabazhi'i sgo skyong ba'i:sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskangs 'phrin las rab 'byams thogs med sgrubs:shwa na ma bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs phur ba sgrub pa'i grogs bdag nyid ma bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs:mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog mdzad pa 'i:sa bdag ma bzhi'i thugs dam bska sa zhing bcu'i don snying skogs mar skyes bu ging bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs:sgrub pa'i drod nyul rnal 'byor skyongs:dbang phyug nyer brgyad thugs dam bskangs:rnal 'byor chags nyams sor chud nas:bdam gnyan po bskang ba dang :bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyas rdzogs don 'grub sku gnyis mngon gyur shog:bar bshags ni hūṃḥdapal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang :

mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: sras mchog khro bcu khra thabs dang : sgo skyong shwa na sa bdag ma: re ti skyes ging dbang phyug yum zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: rnala'abyor nyams chags rtog sgrib bshags: tshe bsod rtogs pa 'phel bar mdzod: badz+ra sa ma ya bhi shudhe ā: gsum pa bsgral las ni yid badz+ra rakru du khaṃ lcags khang gru gsum pa nadamatshon dug gi yo lang 'tshubs pa'i nang du naX dang tri las zhing bcu tshangs ba'i dgra bgegs gang yin pa de dngos su gsal gdab: bdag mdun las spros pa'i pho nya lcagasazhags sgrog dril thogs pa grangs med pa 'phros nas dgra bgegs gang yin pa de bcing pa lngas bcing nas brub khaṃ nang gi ling ga la yang yang bstim mo: chos nyid kyi bdenapa'o: rgyal ba thams cad 'phrin las rdo rje phur bu'i phyag rgyar bzhengs su gsol: gsang sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'o: pho nya dam can rnams las la 'du zhing drag pomangon spyod kyi mdzad 'brin la zhugs par dmigs: a bhi tsar+ya'i dus la babs pa'o: mdun gyi nam mkhar gzi dpang shan 'byed kyi tshul du bzhugs nas rnal 'byor ba'i sdong

༷ grogs byed par mos brnag pa 'di kho na la'o: dgra bgegs la nyes bsgrags byed cing thugs rje'i thabs kyis bzung ba'o: skyo badz+ra ki li gi la ya dpal chen po'i sku yi che ba bskyed ma badz+ra ki li ki la ya dpal chen po'i gsung gi gad rgyang bsgrags pa'o: ma badz+ra ki li ki la ya: dpal chen po'i thugs chos nyid snying rje'i ngang las: log rtogs 'dul ba'i dgongs spyod la 'jugs pa'o: 'gugs pa ni na mo rig 'dzin grub thob brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul phur ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang: ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang: rdo rje chos skyongs bsrung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i bla la 'jab pa: tshe la rku ba: sgog la rngams pa: dang po nad kyi sna 'dren ba bar du gdon kyi tshang bca' ba: tha ma phong thal sna gu ston pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong mkhan

thams can rang dbang med par bcings pa lngas bcings nas:brub khung nang gi gzugs rten ling ga 'di la khug cig phob cig badz+ra e gu sha dzaḥdza hūṃ baṃ ho: skabs dang bstun nasaci rigs brjod dza thams cad 'gugs byad lcags kyu ma: dkar mo 'bum gyis dgra bgegs khug: 'ching byed gser gyi zhags pa thogs: ser mo 'bum gyis dgra bgegs chings:sdom byed chen mo'i lcags sgrogs 'dzin dmar mo 'bum gyis dgra bgegs sdoms:myos byed chen mos dril bu 'bebs:ljang mo 'bum gyis dgra bgegs myos gangal dmigs pa shwa ra re: pho nya las mkhan lag ma ldum gdab pa'i mtshon cha ngar ma zhan:drag rtsal can rnams thugs ma g.yel: dgra bgegs 'gugs 'ching sdom myos mdzod:ci rigs brjod phur ba'i lasamakhan rnams kyis gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs de'i snying lcags kyus drangs ske zhags pas bcings yan lag sgrog gis bsdam:sems dril bus myos par byas nas las kyi ling ga 'di la dbab par mdzod cig: thun dang po'i bla 'gugs ni dza dam tshog chen po'i dus la babs: sprul ba chen po'i dus la

:ga babs: shā na mu kha'i dus la babs:bdag nyid chen po'i dus la babs:sa bdag ma bzhi'i dus la babs:skyes bu ging bzhi'i dus la babs bdag ni phur bu'i rig 'dzin te:khyed cag bka' srung dam tshig can yid la gnag pa 'i dgra bgegs rnams:khams gsum srid gsum gar gnas kyang rang dbang med par snying nas zungs:bla khug las kyi ling gar phob:spu gra' sngags mthar bla khug dra triḥbadz+ra i ku sha dzaḥdza hūṃ baṃ ho:brgya rtsa la sogs ci rigs brjod thun gnyis pa lha dbye ba'i las ni /:dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs:sprul ba chen mo 'i dus la babs:'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs:khyed kyi mngon spyod dus la babs bdag ni phur bu'i rig 'dzin te:phur srung dam can bka' sdod rnams: mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhe sa:bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegs:'go ba'i lha bsru kun dang phrol: skyobs byed kun dang dbye bar gyis myur du 'bog brgyal brlag las mdzod:sbu gri'i sngags mthar a dṛḥtraḥtrag rak+ka dgra bo lha dang phyes shig pra be sha ya phaṭa:brgya rtsa la sogs ci rigs brjod thun

gsum par bcing ba'i las ni dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: bka' sdod sprul pa'i dus la babs: bse lcags skyes ging dus la babs ma mo bcu gnyis dus la babs bdag ni phur bu'i rig 'dzin te: khyed cag bka' dang dam la 'dus: thad du langs ba'i dgra bo de: byad rgya gru gus thul du chug: sngo dmar las kyi zhags pas chings: sgo gsum 'gul mi shes pa na/ dgra bo bcings bsdams 'chor med mdzod: spu gri'i sngags mthar dṛḥtriḥm ra ya hūṃ ri li li chings shig chings shig pa sha hūṃ: brgya rtsa la sogs ca rigasabarjod thun bzhi bar spyo 'bog ga las ni dza dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: shwa na mu kha'i dus la babs: bdag nyid chen po'i dus la babs: sa bdag ma bzhi'i dus la babs skyes bu ging bzhi'i dus la babs: bdag ni phur bu'i rig 'dzin te: khyed cag bka' yi srung ma lags: ma g.yel ma 'khyang las la chas: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs la nad mtshon dug gi char ba phob: sgo gsum spyo 'bog brgyal du chugs thar 'chor med par brlag mdzod cig: spu gra'i sngags ma thar: dṛḥtre+e a mu ka dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya myos shig

tswakho 'bogs shig nag thib se sod: kārma gharnye ho: brgya rtsa la sogs ca rigs brjod thun lnga bar bsgral 'dren rdu gawa kyi las ni hū dam chig chen po'i dus la babs dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang : yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mas: ri rab phur ba dgra la 'debs: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor: bla badz+ra kai be+e ki la ya a phaṭa zhes gtso mchog gi phur ba gdab hū: dam chig chen po'i dus la babs: mthing nag e yi 1nga dkyil nas: sras mchog badz+ra ki la ya: sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i las la bskul: pho nyasprul ba g.yog 'khor bcas mngon spyod drag po'i las la chas: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs gyi rnam shes skye med dbyings su spor: ma badz+ra kai be+e ki la ya kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta.a we sha ya a ā: skyod badz+ra 11 ta hūṃ ka ra (ཿ dgra bgegs dzaḥtriX.a phaṭa: zhes sras mchog gi phur ba gdabs skabs 'dir spro na khro bcu yab yum za gsod khra thabs sgo skyong dang bcas pa'i phur ba gdab denas spu gris dgra bgegs gyi gzugs phung gas te hūṃ: dam chig chen po'i dus la bab: bka' sdod sprul ba'i dus la babs: bdag ni phur bu'i rig 'dzin te: byang chub mchog tu sems

bskyed cing: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob par bdud dang bar du gcod pa yi: tshe sgog mdangs la rgol byed pas: khyed rnams mthu dang rtsal byung la: dgra bgegs phung khams dum bur gtub: lus sems gnyis kyi 'brel thag chod: rnam shes zhakhrul mi shes par sgol: gzugs phung tshogs kyi 'khor lor bsgyur: tshe ha la ha la khasgo ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: g.yo brdu ni /: dam tshig chen po' dus la babs sprul ba chen po'i dus la babs: mngon spyod drag po'i dus la babs: 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs stong pa yum gyis mkha' klong du: thabs mchog rig pa'i rdo rje yis: dgra bgegs sha khrag rus gsum brdung: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: tshe badz+ra ki li ki la ya dgra bgegs ta tha ya ta tha ya hūṃ phaṭa: phye ma phye ma rdul phran rdul phran mā ra ya sod bstab pa ni hūṃḥ rdo rje gzhen nu yab yum dang ཿ sras mchog khro bo khra thabs kyi: chos nyid mnyam pa'i zhal phyes shig: log rtogs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: phung khams skye mched zhal du bstabs: lhag ma ma lus par ni bzhes: 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo chos skur shig: ma hā

rdo15 mo sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha hi:dgra bgegs kyi khams chen brtswa brgyad la kha sa:skye mched bcu gnyis la kha dī:lus zungs bzhi la kha twe:dbang po rnam lnga la kha tī:rnam shes tshogs brgyad la kha tī:de nas bzlog 'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni hūṃ dza:stong gsum sto ngagi 'jin rten kun dur khrod me ru 'bar ba'i dal:ye shes khro bo khros mos gtams:bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la:las kyi khro rdul bu yug 'tshubs:phur pa sras kyi dkyil 'khor las:sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i 'phrin las 'gyed:phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor kyis:gdul dka' ma lus 'dul bar byed:sngon gyi thugs dam ci bzhin du:ma tram̐ bsgral ba'i tshogs ston 'bul:rngams pa'i rkan sgra bcas te rol:'di ltar bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod:bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams bzlog stong phrag brgya cu'i bgegs rnams bzlog:nyi khri chig stong rkyen gegs bzlog:steng nas thog ser 'beb pa bzlog:'og nas klu nad 'bab pa bzlog:bar nas sde brgyad cho 'phrul bzlog:mi nag skye bo'i yos kha bzlog:bran g.yog ngan pa'i dmod mchu bzlog:mdze drag

grum bus btab pa bzlog: byad ma mnan gtad hom zor bzlog: zhang zhung bon gyi btso zor bzlog mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags dug btabs bzlog mi nyag pa yi 'bod 'dre bzlog: gri kha mtshon rtse smas ngo bzlog: mo ngan rtsis rdil 'khrugs pa bzlog: rmi lam than ltas cho 'phrul bzlog: pha ma'i dur sri langs pa bzlog: mi la na tsha gtong ba bzlog:rta phyug nor kyi god kha bzlog: gnam nas dal kha 'debs pa bzlog: sa yi dug mda' g.yos pa bzlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su bsgyur: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du bsgyur:spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la bzlog: chung bdud dal kha thur du bsgyur : bzlog bsgyur byed pa'i dus la babs: bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod tshe badz+ra ki li gī la ya sarba bhisne baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: 17da 17ra sarba bachogag bye : 'di yis mi bzlog gang yang med nus pa gnam lcags thog dang 'dra bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal nges shes gting nas 'grong bar 'gyur sa ma shā de nas lhag ma gtong ba ni nyu: dpal chen garma he ru ga'i: bka' yi 'khor na gnas pa yi rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun: dkar mo dung gi gzhong pa thogs: tshad med snying rje zhi la

༷ gnas rnal 'byor yongs kyi grogs su bsngags: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun: ser mo gser gyi gzhong pa thogs: tshad med byams pas nyams rtags bskyed rnal 'byor zhal chab pham phab len: pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun dmar mo pad+ma'i yol ko thogs: tshad med dga' bas dbang bsdud mo: sgrub gnas gtsug lag chos 'khor skyongs: karma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun: ljang mo be+eḍūr gzhong pa thogs: tshad med btang snyoms sbyor sgrol 'gyed: legs nyes stangs 'dzin mkha' la 'gro: bhurnya rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bdun mthing gsal rat+na'i gzhong pa thogs: tshad med thugs rjes thabs la mkhas: sngags pa'i bka' nyan 'phrin las sgrub: khyed rnams sngon gyi bka' lung bzhin: dpal gyi pham phab 'di bzhes la: rnam mang 'phrin las sgrub bzhin du: rnal 'byor lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: tshe badz+ra rat+na pa d+ma kurma bhurnya bhi sha lo ka ḍāk+ki ni uṣ+ṭi ṭa bha lirnyi pañtsa a dṛ ta rak+ta kha tī: lhag gtor dkyil 'bor byang shar spungs de nas dab mo'i rtsang gyer ni hūṃ bh+yo: gdug rtsub dbal ngar ldan ba'i rtsang phur rnams: ma tram̐

lus la srin mo' 'gros su bkod:rtse mo 'dab chags sha khrag spu yis brgyan:rtsa ba lder chags mdangs dang khrag gis byugs rked par dbang mo bzhugs pa'i rgya mdud brjid:phan tshun drwa ba mig mang ris su bkra lcags kyi 'phar spyang dom dred stag gzig rgyu:dgra bgegs gdug pa'i bla tshe srog la rngams:lcags kyi bang ba mang po rdul ltar 'tshubs dam nyams zhing bcus dri 'dzin lam nas zhugs:rnam shes mar me tshe srog rgya gtor la:chos dbyings 'khrul mi shes pa'i sa ru sgol:81 kegs zla gegs zhag gegs za gegs bzlog pho bdud mo bdud chung sri g.yo ba bzlog:gri kha mtshon rtse sman ngo cho 'phrul bzlog:mi nad nor gyi god yams 'khrugs rtsod bzlog:za 'dre phung sri god 'dre g.yo ba bzlog:thams cad ma lus bzlog bsgyur 'phrin las mdzod:kaḥsaḥr dugaX da tri mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byad phur rbod gtong thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlogabazlog de nas na sgo dbye ba ni dza:shar phyogs pu shud mgo can gyis:tshad med dung sgo dkar po phyes:nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang :rig pa ye shes dngos grub stsol:

dza 〉 haX badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: hūṃ lho phyogs gangaga'i mgo can gyis: tshad med gser sgo ser po phyes: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang : nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol: riXrat+na pra we sha ya phaṭa: baṃ nub phyogs srin bya'i mgo can gyis: tshad med zangs sgo dmar po phyes: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang 'dus shig: rlung sems dbyings bsdus dngos grub stsol: niḥpad+ma pra we sha ya phaṭa: ho byang phyogs khra yi mgo can gyis: tshad med lcags sgo sngon po phyes: dgra bgegs rdul du brlag pa dang : gnyis snang zag zad dngos grub stsol: sa garma bra we sha ya phaṭa: ho: ye shes sgo ma khyed rnams kyis dza gad gser skyems 'di bzhes la: gnas spor mngon spyod las la bzhe sa gtor ma las kyi mtshon char bsgyur: dngos grub rnal 'byor dpa la du stsol: skyems phud phyogs bcur bsgrengs sha mchod de nas dngo sa grub zhu ba na hū: dbus mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i la tshogs rnams thugs rje'i rtsal g.yos rnal 'byer pho mo'i phyogs thun mong dngos grub grub pa brgyad dang ni mchog gi dngos grub he ru ka

dpal srid: skal ldan sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol: yon bdag tshe ring nad med ci bsam 'grub: bdag gzhan chos ldan bkra shis grub mchog stsol: rtsa sngags mthar sirnyi pha la a la la ho: de nas phyi sgo dbye ba ni skyems gtor sbyangs bsgyur spel byas te hūṃ ye nas dam srog thob pa yi: stod smad bar la gnas bcas pa'i srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang : gangs dkar nyi shu rtsa gcig dang : ma yam bstan ma bcu gnyis sde: snang zhing srid pa'i gzhi bdag kun dza gad gser skyems gtor ma bzhes: gtor sgo zor sgo yas sgo phyes: nad sgo gdon sgo yam sgo 'don: gtor zor drag po'i mtshon cha 'di: dgra bgegs gnyis kyi srog la phob pha ri tshu ri g.yas g.yon mdun 'dir gnas gzhi bdag lha klu rnams:kun kyang dza gad gser skyems bzhes: mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs yar bskums: dma' ba rnams kyi dbu mar phob: thad du 'dug pa g.yas g.yon zur: rnal 'byer bdag gi grogs mdzod la: gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la phob ming med brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: cha a ka ni: ni ka ni a bhi la masnyo la ma ye swā hā gtor lam phyes zor

rdo lam phyes yas lam phyes dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams ma 31ra myur du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: de nas thugs dam gnad bskul na gtor ma khrag skyemasabashams pa la 'gugs bstims byas nas 'di skad do hū bye mi mngon chos dbyings dbus mtha' med pa nas: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang : dmigs med yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra gī la ya: phyogs skyong 'dul mdzad ye shes khro bo bcu ma rig mun bsreg shes rab khro mo bcu za byed mche rngams rtags kyi bde ga pa can: tshad med rang mdangs las kyi sgo ma bzhi: lcags kyi spyang mo rngams pa'i mgo dgu la gser gyi 'phar ba sgrol byed lce brgyad ma zangs kyi wa mo gtum rngams rkang gsum mo: g.yu yi khyi mo zug pa'i sgra sgog ma: re ti chen mo sbyor sgrol las mkhan mo: bse yi bud med sha za khrag 'thung bzhi bse lcags dung gi skye ging dgra sgog bdud dbang phyug chen mo legs nyes stang 'dzin ste: rdo rje phur bu'i bka' 'khor sprul bcas rnams ye shes sgyu mar rol ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor

'di bzhes la: do nub mngon spyod drag po'i las la bskul: sdang byed dgra la bka' yi chad pas chod: nyes byed bgegs dpung ming gi lhag mar bsgyur: dam sri rdul du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab so sa ma yā: zhes brjod gtor skyems dgra phyogs steb de nas chad mdo gtong ba ni hūṃ sbyo sdon tshe 'das dus bskal ba'i dang po la: bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru gas ma ṭaṃ rū tra bsgral ba'i dus tshig la: dbang phyug ma sring dam can rgya mtsho rnams: so se'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang dbyar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring ba dang : nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar spel ba sogs: khas blang dam mnos tha tshig ci bzhin du 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bya: de'og 'og min dag pa'i lha gnas su: dam pa'i rig can grwa ma rnams lnga la lag na rdo rjes rgyud gtad dbang bskur tshe: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho yis: khas blangs zhal bzhes dam mnos ci bzhin du: so so'i gzugs

mchog dam pa bstan nas kyangaḥ dbyar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring ba dang : nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar ba sogs: khas blang dam mnos tha tshig ci bzhin du: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo de dus tshig gsum pa la babs tshe: mchod rten chen po bde byed brtsegs pa na bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mdzod dgu'i rgya bkrol tshe bka' babs rig 'dzin bu dgu'i spyan khas blangs zhal bzhes dam mnos dam can rnams so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyangaḥ dbyar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: sgrub mchog rnal 'byer bsring ba da : nyams rtogs yar do 'i zla ltar spel ba sogs: khas blang dam mnos tha tshig ci bzhin du: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor 4 ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo de 'og dus tshig bzhi ba la babs tshe: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag tu: rje 'bangs grogs lnga lang gro lo tswa la

rdo rje phur bu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: dbang bskur lung gnang gtad rgya mdzad pa'i tshe: bse lcags dung ging ma mo bcu gnyis kyis khas blangs mna' bor dam mnos ci bzhin du: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang dbyar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring ba dang : nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar spel ba sogs: khas blang dam mnos tha tshig ci bzhin du: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod:spyo: de 'og dus tshig lnga pa la bab tshe rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang du: o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: lang gro lo tswa'i sku yi gar 'dzin par dgongs brda snyan brgyud man ngag gnyer gtad tshe: rang rtsal dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho yis: snyigs ma'i bod 'bangs skyongs bar zhal bzhes shing: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyangaX dbyar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring ba dang : nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar spel ba sogs: khas blang dam mnos

tswakho tha tshig ci bzhin du: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: smyo deng dus snyigs ma'i dus la bab pa'i tshe: phun tshogs lnga yi sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung zhing bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi yis gzhung bsrings nas: 'bras bu rig 'dzin sa mchog bsgrub pa la sdongagrogs byed pa'i bka' sdod dam can rnams: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang dbyar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : sgrub mchog rnal 'byor sku tshebasrings ba dang : nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar spel ba sogs: khas blangs dam mnos tha tshig ci bzhin du: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byorabacol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā de nas gtor ma zor bsgyur ni sno nyes med rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: gzu dang dpang du dkonamachog bzhugs dza gad gser skyems 'di bzhes la: gtor zor las kyi mtshon cha 'di: dgra bgegs gnyis kyi srog la phob yungs zor rbab ltar hro lo lo mda' thun thog

ltar sha ra ra rdo zor rgyog ltar thibs se thibs: mtshe zor skar ltar khrigs se khrig: gtor zor dbal ngar tha ra ra: me rlung dug mtshon bu yug 'tshubs: yid brnag zhing bcu'i steng du rbad: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlog bgegs dpung ming tsam med par mdzod: mngon spyod 'phrin las grub mdzod cig: dus la babs po sa ma yā: tshe badz+ra tsar+sha sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa: thun ya thun ya zor ya zor ya dgra bgegs 'byung po'i sgog rtsa la rbad sod: gtor ma dgra yi phyogs su sdebs dmod pa bor zhing ral basprugs dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jigs bgegs sde rtsad nas gcod par 'gyur sa ma wā de nas brtan skyong brngan pa ni bye ཿkhags ()dbang phyug pad+ma rgyal po yi: spyan sngar khas blang mna' bor dam mnos pa'i rdo rje kun grags gangs kyi g.yu bun ma: dpal ldan ha ri 'ug chos la ro sman: yang dag shes dang 'brog gnas drag rgyal ma: kong btsun te mo rdo rje g.yu sgron sogs: bdag nyid ma bzhi gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi: sman mo bzhi dang sprul ba g.yog 'khor bcas lhabs lhubs rgyan dang dril g.yer sna tshogs spras: dril rta ri dwags rlung

(khri gi gshog ldan bcibs ming po'i bka' bzhin rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis byon: dbu 'pha dma' bzhin bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes: so thar 'dul ba'i bcas khrims srung ba dang : byang chub sems ldan skyes bu'i thugs bzhed bsgrub: sngags kyi rtsa ba yan lag dam tshag srung nyes lhung byung la bka' yi chad pas chod: bka' bzhin bsgrub pa po la nyams rtogs bskyed: 'phrin las rtsol cig ma mo bstan ma'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: cha badz+ra bra mo ha la la ting ting srang 'gro ma e rda bha ling ta kha tī zhes brjod brten gtor gtsang sar gshegs de nas bro mnan bya ba ni hūṃ: khro bo rol ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bar chad dam sri 'dul ba'i phyir: dbang gi rgyal bo rta mchog dpal: gtum rngams rta skad 'u ru dra/ dpa' bos pro gar khrigs se khrig: snying rje chen po'i gar ngoms bzhin: pho gdon zhabs g.yas stabs kyis bsgyur: mo bdud dam sri zhabs g.yon mnan chung bdud dgra sri mkha' la bsal: pho brang e yi dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'byung po thams cad nye mi nus: rnam rtog gnyis snang ar la gtad: rig pa ye

shes bro rgyas gdab: byang chub sems ni ma skyes par nam yang dam sri thar mi 'gyur: / bzhi' sngags mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā stu bha ya nan: de nas bzod gsol 'bul ba ni ho: dkyil 'khor gsum ldan rdo rje phur ba'i lha: byams chen thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol: dag mnyam ma rtog stan ghan gnas ma stobs rlung sems khu rdul bag chags mdud rgya kun: mi gnas mi dmigs ye shes phur bar 'chags: badz+ra sa ma ya ā: yig brgya dbyangs gsal bzlas la lhag chad kha bskang ngo bsngo smon ni ho: phun tshogs lnga ldan sgrub pas bzhi bzung la: bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi yis gzhung bsrings nas: 'bras bu rig 'dzin lnga yi sa bsgrub dge: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnam grol rgyu ru bsngo: 'dus byas bdag gnyis 'chings rgya rab grol te: he ru gaXdapal nyid du byang chub shog: lan gsum mdun bskyed ye shes sems dpa' la ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pas: de srid brtan par bzhugs su gsolaḥ bsdu rim ni ( snod kyi zhing khams gzhas yas khang la bsdu: de yang lha tshogs lha rnams gtso bo la: gtso bo ye shes sems dpa'i thugs sgog la: grog

shā tsho yig na dwa smra bsam brjod bral ngang: dbyings rig dbyer med chos sku'i dgongs par bzhag: a āḥ āX skad cig stong gsal chen po'i ngang nyid las: rdorje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal ma bral bar: snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i la skur ldang yi badz+ra shī yi gī la ya: lan bdun gya lus gso yi badz+ra shī be+e ki la ya: lan bdun gyas ngag gso sa badz+ra ke be+e gī la ya: lan bdun gyis thugs gso ba'o go bgo ba ni hūṃ: rtses kyang mi chod mi shig pa'i: rdo rje'i go cha bla na med: mtshan ma'i gdon gyis gzhom gzhig bral: chos dbyings dgongasapa'i phyag rgyas btab: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: badro ka pa tsi rak+ṣa hūṃ: badro badz+ra badz+ra hūṃ: rgyun spyod ni dpal rdo rje gzhan nu snang stong rig pa'i rang mdangs tsam du shes pa'i ngang nas spyod lamathams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur khyer: sgra grags thams cad sngags su sbyangs dran rtog gang shar thugs ye shes su la bzla'o: de ltar rnal 'byer sbyor darngas rjes tshang ba'i sgrub pa mchog labartson pa 'i mi yon tan brgyad dang lan pa ra 'gyur: sri bgegs bdud kyi g.yupa pas rgyal sa ma yā slob ma'i sgo gsum sman pa 'i phyar dab ga bya ba la 'jug pa bum gnyis sgrub cing sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i dbang gi rim

pa 'o sa ma mā dang po rnam rgyas bum pa ni bla med so lnga' bcud kyis gtam da lar bkod la 'ad ltar sgrub oṃ swā bha sogs 8)bye nya shā: pho brang 'bar ba e yi klong: pad zla nyi ma bdudabazhi'i khar dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang : yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: sras bzhi khro bcu yab yum dang : za gsod sgo skyongs bka' sdod bcas: zhal phyag rgyanadang cha lugs rnams ma 'dres rang gsal lhun grub bsgom sgog gis bskul te 'og min nas: ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs bstim snye dzogabadz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri war badz+ra sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya stoḥ a ti pū ho: pra ti tsā ho: slo shrī badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wā ra pukhye dhu pe a lo ke gharnye rde wi bye shabha pañtsa rak+ta bha ling ta kha hi: ྅: mar gad mdog can shes rab yum dang rol: sras lnga khro tshogs bka' sdod pho nya 'gyed rdo rje gzhon nu phrin las phur pa'i lha dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dal la bdag gis bstod: bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa 'phros mdun bskyed bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: thams cad kyi sku'i ba spra'i bu ga kun

ṇ+ḍa tsho nas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa'i nang gang bar bsam: bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyis bzlas pa bya'o mthar mchod stod byas la bum pa'i lha rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig du gyur de nas las bum sgrub pa ni oṃ su bha sogs stong pa'i ngang las las kyi bum pa mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhal med khang: thar ba chen po'i bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad zla nyi ma'i khar :༷ ljang sngon spro bsdus yongs su gyur ba las: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sngo ljang g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon bsdig 'dzub mdzad pa: khro bo'i chas du ma rdzogs par gsal ba'i thugs sgog ( la sngags kyi 'phreng bas g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros: 'phags pa mchod: sems can gyi don mdzad: slar tshur 'dus bum lhar thim bum la'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa'i nang gang bar bsam: bla āX bisne ta krita tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa brgya rtsa brjod mthar sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa ni /: debazhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: phrin las gcig bsdus ngo bo nyid: bgegs rnams ma

lus 'thor mdzad pa'i: bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha 'od du zhu ba las bum chu dag byed yan lag brgyad ldan gyi bdud rtsir gyur: bdag nyid 'dug cing rigs me dor slob ma'i sgo gsum khrusakyis sbyangs tho 'tshams bgegasabasal srung 'khor bsgom bden don bshad la maṇ+ḍal bul de nas sta gon dbang skur ba dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni kyi kun mkhyen ye thegs phung 〈sna can srid pa'i dra ba gcod pa po dpal ldan bla ma brtse bas dgongs sta gon dbang rnams bskur du gsol: lan gsum bla mas lan gnang ba ni e ma 'dir 'tshogs rigs ldan pho mo rnams: 'jin rten chos la skyo ba bskyed: phyi ma'i don sgrub dam chos rtsol: de la dbang gi skal ba mchis: spro ba yod dam 'dir 'tshogs rnams: mos pa med rnams phyir dengs gig de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni kyi: rkang gnyisagatso bo sangs rgyas dang : zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs mchog phyir mi sdog pa la: bdag nyid gus pas skyabs su mchi lan gsum ho byin rlabs mchog stsol bla ma dang : dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam lha: bar chad sel mdzad mkha' 'gro la bdag nyid gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum
