dzaX ho ka dag stong chen chos kyi skur: gdangs gsal 'gags med longs spyod rdzogs phyogs med thugs rje sprul ba'i sku: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi lan gsum de nas smon pa sems bskyed ni ho: 'di ltar nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa'i: pha ma 'a11 ba sems can rnams: ma bsgral bsgral dang ma dza la dadza la: dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god: smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum 'jug sems ni ho: sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang : sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar bdag kyang 'di nas byang chub bar: phyin drug byang sems mchog la gnas lan gsum rigs lnga'i sdoms bzung ni ho: dkyil 'khor lha dang slob dpon dgongs dkon mchog gsum ni mi spang ngo rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang : byang chub sems ni mi spang ngo: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu: theg pa gsum dang chos rnams bshad: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu: 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya: de bzhin rigs kyi dam tshig tu: dkyil 'khor gsum dang 'bral mi byed rtsa ba

yan lag dam tshig bsrung: sor byang sngags kyi sdom la gnas: de phyir brtse bas rjes su zungs: sta gon dbang rnams gnang bar zhu: lan gsum de nas bla ma'i dam chu sbyin pa na slob ma rnams skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpa' snang stong rig pa'i rang mdangs tsam du gsal ba'i spyir bo zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po mgrin par pad+ma la brten pa'i āḥdamar po thugs gar nyi ma la bkod pa'i hūṃ sngon po gsum gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing nas rdor sems ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la bstim mo: ma badz+ra sa twa swā pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: yo badz+ra sa twa sa pā ri wa ra 〉〉 dhu pe a lo ke gharnye nai wi bye shabha ā hūṃ hūṃ mi rtogs ye shes rdo rje sems: dmigs med shes rab yum dang sbyor: thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba skyobs: dam tshig bdag po khyod la bstod: yig brgya lan gsum bzlas la slob bu'i nyams chags bshags slar yang bshags tshig gsol ba ni ho: ka' drin gsum ldan bla ma dang : dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpas dgongs: bdag rmongs dam tshig nyams chags kun: bshags so dag cing

:༷༷ tshangs par stsol: lan gsum bya bla ma'i dri yis thig le slob bu'i gnas gsum du bkod la can āḥhūṃ hū āḥskyid zhes rgyas gdab la byin gyis rlabs nas me tog 'thor ro so shing sbyin pa niḥhūṃ so shing dmar po pad+ma'i cod paṇa can: gsang ba'i rdzas mchog so la regs pa'i mod thogs med nas bsags chags nyams sdig sgrib kun: skyugs sman btung ltar hags gis thon gyur te: lus ni rdul bral shel rgong ltar gyur dmigs tshe badz+ra ha sa ha: dngos grub ma' ma brtags ba ni ho so shing gi cod paṇa lha dang bla ma'i phyogs su bstan na phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin tshe 'di nyid la thob: shar du bstan na rdo rje rigs kyi rigs grub: lho ru rin chen rigs dang : nub tu pad+ma'i rigs dang : byang du las kyi rigs dang :mtshams su sna tshogs rigs dang : dbus su bhurnya bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs grub par 'gyur ro des ni lus kyi dri ma sbyangs bum pa'i dab gi snod ru ngo sa ma mā gnyas pa du zhal gyi las chusbyin pa ni ho dag pa gtsang ma'i snod mchog dung zhal nang: dag byed bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lha tshogs bzhugs slob ma'i lce la bzhags pa'i ngag sgrib sbyangs: gsang sngags

bzlas pa mchog spyod skal ba ldan: las nyon rlung gi 'khru/ ba dag gyur cig: khyed sarba saṃ shā dha na snyi shukhye sarba dalpan a pa na ye swā hā las chu 'thung bas ngag sgrib sbyangs gsang ba gsung dbang sngon 'gro'o sa ma yā de nas srad bu sbyin pa ni hūṃ: rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gyur ba mi mnga' ba'i: dbang bskur byin rlabs srad bu ljang sngon nyid: sgob bu'i yan lag dpung par rgyas gdab pa'i rlung sems 'dzag med dbu ma'i dbyings su bcings bde stong zung 'jug kun dha las su rung: byang chub sems kyi ngang la gnas gyur cig: ma sarba bhurnya me tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa kun du swā hā: lasachu 'thor zhing rgyas gdab bya shesarab dbang gi sngon 'gro'o sa ma mā de nas ku sha sbyin pa ni 〉: rma bya'i mgrin ltar ku sha ljang sngon 'di: ring ba sngas dang thung ba gdan du bya:byang chub lung bstan yid kyis smon pas sgrubs: rten 'brel rtags mchog rmi lam nyid du gsal: 31 badz+ra tik+ṣa hūṃ: zhes brjod la slob dpon gyis sbyin 37 badz+ra tik+ta sirnyi hūṃ: zhes bo da bzhin slob bu'i sor bsnol phyag rgyas len 'dod pa' don la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye: lhag pa'i lha dang bla ma'i thugs rje yis bdag la dge dang mi dge'i ltas thams cad bstan du gsol

dzā ba lan gsum gdab des ni bya chub mchog sgrub ca tshag dang rtsal dab nga sngon 'gro'o sa ma yā rjas rnams slob bu yo sa la 'grims bkra shis brjod cing bsngo smon gdab sta gon lha la mchod 'bul ni oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā rī wa a r+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha ye swā hā: de bzhin du pa rdo shabha'i bar gyis mchod hūṃ hrīḥ mi gnas mi dmigs chos dbyings dag pa las: ye shes rjes chags rdo rje khros pa'i rgyal: dkyil 'khor gsum ldan 'bar ba gar dgus 'khyud 'phrin las phur ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod sta gon gyi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar 'od kyi drwa gur du btegs la: bha ga ṭa ma ye: ya mchod bstod ni oṃ badz+ra pubye d+dha pe sogs shabha āḥ(: / thabs mchog rdo rje srin po'i sku: shes rab rgyas 'debs mkha' la rol: sbyor sgrol 'phrin las ljo bsdu 'gyed: rdo rje phur bar phyag 'tshal bstod: yi ge brgya bas lag chad bska sa gsum pa dngos gzhi' dbang bskur la bdag mdun bum bzlas rig me dor slob ma sgo drung 'tshogs pa la sgo gsum khrus kyis sbya sa byas te tho mtshams gegs bsal srung gur bsgom de nas sgo zhus bya ba na kyi: mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gad rgyang can ye shes khro bo khro mo yis: brnga thabs phyag rgyas sgo

phyes la: lha dang bla ma'i zhal ras ston lan gsum zhu bla mas lan gnang ba ni kye bu khyod ci 'dod gang du 'gro 'di ni myang 'das sgrub pa'i sa 'khor bar rgyab kyi phyogs pa ste khyed cag mi 'dod phyir dengs shig zhes bam ba la slob bus zhu ba ni kyi ho rdo rje 'dzin pa: bdag gis 'khor ba spang ngo: bka' bzhin sgrub: rjes su 'jug go: rjes su sgrub po bla mas bka' gnang ba e ma: 'khor 'das gdam ka rang la rag: srid pa rmi lam lta bu der: zhi ba phyogs ris med par sgrub: de lta bu yi skal ldan na: khyod la tshogs smon las 'phro 'dzoms nang du 'dongs 31ga gnang ba sbyin: bla ma lha yi rjes su zhugs: slob bus phyag dang zhe sa bcas pus btsugs thal sbyar mdun du 'khod bden don bshad la maṇ+ḍas phul de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni kyi chos sku mi 'gyur thugs klong nas: ye shes gsang ba mchog gis dgongs: rdo rje phur bu'i dbang dngos grub: skal ldan bdag la gnang bar zhu: lan gsum zhu bla ma'i bka' stsal ba ni e ma: skal ldan sems kyi bu mchog rnams: gsang sngags 0〈cog sgo dad pa dang : dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig gal gsang ba ma smra gsang sgo sdoms: man

lha ngag bdud rtsi zag ma 'jug: zhes gnyer gtad la skyabs su 'gro ba ni na mo dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : lhag pa'i lha mchog badz+ra ku ma ra: bde stong char 'bebs 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro la byang chub snying bo'i bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum sems bskyed pa na he chos sku mkha' khyab bcing grol mi dmigs kyang glo burarlung sems bag rdul ling tog gis: shes rab mig 'grib ma rig 'gro ba rnams gdod ma'i chos skur sad phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum tshogs bsags ni na ma gang zhig dran pas rang byung ye shes rtogs: bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos btud: chos dbyings nam mkha'i rgyan gyur dga' ston sprin: ga shar rang grol bsal bzhag bral bar 'bul: rnam par rtog gsum rkyen bzhi'i g.yo ba kun: chos nyid dbu ma spros mtha' bral bar bshags: 'khor 'das ma phyed mi phyed snying po'i klong: dag mnyam rjen par bzhugs la rjes yi rangs: dus gsum ka dag rig pa dri bral 'di: bying rmugs rlung sems dben par bzhugs gsol 'debs ngo rang thugs rje'i rang byung rang shar ba: sku

gsum rjen par 'char bas chos 'khor bskul:dge dang mi dge mi g.yo spros pa kun:sems bral blo 'das gnyug ma rjen par bzhag:snang bzhi'i rtsal rdzogs gzhon nu bum sku'i sbubs:nang gsal gnyug ma chos sku'i dpal thob re ga:lan gsum dam tshig 'dzan pa ni kya:kun mkhyen mgon po brtse bas bdag la dgongs:bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma mi spangs brten:bla med don la sgrub pa'i snying po byed:srid pa rdo rjes bskyed dang rdzogs rim sbyangs:tha mal snang zhen dag rdzogs smin par byed:de ltar sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skal ldan la:rdo rje phur ba gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsol lan gsum rjes su dam chu sbyin pa ni e ma ho:rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du:bde ba chen po'i don rtags ldan:gang zhig mngon gsum 'char ba'i phyir:dga' bzhi'i rang bzhin lus la gtug:a my-i ta sirnyi hrīX ñtsa dung khang bhan+ta'i gzhal yas su:zla ba'i rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das:de yi bde ba 'dod mar brjod:thabs mchog bdud rtsi'i don la bskul a phroṃ ta bho dhi tsit+ta sirnyi hrīḥhū:mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u'i 1nga:dwangs la ye shes nang gsal bzhugs:shes

tswakho rab 'char sgo dbye ba'i phyir zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi 'bul: a dṛ ta tsit+ta sirnyi hrīḥ sa: bde mchog sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor bzhugs: bol+la gak+ko mnyam spyor phyir: chags sogs skyen bral bdud rtsi 'bul: a dṛ ta ma hā su kha a la la ho: e ma: 'dir 'tshogs rig pa 'dzin pa rnams gu ru yab yum mnyam sbyor skyems: mi 'bral srog gcig tshom bur bcas: 'og min mkha' la spyod byas phyir dam bsre dza gad bdud rtsi btung: a mṛ ta sirnyi a la la ho slob bu rnams la skyems drangs gral bsros mag dar bkab cing me tog sbyin de nas slob ma lha ru gsal gdab pa ni dmigs med stong pa'i ngang nyid las dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung dbus: pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i khar: slob ma dran rdzogs ku ma ra: mthing nag ri rab phur ba 'dril: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang bcas: gsal stong 'dzin pa bral bar bskyed: de'i thugs gar dga' 'khyil rlang gis mtshan pa can la gser gyi 'khor lo rtsib drag brten cing : srog thur gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba rdo rje dang phur pa 'dzin par bskyed:

/:las 'od zer 'phros te 'og min gyi gnas nas rdo rje phur bu'i lha tshogs spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim mo sbyar spos bdug sha chen bsregs thod rnga 'brol la snyan te hūṃ dza: mi mngon chos dbyingasadabus mtha' bral ba nas: srid pa rdo rje ye shes phur ba'i lha mi gnas mi dmigs spros dang bral mod kyang: gdul bya'i re skong byin dbab phyir: ye shes sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar 'dir ngoms la: srid pa phur bu 'grub pa'i byin phob cig: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bstan pa dang gī la ya yi / du gsol: slob bu'i thugs ga'i ye las rlung g.yos dga' 'khyil drag du bskyod: gser 'khor g.yas su sga ra ra 'khor: ye shes sems dpa' gar bsgyur bro ) migs pa rtse gcig tu gtod cig: ma shrī badz+ra kum ra sarba sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza e a ra li trīng hrīng pho phe : a we sha ya a ā: rol mo drag tu 'drol rig pa gtad med kya ngang la bzhag de' dus su ye shes pa pheb ba'i rtags su lus 'phar g.yo dang mchong rgyug 'bebs brdab pa sogs 'byung ga phaṭa pha dang snyar niḥsa'i glu dbyangs mgur sogs len pa dang

dza me shes pa spro zhing rtags tu dag pa'i snang nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ro oṃ badz+ra ku ma ra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ta hūṃ de nas 'dong pa bsal ba ni ye ma ho bde bsgogags snying po chos sku'i zhal dbyer med rang la lhan skyes kyang: ma rig ling tog dri mas sgrib: ye shes gser gyi thur mas bsal tshe dzña na tsaklu pra we sha ya phaṭa: mthong ba bstan pa ni e ma skal ldan sems gyi bu mchog rnams: dbyings ni chos sku'i rang bzhin la: snang cha 'di dag gzugs sku ste: ma dag bsal bar bya ba ste: dag pa ched du bsgrub bya bral gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang la spyod: 'gags med shar la zhen med rol: rten med shar ba'i chos nyid 'di: sku gsum yin no ma nor cig: a a ā phaṭa: me tog 'bul ba ni /: che rabs sngon nas 'brel ba yis: srid ba phur bu'i dkyil 'khor du: rig ba'i me tog 'bul lo bzhes: rtags kyi mtshan ma bstan du gsol: snyed badz+ra puspe pra ti tsā ho: de nas bumadabang bskur ba na hūṃ hūṃ: ngang nyid chos dbyings dbus mtha' med pa nas: srid pa phur bu ye shes gsang ba'i dal: thugs dam bskul lo mdzad pa'i phrin las stsol: zag med ye

shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun dbab nas skal ldan lus kyi sdig sgrib bag chags bkru: ngag rlung mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i g.yo ba dag: sems kyi 'khrul rtogs ban bun mkha' lagator zag med ye shes bum pas dbang bskur ro: snang stong bskyed rim bsgom la mnga' brnyes shog: tshe bhud+ngha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: / badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉: swā rat+na kā ya abhi ྅sdom swā: e pad+ma kā ya a bhi ྅sdom e: ha garma kwa ya a bhi shing ha: rgo badz+ra ki li ki la ya: e pad+ma ki li gi la ya hūṃ bhurnya ki li ki la ya: kā ya a snyi ྅sdom sa: zhes bum chu lanagasum myang du gzhug 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la srid pa phur bu'i bum dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs: dam tshig nyams chags dag snang stong bskyed rim bsgomanus pa'i skal ba mchog dang ldan par gyur cig: bhasto bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba ni /: bhasto zlum po chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam zag med bdud rtsi byang chub sems bcud 'byil: ā li ku li sngags kyi 'od zer 'phro: bla ma yam yub mnyam par spror ba'i skyems: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa dang rjang dang ngag gi sprib pa sbrangs: bde dang

dzā tsho gsal ba mi rtog ye shes 'char grags stong chos kyi 'khor los gdul bya'i khams ma lus sbyangs smin grub pa mthar phyin shog: tshe pañtsa a dṛ ta a la la ho: wak+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: bdud rtsa lan gsum myang du gzhugs 'o skal ldan rigasakyi bu rnams la gsung 'gags med bhan+ta bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas: rtsa rlung ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs:bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur: gsung chos kyi 'khor los gdul bya'i khams bsam mtha' yas par gang la gang 'dul gyi don bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'byung bar shog cig: de nas sgrub pa'i gtor mas dab bskur ba ni sa: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: mthing nag gru gsum e yi klong dkyil nas: rdo rje gzhon nu sras 'khor bcas pa yang : srid pa phur bu'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs la: thogs med mkha' la bsgrod pa'i stobs shugs dang : rgya mtshor mi 'ching 'dzul 'jug nus mthu dang : 'byung khams zab pa'i gter rnams mthong ba dang : gnas yul mkha' 'gror bde stong spyod pa dang : dpag med tshe dang ye shes 'byer rgyas shing: rnam mang phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang :

skal ldan bu mchog rnams la stsal du gsol: lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol ba dang : ki la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: sde brgyad dreg pa zil gyis gnon gyur cig o a la la ho: bṛ badz+ra ku ma ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa /: gtor ma slob bu' gnas gsum du gas 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: dpal gyi gtor chen ye shes 'bar ba'i dbang bskur bas: lus lha ru smin: ngag gsung du dag: sems ye shes su smin: mthu nam mkha' dang mnyam: stobs kyis sde brgyad dregs pa zil gyis gnon cing mthong thos mngon gsum du 'byung ba'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas sras phur gyi dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : gī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: hūṃ: dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha: 'phrin las mur mdzad dpal chen po'i: sras mchog badz+ra ki la ya: mthing nag utal kha dog 'chang: dbu la rigs lnga thugs sgog hūṃ: zhing bcu 'dzin cing sgol mtshon gzir: dbal

dzikho gyis ngan song skye sgo 'gogs: thog med sgrod pa'i gshogs rtsal ldan: phur ni chos kyi dbyings nyid las pa ni rig pa ye shes sku: sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i phonya 'tshubs: 'phrin las yongs 'dus sras mchog gi: sku gsung thugs dbang bu la sbyin lus ngag yid gsum smin pa dang : dug gsum gdon tshogs 'dul nus shing : khamagasum 'khor ba chos skur bsre: ki la ya yi dbang thob shog: slo badz+ra ki li ki la ya: dza hūṃ baṃ ho ka haṃ ka ye dza ye bhi dza ye a tsi te a pa ra tsi te: ma ra sa na pra marta na ye: sarbabhisnye baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: kārma a snyi ṣiñtsa phaṭa: phur sgrom slob bu'i gnas gsum du gatshog 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la sras mchog thogs med mthu ldan rtsal gyi dbar bskur bas: nyonamongs ba'i 'khrul rtogs thad gar chod cing phung po lnga'i nyes pa las grol: ye shes lnga dang sku lnga'i dgongs don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon du gyur te: rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba rnamasabasgral 'dren byed nus pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs dbang ni hūṃ hṝḥ chos sku mi 'gyur e yi klong dkyil nas: srid pa phur bu'i dbang

mchog bu la stsol: bde stong spros dang bral ba'i klong dkyil nas: rdzogs rim phur bu'i dbang mchog bu la stsol: stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i pho brang nas: byang bu'i dbang mchog bu la stsol: rig stong spros dang bral ba'i gzhal yas nas: don dam phur bu'i dbang mchog bu la stsol: skye 'chi bar do'i tha snyad rnam dag nas:shes yon tan mngon gyur shog tshe badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ wāk+ka a bhiṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa trīX gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉: slobam ra'i gzugs bzhag mgrin par sgrub yig bkod thugs shar sgrub phur gtug las phur phyogs bcur 'dril du gzhugs/'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gakyi dbang mchog bskur bas: che btsan dpal chen po dang mnyam: gsang sngags kyi grub pa mchog dang ldan : sbyor sgrol la dgongs pa gtad pa tsam gyis mngon spyo 'phrin las rab 'byams lhun gyi grub ba'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: bsgral dbang ni hū dza: gru gsum mning nag e yi klong dkyil du: ma tram̐ rū tra'i gzugs

dzaX pa la: zhing bcu tshangs rnams dkon mchog bden mthus bkugs: tshad med rnam bzhi'i phyag rgyas 'chor med bcings: gzas po yul 'di skal shāl gtad: skyon du ma blta thugs rje thabs kyis zungs: lcags sam drag po' phur pa'i dbal 'di gtod: lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa'i rdzongs chen zungs: rlung semathabargal rig stong bsgom par zhugs: snying rje stong pa 'i spyod pas sgog 'phrog nas: bsad bcad mnan gzir las rnams ma yin par: phung por ye shes lnga yi rgyas btabarnam shes chos dbyings yum gyi mkha' la bsre: 'tshang ba lnga ldan 'byung ba'i dbang thob shog: sa badz+ra kai li gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa: zhes che ba bskyed drags sngags so lnga brngo da bzhin du phur 'chams byas la bsgral 'dren lan gsum du bya bar gzhug go snyed sarbakārma dus hūṃ phaṭa: a spra ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ: kārma a bhi ༷༷/ s+t+waṃ: 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyed rnams 'chen po'i drag po'i bsgral dbang bskur bas: gdab phur 'ben gsum gyi grub pa mngon du gyur te chos can gyi zag pa dbu mar zad nas: chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab

shes la longs spyod par gyur cig: de nas lhun gyis grub pa'i me dab ni hūṃ hṝ: masang nag 'bar ba e yi klong dkyil nas: dkyil 'khor gsum ldan rdo rje phur ba'i lha: 'alhun gyis grub pa'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: rjes su 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo yis: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i 'phrin las dang : tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor rjapa'i sgo: lha 'dre mi gsum mos bzhi dbang sdud gter: dgra bgegs bdud 'joms drag po mngon spyod kyi: las bzhi lhun grub ye shes me yi dbang : skal ldan rigamachog rnams la sbyin bdag gzhan don du 'bar ba'i las la brtson: thogs med 'gro phan 'grub pa'i mthu ldan shog: a/ badz+ra ku ma ra sarba sa pā ri wā ra shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa ya phaṭa swā hā: kārma a snyi ḍiñtsa hūṃ me ho dang sgang gzar slob bu'i phyag tu gtad: 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la dpal chen po'i drag po'i me dbang bskur bas mi mthun paḍi thams cad zhi ba dang : legs tshogs dpal dang 'byor ba'i dngos po rab tu rgyas te: dregs pa che btsan thams cad kyi sgog la mnga' dbang 'byor nas log rtog ba

tswa kho rnams mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod nus pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: tshe rdzas rnams gto la dbang skur ba ni hū hrīḥ skye med chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa nas: sgyu 'phrul rol mdzad ye shes phur ba'i lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs mthu bskyed pa'i: dam rdzas tshe zan zag med bha lirnyi : dza gad skyems mchog bde ba bskyed pa'i rdzas: tshe yi 'brang rgyas 'dod lnga'i dga' ston gter bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis bkang bas gtam: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol ba dang : rdo rje gzhon nu'i yon tan mchog thob shog ma badz+ra ki li gī la ya tshe sbyo a yu dzñā na kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: wāk+ka a snyi ṣiñtsa ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ dzagad a snyi shiX/ cha: ra sa bha lirnyi a bhi shi mi hrīḥ slob bu rnams la tshe rdzas thams cad myang du gzhugs 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la tshe rdzas dang dza gad bha ling ta a dṛ tas dbang bskur bas: lus bkrag mdangs dang ldan: sha rgyas gnyer ma dwangs: ngag la 'gags sdud dang bral bar rdo rje'i gsung la dbang bsgyur: yid kyi rlung sems 'khrul ba'i sbun pa dag:

rig pa ye shes kyi gter la dbang 'byor: 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed nus pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: mtha' rten gam cing dam tshag 'bog dbang yon sgo gsum ltos med 'bul dge rtsa mkha' khyab 'gro la bsngo thabs des dngos grub 'bad med thob don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur sa ma yu de nas sreg blugs 'bul ba la gzhung ltar rdzas rnams legs par bsags sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangasabasgyur spel las bzhi'i shing gis hom brtsigs la 'bar me thod chings rlung yab dang med dar bang kheb thams cad bsags dang po dam tshig 'dzan pa ni 81 ma hā badz+ra (ཿ zhes rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshag dang hūṃ dzñā na tiṣ+ṭa rlu: zhes dril bu gsung gi dam tshag dang skyed sarba ta tha ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga na kwa ya wak+ka tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: zhes bde ba chen po'i don la gnas shing 'byud rgya bya ba sku yi dam tshag 'dzin pa'o bsregs rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni hūm̐ bhisne ta krita hūṃ phaṭa las mthun snod du me yig las: sreg rdzas zag med bdud rtsir spel: brin las rdo rje phur pa'i dal: dgyes pa bskyed pa'i sprin du gyur oṃ āX: swā hā rluX leḥme paṃḥrtaḥ shirnye puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: rdzas regs bya zhing byin gyis rlabs de nas me sbar ba na (ཿ mthing gsal gti mug 'joms pa'i me: chos dbyings ye

dza shes rtsal chen 'bar las nyon bag chags bud shing bsreg:mtshan mar 'dzin pa chos skur sbyangs:hūṃ bhudha ḍak+ki ni rluḥbadz+ra dz+wa la ram̐:de nas rlung g.yab na ྅:g.yo ba dam chig sgrol ma' mkha':bya ba lhun gyis grub pa'i rlung:'bar ba'i 'phrin las gzhan don bskul:gdug pa'i me dbal zhi gyur cig hūṃ badz+ra ra ti ye ku ru phyo phyo swā hā:de nas thab khang bskyed pa ni hūṃ mi dmigs ka dag stong ba'i ngang nyid las:mthing nag chos dbyings ye shes me klong du sgro las dur khrod thod mkhar rngams pa'i dbus:be+eḍūr mdog can hūṃ yig zhu ba las rin chen pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i khar 'bar ba'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu ni:mthing nag be+eḍūr+ya yi gzi byin 'khyugs:zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gcigs:ha ha hūṃ phaṭa gad rgyang 'brug ltar sgrogs:zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs bsgrad:rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga kha ṭ+wāṃ me:ri rab phur pa dgra dang bgegs la 'dril:dur khrod dpa' chas dpa' ba'i rtags su klabs:gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs 'jigs rung srin po'i gzugs:sna la khro bcu za gsod khra thabs

dang: sgo skyong bse lcags dung gi skyes bu dang : shwa na ma bzhi re ti bse mo bzhi: gnas lngar ki la rigs lnga'i 'du 'phro 'gyed thugs srog 'od kyis 'og min gnas mchog nas: ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gnyis med bstims sbos bsreg rol mo snyan pa' dbyangs dang bcas me dar g.yab bzhin 'di ltar gyer bar bya hū hrīḥ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mi gnas ye shes rdo rje gzhon nu ni: 'bar ba'i gar mdzad khro tshogs sprul bar bcas: ye shes sgyu mar rol ba'i gar ngoms la: gsang ba'i gnas 'dir sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: 31 badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bzhugs gsol ni hū khro rgyal 'bar ba 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bstan pa dang : ki la ya yi dngos grub rtsol ba'i phyir: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par bzhugs sa ma ya dzaX hūṃ baṃ ho: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni na mo: srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba dang : nga rgyal zhen pa ma lus gzhom pa'i phyir: rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas

8 kho la rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis phyag bgyi'o: a ti byu ho: pra ti dza ho: mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ rgyal ba'i dkyil gsar rdo rje gzhon nu la: phyi nang gsangaba'i mchod tshogs 'bul ba ni: dbang lnga'i me tog tshil gsur bdug pa skros: zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang : sha rus zhal zas rkang gi gling bu dang : gzugs sgra driro regs bya chos la sogs: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgol mchod pa'i mchog gus pas 'bul lo dgyes pa chen pos bzhes: 'phrin las lhun gyi grub pa'i dngos grub stsol : sa badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra pus ju pe a lo ke gharnye nai wi bye shabha pra tits+tsha swā hā: a badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra rū pa shabha ghadhe ra sa sparnye dharma pra tits+tsha swā hā cha dṛ badz+ra ku ma ra sapā ri wa ra ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta rak+ta bha lidha sta na ga ṇa bho dhi tsit+ta khā hi: de nas byon skyems 'bul ba ni (ཿ rtsi bcud snyi po 'bru yi mar zag med bdud rtsi skyems kyi mchog: srid paphur bu dgyes phyir 'bul: dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa a dṛ ta kha hi nyer gcig bsdo da la byon skyems 'bul de nas sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni ṭ+wāṃ dhiḥ lcags sam

drag po'i snod mchog yangs pa phu sreg rdzas zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun: srid pa thal 'byin rdo rje phur bar 'bul: 'gro ba'i bsod nams tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes: rtsa sngags mthar sto dhi bre k+ta ye shirnye puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gas yam shang phul sham ni phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar a dṛ ta khā himi rnye puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gis mar phul sham ni brin las rnam bzhi lhun gyi grub par gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra sidha ye shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gis yung dkar phul sham na phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par sogs cig: rtsa sngags mthar skyod sarba saṃ bha dhe shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gas zas mchog phul sham na phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyi grub par gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar tshe badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye shirnyipuṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: ཿ nyer gcig gis 'bras phulaḥsham ni phrin las/sogs rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra bhe ga ye shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcag gas nas bul sham ni phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra

khye1 bhi dza ye shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā nyer gcig gis so ba phul sham ni phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra gasma ri shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gis gus phul sham ni phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe shirnye puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gis dur wa phul sham ni phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ a bra ti ha ta badz+ra ye shirnye puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gis ku sha phul sham ni:phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ ma hā bha la ye shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gis sran ma phul sham mi phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ ga ga ni ga ga ni bri lo ki te shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gis shis tog phul sham ni phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par gyur cig 'dod gsol ni hūṃ trīX ye shes phur ba'i lha tshogs la: sreg blugs mchod pa 'bul ba'i mthus: bdag cag sgrub mchog 'khor bcas la: yas kyi bdud g.yos mas sri ldang

rkyen snang 'jigs tshogs zhi ba dang : tshe dpal 'byor drug ye shes dang : yon tan phyogs med rgyas pa'i las lha 'dre mi gsum dbang 'dus shing: bde stong nyams rtogs rtsal chen 'bar: gnod byed dgra bdud dam sri sogs: rgol ba thams cad tshar bcad nas: 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub cing: gī la ya yi mthu thob thegag: tshe āḥ/ swā hā ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: rdzas 'dus phul la hū gzi brjid 'bar ba me yi lha: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor du: dam rdzas sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod:rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba pu dza kha hi shin rta puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra yā phaṭaḥ swā hā gzhu na med pa kha 'phang yan mchanaḥ o āḥhūṃ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la yas kyi bdud g.yos pa dang : mas kyi sri ldang ba pha tshan gyi rgyab 'dre nye ba'i bshol po lo gegs zla gegs: king gang dang gshed bzhi bdun zur dang rbod gtong rbad 'dre ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya ku ru ye swā hā: ces brjod la yungs dkar thab du 'thor bstod pa ni hā: rdo rje gzhon nu mar gad mdog 'dzin cing sri bdud zil gnon ri rab phur ba

:| 'dril 'khor lo rgyas 'debs khro tshogs sprul bar bcas: 'phrin las phur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: skabs 'dir spro na gsol mchod bskang tshogs bya de nas gtang rag 'bul ba ni hūṃ: dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: mdzes sdug 'dod yon lha mos gar dang bcas: srid pa phur ba'i dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul bdag gzhan bsod nams tshogs rdzogs slad du bzhes sa badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wā ra pur+sha rnyi pe a lo ke gharnye nai wit+ya shabha rū pa shasta gharnye ra sa spar she dharma mahā pañtsa a dṛ ta rak+ta bha lirnyi sta na gha na bho dhi cit+ta kha 1: 'brog 'bra phul la hūṃ: rtsi bcud snying po 'bru yi mar: bzang drug sbyar ba'i a mṛ ta: phur pa'i lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul bzhes la phrin las rnams bzhi sgrub rtsa sngags mthar 31 ra sa kha tweḥ nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig reg bya phul la hūṃ hrīḥ sna tshogs phye ma'i 'phur ma can: lnga rdzas dar gyi regs bya 'di: ye shes phur pa'i lnga la 'bul: 'phrin las lhan gyis grab phyir bzhes: rtsa sngags mthar ma badz+ra wari ye su ha: tshe dang bsod

nams dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: de nas dkar gsum mngar gsum me tog rnams phul la hū hrīḥ dam rdzas gtsang ma dkar mngar bcud: kha tog mdangs 'bar ka ma la: ye shes phur ba'i lha la 'bul 'phrin las lhun gyis grub phyir bzhes: rtsa sngags mthar skyid badz+ra mā le puṣ+ṭa ye ka ma la khā hi kham gsum srid gsum 'dod rgu'i dpal yon thams cad dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: de nas ma dug khrag gsum phul la hū hrīḥ gsar ba'i rtsa ba rten 'brel khrag: nyong mongs gnas stong dug dang mtshe ye shes phur pa'i lha la 'bul: phrin las lhun gyis grub phyir bzhes: rtsa sngags mthar ma hā rak+ta rme sha tsa dur mu kha khā hi: bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod cing rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas dngos grub zhu ba ni (: mi gnas mi dmigs chos dbyings dag pa las ye shes rjes su chags pa'i he ru gas thun mongs grub brgyad mchog gi dngos grub rnams: skal ldan sgrab pa po la dus 'dir stsol rtsa sngags mthar sirnyi pha la a la la ho: de nas gshegs skyems bshos nag

lho sngo 'bul ba ni oṃ āḥhūṃ: lcags sam drag po'i snod nang du: gtor ma zag med bdud rtsir gyur: ma āḥhūṃ: thugs rje che ldan drag po'i lha tshogs la: gnag lci ba chu dug sbyor bshos chen po: lcags phye zangs phye til yungs bsres pa 'di: ye shes khro bo chen po dgyes phyir 'bul: gtang rag mchod pa bzhes la dgra bdud sgrol: rnam mang 'brin las lhun gyis grub mdzod cig: rtsa sngags mthar ma hā bha ling ta khā hi: nyer gcig gas phul bstod pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ mthing nag e yi klong dkyil nas: be+eḍūr gos can phur ba 'dril bdud dang dam sri 'byung po'i gshed: gī la ya la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol zhu ba ni ho: ye shesame yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: 'bar ba'i dam tshig mchog la dgongs spyod pa'i: khro rgyal rdo rje gzhon nu'i la tshogs dgongs: bdag rmongs 'khrul ba'i nongs pa gang song bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya snyi shukhye ā: yag rgya lan gsum bzlas la lhag chad khabaskangs bsngo smon ni ho: ye shes khro bo rol ba'i dkyil 'khor du: las bzhi lhun grub sreg byugs phul ba'i dges: nam mkha'i mtha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus kun: 'og min me ri

'bar bar byang chub shog: lan gsum bsdu rim ni hūṃ hrī las bzhi lhun gyis grub ba'i me 1nga du:rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs byon pa legs:da ni mdzad pa 'phrin las lhun grub ba'i:rang bzhin 'od gsal bde ba chen por rlu:ye shes pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs dam tshig pa rang gi thugs gar bsdu'o:wag ma cha gnyas su byas la oṃ u tsi ṭa bha ling ta kha 1:rdzas thab khung du gtor oṃ u ci ṭa bha ling ta bha k+ta bhe swā hā:thab kyi phya rol du dor sbyin bsreg za ba' gdon rnams 'joms par gyur:shis brjod ni na mo:ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os gnas: lung rtogs dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i lam:'phags tshogs dge 'dun skye rgu yong kyi skyabs dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bkra shis re ga:byin rlabs char 'bebs dgongs brda snyan rgyud rje dngos grub sprin 'khrigs sgrub rgyud yi dam lha bde stong char 'bebs dbyings gsum ḍak+ki'i sprin: skyabs mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi bkra shis re ga:byin rlabs mkha' la chos sku'i 'od gsal 'bar:'gags med dwangs mtshor gzugs sku'i rta bdun tshes:rtsol med mtha' klas sprul sku'i zer stong

shāka dngar sku gsum ye shes gsang rdzogs bkra shis shog: lta ba yas 'bebs don dam mkha' ltar dag: spyod pa mas 'dzegs kun rdzob rgyu 'bras zhib: zung 'jug bsgom pas gzung 'dzin 'ching rgya grol: theg mchog a ti snying po'i bkra shis shog: mi mthun 'jigs pa'i phyogs rnams zhi ba dang : tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas lha 'dre mi gsum mos bzhi dbang du 'dus: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog dge mtshan dpal gyi me tog char du bsnyil: phyogs las rnam parargyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs nyong mongs g.yul ngo 'joms pa'i ru mtshon ste: kun nas rnam par dge ba'i bkra shis 37ga: nyin yang dge bcu'i bkra shis ta la la: mtshan yang 'od gsal kha sbyor kyi li li: rtags par dge mtshan phywa g.yang me re re: rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis 31ga: de ltar sreg blug phul ba yas 'phran las rnam bzha lhun gyis grub gdul dka' nyon mo sa g.yul las rgyal don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za sa ma yā sgrub pa las kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug sgo sngon 'gro 'ad ru gab dang po skyabs sems sgom pa ni na mo drin chen bla ma rgyal ba

dgongs rgyud dang :brda snyan shog ser bka' lung man ngag mdzod ka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang la khyed shes dad pa'i snying nas skyabs su mchi mthing nag 'barab e yi klong dkyil nas:dpal chen mngon rdzogs rdo rje gzhon nu dang :sbyor ba'i yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma gtso mchog rtsa ba'i lha la skyabs su mchi gru gsumamathing nag rū tra bsnol ba'i khar:thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra ki la ya:spyor sgrol mdzad pa'i pho nya glog ltar 'khyugs:gdul dka' 'dul mdzad lha la skyabs su mchi:phyogs bcur phyogs skyong pho mo bsnol ba'i khar bdud 'dul khro bcu yab yum za gsod bcas:sbyor sgrol mdzad pa'i 'phrin las glog ltar 'khyugs:phyogs bcu khro bo'i dal la skyabs su mchi dkyil 'khor bar khyams 'khor lo'i rtsib steng su shwa na bdag nyid sa bdag re ma ti bse lcags dung sogs dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad:phur ba'i srung ma rnamasal skyabs su mchi:lan gsum he nam mkha'i mtha' khyab 'gro ba dmus masang rnams rang ngo ma shes 'khrul bas las rjes 'brang:rtag par dug lngas myos pa snying rje'i yul

dzaX byang chub sa la 'god phyir sems bskyed do:lan gsum rjes su tshogs bsags ni na mo gang sku dran pas tha mal snang zhen 'gags:gsung gsang thos pas gzung 'dzin 'chings rgya grol dran pa'i mod la srid zhi'i 'jigs 'phrog pa'i:bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gtug:bdag lus zhing gi rdul snyed rab sprul te:mal lnga sar phab gus phyag zhe sa bcas:tshogs zhing rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i dru kun nyon 'khrul ba sangs phyir phyag bgyi'o:mthong bas yid skong blta na sdug pa'i dpal phyi nang gsang mchod rdo rje'i rig mar bcas:bdag gis bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs phyir 'bul:dri bral ye shes mkha' ltar dag pas bzhes:ma rig rtog gsum rkyen bzhi'i cho 'phrul las:tshogs yul mtshan ma gdos por bzung ba'i nongs sgo gsum dri ma dam tshigs chags nyams kun mi 'chab gnong 'gyod stobs bzhi tshangs pas bshags phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcas:so skyes nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyi:rnam dkar mdzad pa 'phrin las rab 'byams la:dga' ba

chen pos rjes su yi rang ngo gdul bya'i khams ni tshad med de snyed du gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa 'gags med par kun 'byung dka' thub dbang bsgyur theg pa yi chos kyi 'khor lo nub med bskor bar bskul: stong gsum mi mjed 'jin rten khams rnams su: sangs rgyas byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs: mdzad 'phrin spel khyab mya ngan 'da' bzhed kun: mi 'da' rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs su gsolaḥ 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar bsags pa yi: zag dang zag med dge tshogs gcig bsdus te: 'khor gsum yongs dag chos sku'i dgongs par bsngo: sku dang ye shes chen por smin grol shog: maphyo ni oṃ āḥhūṃ: zhing khams chen po stong gsum mi mjed khyon: lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i sprin: 'dod yon lha mo'i dga' ston spro ba 'di: sprul sku thub dbang rgyal ba'i drung du 'bul: ma āḥs: bkod pa chen po lnga dang ldan pa'i dal: 'og min rnam mdzes stug po bkod pa'i zhing: rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i dga' ston 'phro ba 'di: longs spyod rdzogs sku gangs can mtsho la 'bul ma āḥhūṃ chos dbyings klong yangs yum gyi da la ru

8kho bde gsal mi rtog rig pa ye shes ngang: gang shar rang grol rgyan rdzogs marnyal 'di: chos sku khyab brdal kun bza 1nga du 'bul: 37 āḥ/ mnyes byed bye nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'di: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul: sku gsum mngon gyur srid zhi'i char gtogs pa'i: nam mkhar mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol b.raregag tre gu ru rat+na marnyal pū dza me gha sa mu tra spra ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥshāḥ dza hū be ho: tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rgyud sbyang zhing dag par bsam mo: de nas dkaragator 'bul ba ni dkar skyems bshams phral byan gyis brlabs ba sna tsho/ swā bha wa sogs kyi sbyangs la spyo las rin nge che'i bye da du tram̐ las gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gadza ma las dza/ba pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: o ā sa: sa bri shrī wi dhe wi lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza: tshe pri shrī wi dhe wi lo ka pa la sa pā ri wa ra e dam bha lirnya kha kha kha tīkha hi lan gsum pus dru pe a lo ke ghan+de je wi t+ya shabha pra ti ts+tsha a hūṃ ༷ hūṃ stong gsum stong gi 'jin rten la: dbang mdzad dreg pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sngon gyi dam mnos ji bzhin

du tha tshig bsgrag nas 'bod do byon: byams brtse'i dad dang gus pas gson: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub mchog rnams dam chos byang chub sgrub pa la: nyer 'che'i bar chadami 'byung zhing: 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag gyis: sa gzhi rin che gnang ba dang : dngos grub 'byung ba'i bskul ma gyis: gtsang sbyar dza gad gser skyems dang : 'dod yonagator ma 'di bzhes la: ko long ru nga mi mdzad par: gnas mgron lta bu'i dam tshig gis 'brin las rab 'byams grub mdzod cig: chos sbyin bya gtor skyems gtsang sar mchod denas bgegs gtor byin rlabs ni oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya skṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: bdag nyid dbang chen rta mgrin du gsal la: spyo las rin po che'i snod du oṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsir gyur o āḥ(: hūṃ: phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcu dang sa gsum la: dbang mdzad bgegs rgyal bi na ya ga'i gtso'i: stong phrag brgyad cu nyi khri chig stong dang : gdon chen bco lnga 'phrog ma ma bu'i sde: gnyug gnas glo bur lhag pa'i 'byung po rnams: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bka' byung gis: skad cig yud tsam gcig gis 'dir 'dus la

: |tsho bdag gis bsgo bas bka' bsgrub dam mnos shig: cha badz+ra ṭā ki ra dza hūṃ dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho: badz+ra e gu sha dza: bgegs dang log 'dren len chags 'byung po thams cad 'dus par bsam: bden brjod ni na mo: drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul phur ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dabhe : ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang : rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : rnal 'byor ba bdag gi lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa chen po'i mthus: sa yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag dang brgyud par bcas pas phun tshogs lnga yis gzhi bzungs: bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi yis gzhur bsrings 'bras bu rig 'dzin gyi sa sgrub par byed pa la tho 'tshams par byed pa'i

'byung po gnyis 'dzin can: nam mkha' la rgyu ba bar snang la gnas pa: sa gzhi la brten pa: sa 'og tu 'dug pa: skyabs grib la gab pa 'byung ba la dbang za ba thams cadaskad cig yud tsam du lan chags 'jal ba'i mgron du 'dus shig: ṭak+ki ra dza hūm̐ dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho: tshe sarba snyisne sa pā ri wa ra e dam bha h+la ta kha kha khā hi khā twe: lan gsum a pabye pukhye dhu pe a lo ke gharnye nai wi t+ya shabha a hūṃ swā hā: hū: nyon cig bgegs bdud dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs: tshe rabs lan chags 'jal ba'i mgron du 'dus: ma chags mi gas mi rmongs ngang gnas bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' la nyan par gyis brngan du gtor skyu chang bu mar me dang : zhal zas 'bras chan sha chang la phug bcas: 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas su sngon gyi lan chags thams cad byang bar gyis: 'phral du bu lon mang po sod zin pas: tshe sgog dkyil 'khor mdangs la ma 'tshe bar:rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar phyir dengs shig: gal te bka' la mi nyan 'tshe byed na: pad+ma dbang chen 'khros ba'i nga rgyal gyis: bgegs khyod phung po rdo rje mtshon chas gtub: mar

sho kho dang yungs dkar mer bsreg ci bzhin tshag ming gi lhag mar byed pa lta ci smos: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: sarba bhu ta ga1bzhis sprad gzhu sa ltar bka' bsgo bden brjod bya thun gyis brab nas bgegs mtshams bcad sru 'khor la sogs gzhung lta bya spro na byin chen 'di lta ste sha chen dud btang sbyar sbos bdug rtogasasgrogasaḥ snyan pa 'i dbya sa kyis 'di skad rdo bla ma ṛg 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad sngon gyi dam tshig bzang po rjes su dran nas rdo rje phur ba'i lha tshogs kyi phyabal mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur: sa badz+ra sa ma ya dza badz+ra sa ma ya sto: hū dza dbus phyogs mning nag e klong nas bcom ldan rdo rje yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mas: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig: dkyil 'khor gru chad rtsibs steng nas: khro rgyal sras mchog ki la ya: bdud mched bzhi yis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig dkyil 'khor khyams kyi rtsibs steng nas dpal chen khro bo rol ba'i sras: mthu chen nyi shu rtsa gcig gis:

'di la byin phob cig: phyogs bcu 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas ye shes khro bo khro mo dang : za gsod las mdzad nyi shu yis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig: phyi 'khyamasaganas la dbang mdzad pa'i: shwa na sa bdag bdag nyid ma: bse lcags dung gi skyes bu yis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig: dkyir 'khor phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi nas: pushud gang ga srin bya khra legs nyes stangs 'dzin khyed rnams kyis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams byin gyis rlabs mar me gsal ba'i mdangasabaskyed cig skal ldan bu la dbang bzhi bskur: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin phob cig rtags mtshan bzang po bstan pa dang : gī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: ma badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: a we sha ya a ā: byin phebs pa'i brtul zhugs ga spyod pa du mas sgo nas drod rtags thob par bya'o sa ma yā skabs su gsol ba 'debs pa ni tshan āX hūṃ 'o ga min dzadas dbyings spros mtha' bral ba nas: dpal ldan kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs: dgongs rgyud rtogs pa 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs: rang bzhin 'od gsal phyogs

86 med pho brang nas:rig 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs: brda rgyud 'od gsal 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs :phyogs med kun khyab sprul sku'i zhing khams nas: dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs:snyan rgyud drod tshad 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs :o rgyan pho brang thod cog dgu ldan nas: rgyal po in+t+ra sto dhi la gsol ba 'debs:gsang sngags zab don rtogs par byin gyis rlobs:dur khrod dga' byed tshal gyi pho brang nas rig 'dzin ro langs bde ba la gsol ba 'debs brtul shugs grub mchog 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs:mchod rten chen po bde byed brtsegs pa nas:rig 'dzin pra bha hasti la gsol ba 'debs:mngon spyod 'brin las grub par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo nas rig 'dzin mi yi thod pa can la gsol ba 'debs:dregs pa bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs: gnam mtsho sngags kyi bsgrub gnas chen po ru mkhar chen 'dre 'dul mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs:rlung sems rang dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs:sgreg kyi yangs rjongs brag gi

nga nas: lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: thar 'byin phur ba 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lho brag gnam skas can gyi rgya bkrol ba: rig t+na gling pa la gsol ba 'debs: thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs: gar bzhugs ma nges phun tshogs gzhal yas su: rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje la / 'debs: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs: brgyud 'debs thugs rje'i zil las khol du byung ba'o mchanaḥ spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng nas: drin chen rtsa ba'i gsol ba 'debs: snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: mi med dben khrod dam pa'i sgrub gnas su: bya btang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs nges 'byung bzang pos rgyud bskul nas 'di snang gdung zhen chod par byin gyis rlobs 'jin rten chos brgyad bya ba ro snyoms nas: dgra gnyen chags sdang grol bar byin gyis nyin mtshan sgrub la gzhol ba'i ting 'dzin gyis 'chi kha blo bde 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs bar do drug gi nyams len gdengs thob nas sku gsum lhun grub 'byung

dzaXtsho bar byin gyis rlobs: de ltar gsol ba 'debs nus na mos gus rgyud bskul byin rlabs 'jug tshe dang chos kyi bar chad sel don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur sa ma yu i i sman mdza' mos gar byed ldems se ldem sgra grul bum rgyang glu 'di skad gyer sems dga' ba'i me long gsal bar byed 'ja' ri mo'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug go skad shar gser khri ser po'i yang steng nas gser gaṇ+ḍa sgrogs pa dbang po' mang chos thub bstan rin chen sgron me 'dzin srog mi 'gyur kwa ba phur nag yin ma mkha' 'gro'i lcags kyur grangs bskul na bu de la pha phog skal ba sprod lho dngul khri dkar po'i gdan steng nas sku mi 'gyur dung gi zla ba tshes bdud rgya 'dres ro smad mas grab btabs sprel dmar po'i cod paṇa 'dzug pa'i dus ma mkha' 'gros bsu ba 'byung na thang de'i srog gi ka ba phur nag yin nub zangs bra dmar po' gdan steng na shar rma bya dmar po sngags kyi zlos bdud rgya 'dre'i mche ba'i phrag na gnas steng g.yar sngon ngad kyi ma 'khrud gong lha phur nag 'phrad na rten 'brel che ba gang snga ma byas bdud kyis gcod byang g.yu khri sngon po' gdan steng na g.yu'i mchod sdong ka la yakru'i zol che'i ldon shing lho ru yo bar 'dug sems dar dkar yang mo'i rlung gis spyod bdud dam ma'i bar chad ma byas par lha phur nag 'phrad pas phan bde ba phyogs nges med lcags kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzug bdud dam sri' mgo la

bro zhig brdung yang shar lho gser kyi gzhong pa'i nang srog gtsang ma gser kyi thag pa can mgon me tri'i sprul ba nirma ka rkyen rlung nag 'tshubs mas ma bskul bar lha phur nag bsnyen sgrub yul der dge mtsho sngon po 'a da rlangs dum chad 'gro yang lho nub pad+ma'i yol ko'i nang lcags ma zan bon kya nirma ka grogs dam sel rkyen gyis ma 'phrog par lha phur nag 'di 'phrad sku tshe brten yul de ru bde skyid bsil khang sbyin yang nub byang lcags mo' ba gam steng khyi dom bu' gdan khar 'phags pa yi khong 'gro 'dul lu hi dz+wa ki'i tshul smin mtshams la be+eḍār sme ba shar lha phur nag 'di 'phrad grub 'bras 'byung yang byang shar sa stegs gsum gyi steng sngon las smon 'phro btsan ngang mo'i tshul bdud rgya 'dre dam sri' sbyor ba dang gegs rlung gis bskyod pas ma bsgyur bar sngon las smon rten 'brel lcags kyu yis lha bur nag 'di 'phrad bsnyen sgrub na gegs rlung gi rta pho phyogs su 'gro mgon bla ma' sku che'i gsos sman bskyed de 'degs pa' kā ba rnam brgyad yin yang ldon shing gser gyi lo 'bras can bu dam gtsang rags bzang shrī tri yin lho rgya stag g.yu yi smin ma can mgon kun mkhyen dgyes zhal sku skyes yin nub 'brong ngar shel gya rwa co can stod dbang 'dabs gling gi nirma ka byang dom bu g.yu yi rke brgyan can sde chen po a khyu bu bsnyon ste lha phur nag 'degs pa' ka ba bzhi bdud dam sri'i ral bas ma dkrugs na lcags sngon po' phur bu spyi

dzaXdza bor btags phyogs so so' rlung nag 'tshos mas gtogs brda de tsho thugs kyi ga 'ur chug chos de tsho rang rang phyag tu sprod ma mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i rol ston 'di yul bde ba'i me tog char du snyil ya bal po' ldem 'gro'i ta la la 'dzum mgrin pa' ngag ni kyu ru ru ya ltos shig byang phyogs yul la stos byang sham bha la nas zer gcig 'phros de' thob pa gu ru khyung zhen yin bka' na sngags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'di byang me rlung dug gi na bun 'thibs skyon ma gos dung gi rtse mo can g.yu' ba gam rdzo sa nas de sgrub tshugs khyed yab yum lcam sri bde skabs 'gyed yang stos shag lha ldan phyogs la ltos sku'i rgyal tshabs gang des bsags spelamathus gnas bzangapo lho brag zig ler 'phos thugs ka 'ur zhugs pa phur nag ste de'i bsnyen sgrub btsan po'i ri nas byed dbal gdab las lho yi phyogs su gtor sprel dmar po'i khrag rgya de yis 'thor shing tsan ldan yal ga thabs des smin rgya nag yul gyi sa cha nas ri rtse lnga'i byang gi rtsub khrod nas lha 'jam dpal dpa 'a bo' thugs rje ltar bdud 'dul ba gshin rje 'char ma'i dbal rgya'i bu mo mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro gsum deng grogs su byasanas sprad pa lags ri gser ldan spug po'i byang nas sgrubs dbal ngar kha bya gi phyogs su gtor na phung 'gyed g.yul zhugs 'khrugs rtsod 'byung yang gangs ri chen po di se nas mgon pad+ma'i thugs bskyed las byung ba

'phrin las kyi zegs ma ka ma la de'i dpal kha rin chen shog skyar thob gnas nges med dben pa'i ri sul du bsgrub rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa'i skal ldan na yul 'ga' la bde skyid nyin mor byed nyid yab yum sras 'khor bde skabs ster grangs drug cu'i ral kha legs 'phrod 'gyur yang rta nag lcags kyi ral ba can bdud rgya 'dres has grib g.ya' la bsngags skabs de 'phrod lcags kyi me long gtor mda' nag phran dar kha phyogs su 'thor gnad de tsho deng dusadam tshag yin lha rta zhal khyung gtsug bla na med de kun gyi dam tshig snying la zungs yang rdo rje gtsug tor ngan sngagasargyal khyung nag gi no so 'phrin las 'ad byad rigs sngags gzhes pa'i tho lum yin mthu rdzu'aphrul 'phrog pa'i thog ngar lags sel phung khrol bshigs pa'i so mang yin de re zhig srog gi gta' ru 'chong gza' dug sdong 'bar ba spu gri'i rdzongs da 'bod rbad bsad pa'i dam tshag gis dgra nag po' ral ba gcod kyang srid grags snyan pa'i snga don ldir skad do brda de tsho ma brjed yid la 'chongs skabs legs pa'i ngo so mtho yang srid yang bal mo dkyus 'gros ta la la 'dzum rgyang grags skad kyas 'di ltar bzlo mtsho chen po lcags sngon 'khrul 'khor bskor yul chen po rgyal khab kha lebs byed me dmar po'i zer thag springs ba na mtshal khrag dang brdab nas sa chen ldir nyes yod med me mur 'ob la bying zhing 'di tshos bde sdug ya ma brla mgo rmongs pa'i gangs ljongs bod

rdo dze khams pa skyabs dkon mchog ran chen rgyab tu bor grogs mkha' 'gro dam can blo mi gtad las byed na tshong dang shag la g.yeng rgyu bsgrub na dug rdzas dug las bsgrub gtam smra ba mtha' mi'i skad glugyer gos bgo na rgya gos sogs chas byed gnas 'grims na tshong ra rgya grong 'grims blos 'dun ma nag po rgya la byed tshul de tsho bod phung snga ltas yin bu khyod kyis sgrub chug brtan po ra zungs mi phyi nang gnyis la blo ma bsre rkang ma yengs sdod tshug zan par gyis ngas bsngags pa'i gnas la bshol ma byed rten 'brel tsam dus nas ma g.yel cig mi blo sems gcig pa'i 'khor slob rnams khyed thugasarje'i thabs kyis bzungs byas nas srid 'di las thar ba'i lam bzang ston mgon pad+ma'i zhing la sa bon thobs don 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing su skyol tshag snyan zhus bdud rtsi'i mchid 'di zu sa da bal mo bal yul mthil du 'gro gnas yang le shod kya phur par gab sngon rtena'abrel dbang gis ban chos 'dir rtags rten 'brel bzang po' 'phrin pa ra gda' ma mkha' 'gro be+eḍūr klo la thim sems rtogs pa 'i na 'pha nam mkhar mnyam sa ma wā snyi e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha was ma'ongs 'gro la thugs brtses rjes chags pa 'i zab pa 'i yang bcud thugs gter 'dus pa 'i dpal gsang ba skor bzhi man ngag srog gi bcud phyogs bzhi' gnas nas thugs khrag mkha' 'gros gtad rten 'brel che phyir shing mo

lor rin chen chos sde rnam dkar shog skyar phob rgyun khyer bsnyen sgrub dam du bya ba gnad bstan dang 'gro la bde skyid nyin mor byed yab yum lcam srings sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i rten 'brel bka' 'di srung shig sngags bdag ral gcig mas dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par zungs skal bzang rig pa 'dzin pa'i phyag tu sprod 'di ltar sgrub pa lhur len byed pa'i ma o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus spyod par sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thim dzi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin shes rab me 'bar gyis bkra shis lha regs rin chen ma ṇi hūṃ gis skyes bcas nan tan chen pos bskul nye gnas slob bu dhe was bri gzhi'i shog gu'i mthun rkyen kyas bskul ba dang grogs nas kyang nan tan chen po'i lcags gas brab te bskul ba'i ngor kho bo sbas pa'i rnam 'byor gsang sngags mi spyod glang pas o rgyan mkha'

dzā phur pa la nag spu gri'i rgyud las rdo rje tshe yi dpa sa grub sbyin pa ni tshe rdzas rnams mdun du bkod la: bdag nyid dpal chen po'i thugs sha'i hūṃ las 'od zer gcig spros te mdun gyi tshe rdzas rnams la phog: de dag las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi dbang bya.an dade bas grab thams cad dang yalha dang drang sratha 'khathar lazas btar ba'a.a rgyal pa thra rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang stobs 'byer ma lus pa rnams dang : 'byung bzhi'i nyi zla brtan g.yos dpal yon dwangs bcud ma lus pa a rniḥhūṃ gsum gyi rnam par sib sib rug rug bsdus nas mdun gyi tshe rdzas rnams la thim pas 'chi med ye shes kyi dngos grub sbyin pa'i gter du mos la : tho badz+ra ki li kai la ya sarba bisne baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: a tri ṇi:tshe sbyo a yu na g.yu tshe hūṃ: ces sngags brjod mthar mda' dar g.yab ci tshe 'gugs pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ rang snang shes rig ma 'gags tshe yi lha: 'chi med ye shes grub pa rdo rje'i sku: rig stong mi shig gnyug ma'i de kho na: rdo rje gzhon nu tshe dang ye shes gter thugs dam gnad bskul dgongs pa'i rtsal g.yos la mos ldan bu la

'chi med grub mchog stsol: lus 'chi med rdo rje'i gzi mdangs phob ngag 'gags med tshangs dbyangs gzi byin bskyed sems bde stong 'od gsal ting 'dzin sbyor: khams lnga 'dus 'di la dwangs bcud bskyed srog mi 'gyur nyi zla'i ga'ur chug: bla tshe gnyis mthud 'gyur gsos su smin: dpal he ru ka dpal phyag rgyas thob hūṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings mi 'gyura'asde yi 1nga dkyil nas: mi g.yo thabs kyi sku gachog 'dren shugs can: thal 'byin mnga' bdag badz+ra ki la ya: srid pa phur bu bdag sgrub thugs dam bskul: byams chen thugs rje'i 1nga nas 'dir bskyod la: mos ldan bu la 'chi med grub mchog stsol: lus 'chi med rdo rje'i gzi mdangs phob: ngag 'gags med tshangs dbyangs gzi byin bskyed: sems bde stong 'od gsal ting 'dzin sbyor: khams lnga 'dus 'di la dwangs bcud bskyed: srog mi 'gyur nyi zla'i ga'ur chug: bla tshe gnyis mthun 'gyur gsos su smin:dpal he ru ka dpal phyag rgyas thob: hū hrī nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mi gnas mi dmigs ye shes khro bo'i dal: za gsod las mdzad pho nya glog

rdo ltar 'khyugs kham gsum yongs sgrol dgongs spyod 'phrin las can skye med dbyings las bskul lo gzigs pa ngoms:mos ldan bu la 'chi med grub mchog stsol:lus 'chi med rdo rjes gzi mdangs phob:ngag 'gags med tsha sa dbyangs gzi byin bskyed:sems bde stong 'od gsal ting 'dzin sbyor:khams lnga 'dus 'di la dwangs bcud bskyed:srog mi 'gyur nyi zla'i ga'ur chug:bla tshe gnyis mthun 'gyur gsos su smin:dpal he ru ka dpal phyag rgyas thob:nyu hrīḥgasang srog dag pa chos sku'i dgongs spyod can:thabs mang 'phron las mngon spyod sbyor sgrol 'gyed:tshad med rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i:shwa na bdag nyid sa bdag skyes ging sogs:bka' sdod rdo rje'i srog ldan thugs dam bskul:'khor 'das dpal yon tshe bcud 'dir bsdus la mos ldan bu la 'chi med grub mchog stsol:lus 'chi med rdo rjes gzi mdangs phobasnyengag 'gags med tshangs dbyangs gzi byin bskyed:sems bde stong 'od gsal ting 'dzin spyor:khams lnga 'dus 'di la dwangs bcud bskyed:sgog mi 'byur nyi zla'i

ga'ur chug: bla tshe gnyis mthun 'gyur gsos su smin dpal he ru ka dpal phyag rgyas thob: trī trīḥ mi 'gyur lhun pobe+eḍūr bum pa rtsa thal 'byin 'phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs: 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang 'dir tshogs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a nyi ṣiñtsa oṃ: tshe chang sbyin pa ni hū trīḥdum gcig miyi nor bu ka pā lar 'chi med ye shes tshe rdzas a pra ta: byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bcud chen 'khyil 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol:rtsa sngags mthar wak+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tshe 'brang gtad la trī hrīḥ rin chen sna tshogasalas grub gzhong pa phu tshe yi dam rdzas g.yang zhag 'khyil ba la: tshe dang bsod nams dpal gyi 'od zer 'bar: skal ldan rnams la tshe yi dbang bskur stsol: rtsa sngags mthar gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐ mdar dar gtad la hū hrī mi 'gyur g.yung drungartag pa'i rdo rje ni: rdo rje 'chang gi tshe g.yang bu la bsdim: dus min 'chi ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba dang : tshe dbang dngos grub skal ldan rnams la stsol: rtsa sngags mthar hūṃ tra tra shag mi tra ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: shis brjod ni na

tswakho mo: phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas: der 'dzin skyes bu'i tshe sgrub mtha' ru phyin: yangs pa'i rgyal khams rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod: don gnyis lhun gyis dza/ba pa'i bkra shis regag: de ltar tshe yi dbang bskur bas dus man 'chi rkyen bar chad sel nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mtsho rgyal man ngag snying brgyud las gter ston rang gas sbyar ba dge sarba ma le

tswakho tshe 2gas ni hūṃ trīḥ shes rig ma bcos rdo rje tshe yi lha: skye 'gags 'gyur med badz+ra ku ma ra: sgyu 'phrul rol pa pho nya mgyogs ma'i tshogs: chos dbyings rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' las bzhengs: bla sgog tshe yi ngo bo rjeḥyig gzugs lhun grub mi yi bsod nams dpal bcud bstims: 'byung lnga nyi zla brtan g.yos dwangs ma dril rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bsrung bya rnams la bstims: dus/ min 'chi rkyen tshe yi g.yul ngo sel: gnyug ma'i khams su rtag par brtan gyur cig: cha tshe sbyo g.yu hūṃ g.yu tshe hūṃ: a yu1 na g.yu tshe hūṃ: grangs mang brjod la hūṃḥ thugs dam chen po'i dam tshig dus la babs: tshe dpag med mgon rgyal ba rigs lnga dang : lha mo mgyogs ma sgo ma sprul dang bcas dga' rab bṛ seng o rgyan bī ma la hūṃ gar nam snying dgyes bskyed sgrub pa'i grogs: kun kyang sngon nas grub pa mchog brtes bzhin: sgrub mchog byin gyis brlabs phyir phyag rgyar bzhengs: bla srog lha 'dre'i brkus dang 'khyams ral yal: zhig dang zad pa'i tshe gsos sgog mthud la lo brgya'i bar du 'chi med rgyas thob la: phyogs mtshams lha 'dres

lag nas tshe khug cig: bla sgog mi 'gyur gnyug ma'i khams gsu brtan: rdo rje tshe yi rig 'dzin thob gyur cig: tshe sbyo tram̐ hrī ā: a yudzñā na tshe hūṃ: sngags ci rigs brjod mthar hū hrīḥbla tshe mi 'gyur rdo rje'i mda' la brten: sde brgyad lha 'dre'i lag nas bla g.yu bkug: 'khor 'das brtan g.yos dwangs bcud dar gyis bkug: mi nub 'od gsal nyi zla'i ga'ur chug: tshe 'di mi 'gyur rdo rje ltar du brtan sgog ni mi nub rgyal mtshan 'pho 'gyur bral: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi phywa 'gugs g.yang blan no: srog gcig yi ge phri ba med par gang:rdo rje 'chang gis tshe bstims sgog rgyas btab skye 'chi gnyis med ye shes sku thob shog: tshe gzungs brjod par bya'o tshe bum gtad la kye: rje btsun o rgyan mgon po tshe dpag med: gsang ba'i yum chen rdo rje gos dkar mo tshe lha rgyal ba yab yum gtso dang 'khor bkra shis bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang: brda rtags bkod pa phun sum tshogs dbus bzhugs: 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bebs skal ldan slob ma rnams la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol ba dang : rdo rje tshe yi dbang mchog

skokho thob par shog: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: tshe chang gtad la hūṃ hṝ dum gartsig mi be+e nor bu kā pa lar: bla ma yab yum mnyam sbyor bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar dmar mthing ga'i mdangs 'bar bcud chen 'khyil skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje tshe yi dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags mthar wak+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa.āḥ tshe ril gtad la hūṃ hrī rtsa khams dag pa lus kyi gzhal yas su: 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma 'chi med tshe rdzas bskyil: skye 'chi rgas na rgud pa mi 'byung par bstan pa 'dzin phyir rdorje'i tshe thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tshe 'brang gam la hūṃ hrīX mi 'gyur rdo rje tshe dang g.yang gi rten: rtsa gsum wa yi byin rlabs sprin phung 'khrigs: dngos grubamachog gi dpal 'bar gtor chen po skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur 'chi med grub: gzhan don phun tshogs mdzad 'phrin mtha' rgyas shog: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal bā lirnyi a bhi〉〉 oṃ ā0 hūṃ hriḥ o dang po sgomed stong pa chos ska'i rgya: gnyis pa thabs shes zung 'jug longs sku'i rgya: gsum pa ston 'khor 'brin las sprul sku'i rgya: bzhi pa ye shes

mnyam sbyor ngo bo'i gye: lnga pa mi 'gyur sku lnga lhun grub rgya: drug pa rigs drug dong sprug phrin las rgya bdun pa bcom ldan rgyal ba rab bdun rgya: brgyad pa lhun grub 'char sgobargyad kyi rgya dgu pa ye shes 1nga dgu mnyam sbyor rgya: bcu pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug phar phyin rgya: don gnyis lhun grub rdo rje'i tshe thob shog: smon lam dang shis brjod rgya cher spro b.rabya'o nus ldan (sa so tshe rdzas sgrub pa ni phaṭa dza: bdag mdun bum pa'i dkyil 'khor kun: thal 'byin rnam bzhi'i dgongs spyod can: phur pa 'phrin las lha ru shes dag mnyamadakyil 'khe ra gsum du sgrubs tshe badz+ra ki li ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa: tshe hūṃ a ma ra ṇa dzi warnyi ye swā hā: brgya rtsa brjod mthar bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe 'khyams pa zhig ral chad gas sugyur pa thams cad: 'bru gsum yi ge'i rnam par spyan drangs nas bdag mdun bum pa'i dkyil 'khor dang : skal ldan slob ma rnams la bstims pas rdo rje tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa thob par mos la: las kyi gnyer kha ba na hūṃḥ bzhengs shigs dge bsnyen snying dkrung btsan: smu gu rgab nag chib bzhin du: dar chas rin chen rgyan spras

8kho nas:'phrul gyi mda' mo 'debs pa khyod:lhang lhang 'bod do da tshur 'dus legs nyes thol thol rnam par sgrogs:mngon shes sems la pra mo dbob:dmu gab sgrib g.yog med par mdzod:tshe da na ra tsa phaṭa:du na ra dza phaṭa:ni 'du ra tsa phaṭa:sra mo ston swā hā de 'dra zhag nus ldan pa la thol byu du shar ro bh+yo sngon che dpal chen he ru ga'i:spyan sngar khas blang dam mnos pas:ma tshogs dbabhe phyug nyer brgyad ni:sngags pa'i 'bod do dam la 'dus:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byor mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang g.yo sgyu med par gus ldan pas:sems kyis blang te spyi bor bkur:'phrin las sgrub zhes mna' bor ltar tha tshig ma g.yel dus la bab bstan pa srung la zhing bcu sgrol:mtha' dmags bzlog la bshad sgrub spel:gang bcol thugs bzhed bzhin du stsol:bh+yo rdo dze+ephur pa'i bstan srung ba:dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig ni:ral gri zang yag klad la bskor phur pa dgra bo'i snying la gzir:sngon gyi tha tshig ci bzhin du:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa da :

bstan bshig lag dmar srog rtsa chod bsgral 'dren thogs med 'byung bar mdzod: / ldang lha gsang ba'i brag phug nas bdud btsan klu yi spu gri ni: o rgyan pad+ma'i bka'abazhin du: phur pa bsgrub pa'i grogs su byon: thugs mthun mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: dam ldan rnal 'byor thugs bzhed kun: thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa dang : dgrabadud dam sri rdul du rlog: snyan pa bskyed la grags pa sgrogs: phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis mdzod: ma ye ye zhur zhur: thig thig: dmag dpon chen po 'khor dang bcasapa'i zhal du ma hā pañtsa bā lirnya rak+ta khā tī: gzhung las gab pa'i don hūṃ dam chig chen po'i dus la babs: khro bo chen po'i dus la babs: las mdzad pho nya'i dus la babs: phyagabarnyan sprul ba'i dus la babs bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: bstan la sdang ba'i dgrabagegs la: mngon sprod drag po' phrin las brtsams: phung por ye shes mtshon chas btab: gnas ngan 'khor ba'i las rgyan gcod: bag chags 'khrul 'khor rmings nas

sdoX bshig tshe badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra phaṭa: bi dza ya phaṭa ni lan tan+t+ra phaṭa: ya man+ta ka phaṭa: ār+ya a tsa la phaṭa: rgya ṣ+ṭṛ wa phaṭa: a pa ra tsit+ta phaṭa: a dṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali phaṭa:sa lo kya bhi dza ya phaṭa: ma hā bā la hūṃ phaṭa: khro bas phur ba gnas su gdab hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: ye shes khro tshogs dus la babs: sprul ba sam yas dus la babs: mngon spyod 'phrin las dus la babs: ma rig rmongs pa'i sems can 'di: nyon mongs zhe sdang rgyas pas mnar 'khor ba'i gnas las thar mi srid thugs rjes thabs kyis ma bzung na: 'khrul ba'i sems can snying re rje: dam tshig chen pos bsgral byas na: las dang rnam smin bag chags sbyongs: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su byed: tshe badz+ra kro ti sarba ma ra ya rbad: k+taka gham phaṭa: ha na ha na phaṭa: da ha da ha phaṭa pa tsa pa tsa phaṭa: bhan+ta bhan+ta phaṭa: hū lu hū lu phaṭa: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha phaṭa: tshin+ta tshin+ta phaṭa: bhin+ta bhin+ta phaṭa:sbo ṭa sbo ṭa hūṃ: phyag rgyas phur ba gnas su gdab smi dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs tshad med 'phrin las dus la babs: shwa na sa bdag dus la babs: re ti skyes ging dus la

babs: ma rig las skyes 'khrul ba'i dgra 'khor ba'i gnas su brgyud mar 'byams: rigs drug sdug bsngal bzod med myong: las ngan rgyun la zad dus med: thugs rjes thabs kyis bzung byas nas: phung po rdo rje'i mtshon chas btab: sems nyid chos skur rgyas gdab po: sa badz+ra ki li gī la ya: snyin+ta bhin+ta phaṭa: na ma sa man+ta hrī hrī phaṭa su ru su ru pra su ru phaṭa: ma ra ya phaṭa: ka rta ka ye phaṭa: ma ra sa na phaṭa : pra mar+bha na phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa: ka la rū pa phaṭa: yak+ka pra dun phaṭa: snying khrag shad dza: tsit+ta gtub:myag myag: sod sod: dha dhi ma ma garma dṛ kre dza ya phaṭa: gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig la gdab po 'di yang nus ldan pas so : bdud tri mā ra ya rbad nan: kha la dza la ni rbad nan: rā dza tun ling niX ༷bhe /༷:soshig shig dun dun rbad nan tshal tshal rbad nan: khro khro bh+yo rbad nan rmug rmug rbad nan: til til rbad nan: byad phur rbod gtong rbad nan: zhes grangasabasogs

(15 phur pa lha nag las nong bshags phul ba na rag dong sprugs bya ba bzhugs:lhakho na mo gu ru yaḥ skokhri gnyen po stobs bzhe tshangs ba yis sa: kun tu bzang po thugs mchog rin po che: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus lhun gyis grub snang stong sa ler gzigs pa'i zhal ma rmethong: gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba mthol lo bshags chos nyid bzang mo khyab brdal spros bral klong: dag pa dbyings gsum mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs: bde stong kha spyor mnyam nyid zhal ma mthong: nyong mongs sred pas 'ching ba mthol lo bshags: rdo rje gzhon nu kham gsum dbang sdud klong: dbyings dang ye shes shes rab gsum byis sgog srid gsum ka dag chen por mnyam gnas kyang: rnam par rtog gsum glo bur dri ma bshags 'khor lo rgyas 'debs srid zhi ro mnyam klong sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med ye sangs rgyas: tha snyad blo yi bag rdul dri ma zhugs: bde stong spros bral 'od gsal rjen pa ra bshags rag stong mi shig badz+ra ki la

ya: tshogs yul sems kyi stong srog dbu mar 'dren snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig mchog 'dzin par: 'khor ba'i srog gzugs bag chags bcas te bshags: log rtogabargyud mar gnyis gnyis bdud dam pos kham gsum med snang stong gzugs tsam du bzos: he ru ka dpal khro bo rol ba'i klong: yul dang yul can gnyis med mnyam par bshags: mu bzhir gol ba'i phyin ci log gi lta: rig stong mi shig rdo rjes gdar bcad nas: khyab brdal chos sku mnyam nyid chen por bshags: 'khor 'das dag mnyam /bye/sa/ ༷ //༵na gyur regag a ā: 'di yis mi dgas ga ya med skal ba can gyi dpal du shogs sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya zhes sprul sku thegs mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor lang gros sprul bas bsgyur ba dge legs

dzaXdzaphur ba lha nag spu gri'i dal du rdzas bskang 'bul ba bsod nams gter sprin bzhugs so::kho na mo shrī badz+ra ku ma ra ya: sprosmosto// / ( trī:nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:srid pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs sras 'khor bcas:'tshogs la sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:dam tshig dag pa'i mos ngor bzhugs su gsol:dung khang bhan+ta 'bar ba'i sgod mchog du dga' ston ko ro tsa na'i bdud rtsis babyang chub sems kyi bcud chen zeg ma 'phro:'di yang srid pa phur ba'i dal du 'bul:snying khar bde ba chen po'i bhan+ta cha bsam bstan blo las 'das pa'i rak+tas bganyis med bde chen rol ba'i chags pa bskyed:dpal chen dgyes bskyed srid pa phur par 'bul dwangs gsal dbang po 'bar ba'i bhan+ta ru rgyang zhags dwangs ma bcu

rin chen dpal bshos btsug: rtsa yi 'theb kyu bde chen rak+tas bran: rdo rje srin po'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul dum gcig mi yi nor bu ka pā lar: sngags kyi dbadza gad bcud chen gtams: dam tshig mnyam pa nyid du bsre ba'i phyir: srid pa phur pa'i dal du dgyes ston 'bul a la la ho bde ba chen por bzhes: 'khor ba dong shāgab ma malnga na shākyar regag: de ltar phul bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag nyams rtogs ngang gas 'phel sa ma wā skal ba can gya dpal du shog rgya rgya rgya 'di yang sgrub pa'i cha lag tu gter ston rang gi/ ya ge'i mthun rkyen 'gyur med do dge bas nyams rtogs 'phel gyur cig sarba mju lo/

8 9 dam chos thugs kyi gter kha las: rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs bsdus bsod nams gter sprin bzhugs:dzā ne na mo ku ma ra ya shas/mo/ / dum gcig snod du dga' ston tshogs sha lnga bdud rtsir dmigs te bshams rdo rje phur pa 'i lha tshogs la 'phrin las lhun rgyas grub phyir 'bul tsho10112 hūṃ hrī srid pa rdo rje phur ba'i lha: ye shes khro tshogs gshegs su gsol: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i tshogs la rol: mtshan ma'i rtog pa thams cad bshags: snying rjes 'gal zlo bdud dang sri: snang shes thal 'byin phur pas bsgral: phung po rdo rjer gtam byas nas: ye shes gsang ba'i 1nga du bstabs snang gsum bag chags gzhi la sangs: rig stong rdo rje phur pa shā1ba: gī la ya yis dngos sdo/ba (65: de ltar phul pa sa tshogs chen bsags gsod nams ye shes gter grub nas 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo chos skur sangs don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang shar gnyan po g.yu rtse'i gnas mdun du rdo rje phur pa 'i bsnyen sgrub byed skabs nus ldan pa sa sbyar ba mabe lam

dhiji phur ba lha nag sbu gri'i rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i dgyes bskang ni:jokho na mo gu ru ya dzurgosgo dga' ston tshogs kyi spyor lo spro rol mo snyan pa' glus bskul te hūṃ trīḥ bde stong 'dus ma byas pa'i pho brang nas: rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen thugs dam bskangs: thal 'byin phur ba sgrub pa'i dgongs spyod can: bram ze2 8 bha haste'i thugs dam bskangs: pad sdong las 'khrungs sangs rgyas gnyis pa che: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs snying thig sgol 'dzin ye shes bka' rgya mtsho: paṇa chen bi ma mi tra'i thugs dam bskangs: bi to ta ma'i lha zhal mngon gzigs pa: bal po bṛ la malja'i thugs dam bskangs: gu ru'i dgyes sde mkhar chen grub rgyal mo: phur thog ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bska sa: grub pa mngon gyur mkha' la bya ltar lding: a tsar dpal gyi snying rje'i thugs dam bskangs: yong rdzogs brag la sgrab thur zan ltar 'dzug: gnub chen sangs rgyas ye shes thugs dam bskangs 'ja' zer la byon ye shes ma

tshogs 'dud: dge slong nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam bskangs: chos rgyal gdung rigs mkhas grub zla bral ba: mkhon rje klu yi dbang po'i thugs dam bskangs: 'phrin lasarno myur gang yang thogs med pa: lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas thugs dam bskangs dngos brgyud grub pa brtes pa'i rnal 'byer ba: phur ba'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi thugasadam bskangs: thal 'byin rnam bzhi'i dgongs spyod mngon gyur te: log lam gnyis snang bdud bzhis mi bsgyur bar: srid pa phur bu byang sems gzhi tshug nas: rig stong mishig rdo rje gzhen nu'i zhal tshe 'di nyid la mngon du 'gyur ba dang : rtsa ba yan lag nyes lhung gzhi bral dag dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med shog de ltar bskang ba'ithabs zab 'di lang gro'i sprul ba'i dpal du shog: sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya zhes sgrub pa'i thun gseng du nus ldan pas shar mar spel te me tris yi ger bkod pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le

sbyo me zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: gsang ba'i nyams len tshogs mchod gter gyi bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:tswa kho na mo dzña na ḍak+ki ni ye: shisgo gi/ mchog tu mi 'byur bde ba che pan skyes ye shes gas ma'i zhal don dam rdo rje pha ga mo la ngo mtshar chen pos phyag bgyid do de yang bza' bca' bayo ba'i rigs bhasto'i snod du bsags byas te 'bru gsum nus pas sbyangs spel bsgyur de nas 'bu' ba'i rim pa ni ā: mtshan ldan bhan+ta yangs pa'i bye da nang du: rngamanams pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin: rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i rol bar bsgyur: 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du rnams par spel: ma āḥhū: hūṃ hrī o rgyan rang byung dur khrod chen po dang :gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i pho brang nas: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor bcas: ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol thod rnga dril bu'i sgra la dgyes

dngos 'dzin dag pas thug dam bskangs dngos zhen bden 'dzin 'thas pa mthol lo bshags: nang mchod nyon mongs dag pas thugs dam bskangs: chags sdang rang gar spyod pa mthol lo gshags: gsang mchod sman gtor rak+tas thugs dam bskangs: dug gsum a 'thas 'khrul pa mthol lo gshags: thabs shes ro mnyam bde bas thugs dam bskangs: dkar dmar chags spyod stor ba mthol lo gshags: gnyis su snang ba dbu ma chen por bshags sems kyis sems la blta ba mthol lo bshags: bshags dang bshags par bya ba gnyis su med blo 'das rdzogs pa che po'i ngang la bzhag: phyi dgra zhing bcu nang dgra smon log rigs: gsang ba gnyis su snang ba'i rū tra kun: ye shes rig pa'i shes rab ral gris bsgral: mi 'gyur gsang ba'i klob du khā hi stobs: dam rdzas pham phab 'dod yon mchod sprin gyis rdo rje'i las mdzad lhag skyong pho mo brngan:dgyes bskangs 'phrin las kun sgrub g.yul las rgyal : zab gter phyogs bcur dar rgyas 'phrin las mdzod: mi mngon dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: legs

rdo kho nyes ltong 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod mdzod: dpal mgon bdun cu dreg pa sde lnga dang : drag mo mched gsum sha za ging gcig gis: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byer bcol ba'i las mdzod sa ma yā: ma yam bstan ma bcu gnyis dpon g.yog gis bshal chu'i skyems bzhes 'phrin las grub par mdzod log 'khrul dam sri 'byung po ma lus pa: gru gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i e klong brub: mnan no ma sdang sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: gsang gsum gnyug ma'i dngos grub bu la stsol: ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur nongs pa bshags: dge tshogs gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: phyam gcig kun bzang rgyal sa zin par shog: dgongs pa zang thal mngon du byas pa'i mthus: gnyis rtog mdud pa'i dgongs rgya grol bar shog lhan skyes ye shes zhal ras rtogs pa'i mthus: thim la ma rmugs rig sku rtogs par shog: ye gnas gnyug ma'i gshis su sad pa'i mthus dag mnyam sangs rgyas dgongs pa rtogs par shog: lha gcig rdo rje phag mo bsgom pa'i mthus bcu drug gsum gyi don mthar phyin par

shog: lha dang snang ba rang sems dbyer med shog khyab brdal rdzogs pa chen po 'byams su klas: slar yang ye shes rol ba'i rjes thob kyis: 'gro 'dren sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod lam byan mo chos dbyings mkha' la rig pa'i nyi ma shar: bde stong thugs rje'i sbrang char zil ma 'bebs: dad ldan 'gro blo'i ge sar zum pa phye: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshom bu dang bcas te: skyes rgyan mkha' 'a11ra 'tshogs pa'i bkra shis regag ces dang bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel tshe chos gegs zhi sgrub tshug zan pa dang dbyingasagasum mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i las mthar phyan rtags mtshan khyad 'phagasayar pa 'i zla ltar 'phel bka' gas bdud rtsi'i zegs ma lta bu'i chos grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyed la gtad rin chen brda la thob cag sar h+ye zababacud thub par srungs shigs sngags bdag gsum skal med lag tu ma shor sha za ging ma 'ongs snyigasam sum bcu kha ral dus nga sprul snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye lha cesapa 'di ya chosakyi bdag popad+ma chos 'phel kun bzang grub dbang rnams kyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes o rgyan gsang ba'i gnas dkor bkra shas gsang phug nas mkha' 'gro'i brda lhag chad med par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le

8 kho tshogs 'phrin gdab pa ni ho dgongs su gsol lo: spros med rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i dbyings na ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa rnams: thugs skye med phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i ngang la ye shes kyi gzigs pa chags thogs dang bral ba'i 'dir 'tshogs shing 'dus pa rnams la dgongs su gsol lo: deng phun tshogs lnga dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir bdag cag gi yo byad rnam par dag pa bsgrub nas tshogs ston spros lags na bzhes par ci gnang: bla ma'i brdalan gan ba ni ho rdo rje rgyal theb dbyings kyi 'gyur gdengs rdo rje spyan po sgrol ba'i ging ga ra las kyi gzung ma rngams rol gdung 'khrugs sogs dam tshig srog gcig sbrel ba rnams gsan du gsol: deng byang chub sems kyi tshogs sngon du btang nas bsam pa dag pa 'i rdzas dngos po dag pa'i tshogs: dam tshig dag pa'i 'dus pa rnams bka' bzhin du byung na: rmad byung thabs kyi cho gas dga' ston tshogs 'khor rgya chen bskor lags na bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po rdzogs pa'i dgos pa dang ldan pas na rdo rje

phur pa dkyil 'khor gsum ldan kyi lha tshogs dang bdag rdo rje slob dpon gyi bzhes par gnang ngo:tshogs spyi nas e ma ho: rang snang rnam par dag pa'i ston gnas 'di lta bu'i tshogs gral du bdag cag tshud pa sngon smon rten 'brel skal pa shin tu bzang bas na:dad pa ting 'dzin dam tshig dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir thabs chen tshogs la brten nas rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs grwal du 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel bzang po'i skal ba rgyud la 'jog 'tshal:bskang rdzas byin rlabs ni o āḥhūṃ:skye med rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings su:'gags med ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i tshogs:bde ba mchog gi 'od gsal lha mor bcas:rig pa ye shes phur pa bskang phyir spel:sa ā hū:bde ba mchog gsang ḍāk+ki su kha'i slong:bcu drug phyed byed dga' bzhi'i tshogs ston spel:gnyis med mnyam sbyor yid rig phyag rgya bcas rdzogs rim 'od gsal phur pa bskang phyir spel: maskuḥhūṃ: khyab brdal yangs pa'i dung chen snod nang du yul drug brtan g.yo dga' ston tshogs su shar:khams gsum bde sprin phyag rgya'i gar dang

lja bcas bskyed rim srid pa phur ba bskang phyir spel: tso āhūṃ: zad med gter chen ting 'dzin rol ba'i rgyan: ngo bo skye med rang bzhin dngos mtshan grol thugs rje cir yang 'char ba rig pa'i 'phrul: stong khams 'jig rten dog mo byed par spro nam mkha' mdzod sngags dang badz+ra spra ra ṇa kho: 'di yang gter ston rang gis smras yi ge 'gyur med zhesabyas bkod: dga' ston tshogs kyi bsod nams des rgyal khams chos ldan bkra shis thegagaḥ sarba masgo le

༷ dza tshogs bsgral ni tshogs sgod lcags khang gru gsum pa las kyi ga na rje'i bsha' khab dngos su gsal la:tshogs rdzas zhing bcu tshangs ba'i dgra sde rnams nyam thag dbug dang bral la khad 'dar bri li li gnas par dmigs la:bden brjod ni na mo:rig 'dzin grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bden pa dang :yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bden pa dang :dag pa dbyings gsum na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyis bden pa dang :rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmags tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyis:nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs pa'i lag dmar:sems can gyis bde skyid bcom pa'i bdud sde:dam chos byang chub sgrub pa la nye bar 'tshe ba'i gzugs can gyi dgra dang gzugs med kyi bgegs thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par tshogs tha ma dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig:smoḥtriḥbadz+ra aṅku sha dza:dzaX hūṃ baṃ

ho: lhag zhus ni dpa' bo chen po dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la gnas pa'i dbang phyug ma sring ging laṅga la dpal chen po' tha tshig ltar pham phab lhag ma'i gtor ma bdud rtsir bsgyur nas gnang bar zhu zhu byin rlabs ni āḥ las bhan+ta lcang lo can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lhag ma'i gtor ma sha yi ri bo: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram khrod: 'dod yon lnga yi phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po gcig tu gyur: tshe āḥ/ ha ho trīḥ gtor ma byin rlabs ni āXlas bhan+ta'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gtor ma sha khrag rus pa'i phung po stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar gyur: slo āḥs: brtan gtor byan rlabs na rin po che'i sgod du bshal chu dang gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dam tshig srung ba'i pha phog gi dga' ston tu gyur: rma āḥhūṃ: bro mnan ni gtor snod sbubs pas dam sri 'gab 'dre thams cad nub par bsam: na mo: mchog gsum sma gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis batsho ba med pa'i bden pas mthus: gnod byed dam sri 'gab 'dre bse rag phung sri thams cad pho brang ri rab chen po'i 'og tu khug

tswakho cig:dzaX/ bo holas ngan dam sri bdud bgegs kyi sde thams cad stong shing nub par bsam mo yar btegs tshe gtor gzheng bkra shis pa'i snod du phanabade'i dga' ston dpal 'byor gyis gang bar gyur:mchod dmigs ni bdag bskyed las spre sa pa'i 'dod yon gyi lha mo nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor gyis lha tshogs mchodaci bska bar bsam la:bstod dmigs ni gzhan yang bajes sdug blta bas chog mi shes pa'i lha mo grangs med pas phyag rgya lnga ldan gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi sku gsungathugs yon tan 'phrin las la bstod pa rgya chen pe phul bar bsam mo:mthar lha mo rnams bdag mdun gyi gnas sor sor thim par bsam mo:shas brngo da la rang ge snying gami'od zer gyis bskul te la klu mi yi paṇa grub rig 'dzin rgya mtsho nam mkha' la byon nas bkra shis pas bden tshig brjod cing phyag nas dge mchan kyi dpal 'bar ba'i me togagi char chen po bsnyil bar bsam la:rten snyi bkra shis rgya cher brjod smon lam ni na me dgu dra thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen sgron me 'bar snga 'gyur gsang sngags rdo rje'i 'od stong
