bkra: sde gnyis rtag par thugs mthun khrims gtsang bzhin: bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis la gnas gyur cig: log rtog kla kle'i rgol ba mi 'byung zhing: rgyal khams 'gro bde skyid spel bzhin du kun kyang dge bcu'i khrims la rtag gnas nas: rig 'dzin tshogs gral spyod pa'i skal ldan shog rmad byung rdo rje'i don ston bla ma dang : bstan sbyin bdag bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams: sku tshe mi 'gyur yun du brten pa dang : gdul zhing rgya mtsho smin cing grol gyur cig: rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra yi thugs kya yang bcud zab pa 'i skor chen srog gi dwangs ma 'di: kho mo mtsho rgyal thugs kyi sras nus ldan rdo rje'i dpal du bzhag dus kyi rgud pa gso ba'i phyir sngon po'i dug tshang kha lhud tshe a tsar dpal gyi rdo rje yis mkhar chu dpal gyi phug nas sprad rtag rten 'brel ma 'dzol na 'byug ngar sgrul 'khyugs rta brgyugs nas lug nyal sprel rtsed bya 'phur tshe a mo la ge'i rdo leb kyis mtsho sngon kha leb byed kyang srid de bar bka' 'di zub par srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shoras ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu gye brda thim 3/ zhes pa'ang sgrub pa zab mo'i thun gseng du kha skong nye bar mkho phyar gsang sngags mi bskyod gling bas shar mar spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba ma le

skokho phur ba'i gnam phud ni sbyo rdo dzopad+ma thod 'phreng gi: bka' rtags spyi bor 'chang ba yi: dam tshig thugs la brten bzhin pa: rnal 'byor 'phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs: tsha ba'i ma mo bcu gnyis dang : dam can lha lnga mthu rtsal can: sdong lha gnyan gyi srung ma che: bdud btsan klu yi spu gri ni: sprul pa g.yog bcas gnas 'dir byon rmad byung dga' ston tshogs la rol: tshad med 'phrin las rab 'byams kun: thal 'byin bka' nyan pho nyas sgrubs: dge dang mi dge mi g.yo'i las: khro bo thal 'byin dgongasapas sbyangs: nyong mongs rtogs bdud dug lnga'i dgra: thal 'byin sras mchog dgongs par brub srid pa'i snang shes bag chags sbyangs: dpal chen thal 'byin dgongs pas bsgral: rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa rmad byung grub: don rtags phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs: gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du rol snang gsum zag pa rang sar zad: he ru ka dpal mngon sdomar regag: 'di yang gter ston ra gis smras ya ge 'gyur med bya bas bkod dge ba'i don gnyas lhun grub shog sarba ma le

lha'i tshogs la rol ba na ho mtshan ma'i rtogs pa rang sar bcom: chos nyid mnyam pa'i dgongs spyod kyis lha la lha thim ji bzhin du: chos nyid la yang chos nyid rol: a ho ma hā su kha sirnyi pha la ho: tshogs ba'i smon lam gdab pa ni ho: theg chen thabs kyi dga' ston 'di mnyam nyid dgongs pas rol shes na: 'khor ba'i duḥ kha 'joms pa ni: shākyab pa mchog gi dam tshig yin: a la la ho 'ad yang gter ston ra gis smras slob bu 'gyur los yi ger bkod gsang sngags thabs bzhin spyod nus shing 'khor ba'i skye sgo kheg par shog sarba maṅga le

lha'i phur pa lha nag spu gri'i 'khor lo'i thugs dam gnad bskul rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhugs dzaX na re sho ka ya : 31ra ma sha chen dud btang rol mo snyir lta ba'i gde bskyed lta stangs gzar snyan pa 'i glu yi tha tshig gis thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni /: spyodan /debaskal pa dang po la: rgya gar yul gyi lho nub mtshams: ri bo te shan ya na'i 'gram: mchod rten sngon po'i khri 'phang 'dab: ma dros 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil klu gnyan sa bdag gtodakyis bstod: de na su bzhugs su mi bzhugs: slob dpon bre ze mchog sred dang : rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: ma mo rgya mtsho'i gos can dang : mkha' 'gro gser gyi rna rgyanacan: lha mo pad+ma'i 'phreng ba mdzes: kun kyang sngags kyi dgongs spyod skyongs: nam mkha'i dbyings la mnyam par bzhag: 'phrin las bi to ta mar 'dzug: rigs sngags 'bumagyi 'khyal 'khor bshigs: gdug pa bdud bzhi'i dpa' stongs shing: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog pa dang : mkha' khyab ye shes khro bos gang: 'khor 'das stong sgog mngon du

byung: tha snyad snang shes thal mar 'byin: ki la ya yi dngos grub brnyes: sngon gyi de la dpe blang nas: deng gi dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir dkyil 'khor gsum gyis gzhi bzung zhing bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhis gzhung bsrings na: ma g.yel ma 'phang thugs dam can: rdo rje khros pas dbang byin phob: thog med 'kha' la bsgrod stobs ldan: rdo rje phra min 'dir byon 'tshal: rgya mtsho'i dbyings nas 'dzug pa mnga': mdzes pa klu mos sprin char bsdus: kham gsum lha yi grong khyer nas: mdzes ldan ma yis bdud rtsi brnyil: ma g.yel ma 'phang ging gi tshogs: dur khrod gnas nas 'dir byin phob: ma g.yel ma 'phang dpa' bo'i tshogs gangs dkar rtse nas 'dir byin phob: ma g.yel ma 'phang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rgya mtsho'i gnas nas 'dir byin phob: ma g.yel ma 'phang rig 'dzin tshogs: rnga yab gling nas 'dir byin phob rdo rje'i rig 'dzin grub pa dang : ki la ya yi dngos grub mchog rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bcas da lta nyid la stsal du gsol he ru ka dang dbyer med mdzod: slo badz+ra ku ma ra sa ma yā: zhes bskul tshe rdo rje srin po'i

dza bden brjod ni ho datre ngas su gsol lo: lan gsum rgyal ba dbo ngas pa'i brgyud pa rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa: gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa: re ga ser tshig gi brgyud pa: mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud pa: bka' bab don gyi brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : yi dam dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul phur ba'i lha tshogs bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs rnams gyi bden pa dang : ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams gyi bden pa dang :rdo rje chos skyong pa'i bka' srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : bka' gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : bden gnyis basmu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyis: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la bar du gcod pa'i bdud ma ṭaṃ rū tra thams cad mdun gyi ma tram̐ 'di la khug cig: lan gsum dzaḥ4 rba ho: gnod byed a na ya dza: zhes gter ston rang gis sbyar ba'o

:kho gser skyems ni chos nyid kyi bden pa'o dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : mdo sgyu sems phyogs yi dam lhag pa'i lha phag khros seng gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis: gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod grogs mdzod cig: gas sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs pa 'o rdo rje'i srog ldan skyes bu ging bzhi dang : ma mo bcu gnyis dbang phyug gser gyi sring: dge bsnyen nyer gcig dam can rgya mtsho yis: gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod grogs mdzod cig: a snyi tsar+sha'i dus la bab pa 'o rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub ri'i phyogs la bskor: khrel med zhing bcu langs la shor ba'i skabs: bstan dang der 'dzin dbu 'phang dma' bskul ba'i: rdo rje phur pa mngon spyod las la bzhengs: ba ga pa 'di kho na'o dam las nyams shing 'gal gshe log pa dang : ngan pa'i ngang tshul rnam smin myong gyur can: yongs la gnod cing bla ma dam pa'i dgra: 'di ru ki la ya yis las mdzod cig:thugs dam dus 05 bab 21 sa ma yā: bsgral gzhung gi dum bu gcig go kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis gnang ba nus ldan pas sa

tswakho phur pa lha nag spu gri'i rgyud kyi bskul byang dug mda' dmar nag dgra bo'i snying 'byin bzhugs :tswakho na mogu ru shrī ku ma ra yu: hūṃrba35spyo( 1 mngon spyod drag po'i rnal yor gyi zhing bakhri dgra sde tshar gcod phyar bskul pa tshag gi mda' sprad nas dug zer zha r+sā' dgra la 'deb sa ma yā rnal 'byor brtul zhugs dpa' gdengs bskyed dar phyar khrag skyems g.yu skyems mchod sha khrag gtor ma ba na ston bzhag snyan pa 'i glu yas 'di skad do dza je gru gsum mchen nag e yi 11nga dkyil nas: bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i khri yi khar: rgyal kun 'brin las gcig bsdus ngo bo nyid: dpa' chen rdo rje gzhon nu be+eḍūr zhal gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dur khrod dpal chas klubs: phyag drug mtshon chas rigs drug g.yang sa sgrol sku gsum zhal gyis snang gsum mtshan ma bshigs: zhabs bzhi bsgrad pas skye ba rnam bzhi gnon: dug gsum gnasastsong byag pa'i rdzas gsum 'khyad: sa gsum gdon 'dal mnab pa'i gos gsum krabs: srid zhi gnyis med btags pa'i rgyan gnyis mas: phar phyin drag rdzogs rus pa'i ka

shar 'chang:gzung 'dzin dbyangs sgrol me rlung gzugs shing g.yo:rig pa mi 'gyur rdo rje rtse lngas brgyan:ye shes sgog gi go ru hūṃ gis mtshan:zhi khro rigs lnga'i thod rgyan darasna'i 'phan:mthing nag ral ba gyen brdzes mtshon thun 'phro:stobs kyi bdag nyid badz+ra ku ma ra do nub mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs sbyor ba'i yum mchog 'khor lorgyas 'debs ma:mthing gsal be+eḍūr+ya yi dkyil 'khor la:in+t+ra ni la'i ral ba sku rgyab 'phyang:bde la stong pas rgyas 'debs yab mgul 'khyud dug gsum rtsad gcod drishul thod khrag stobs:rus rgyan gzig shams mgo 'phreng zhing lpags klubs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyangs srid zhi mnyam nyid ston:'bum khrag mkha' 'gros nye 'du 'gagasapa med:'khor lo rgyas 'debs mngon spyod las la bzhengs:ljang nag gru gsum e yi sang dkyil du:thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra gī la ya 'phrin las bzhi rdzogs khra thabanyer gcig 'gyed:gdul dka' tshar gcod sprul pa brgya rtsa 'phro:sta re lcags kyu spu gri gdab phur 'dril dgra bgegs dam sri'i snying khrag lhud par byed:khro chung las

dza mdzad bu yug bzhin du 'tshubs: bka' nyan pho nya dam la lhag par 'du: sku smad dbal phur rtse mo e ru gnas: thabs dang shugs kyis sgol ba'i 'phrin las can badz+ra gī la mngon spyod las la bzhengs: lha gdon 'dul mdzad khro bo hūṃ ka ra: 'jig byed chen mo rdo rje sgra 'byin rol: bka' nyan pho nya phag dang smig bu'i mgo:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub phyir bskul: dri za 'dul mdzad khro bo rnam par rgyal: sgrol byed chen mo rdo rje snyem ma rol las mdzad pho nya sreg dang bya rgod mgo ma rig gsal ba rang sar bsgral phyir bskul: me lha 'dul mdzad khro bo dbyug sngon can: stobs byed chen mo rdo rje sder mo rol: yab yum sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo: nyams pa zhing bcu bsgral phyir thugs dam bskul: ya man gdon 'dul khro rgyal gshin rje gshed: mkha' mnyam bde sbyor dur khrod bdag mo rol: rdzu 'phrul thog med sha ba 'ug mgo can: rno myur thog 'dra'i nus pa ston phyir bskul: rak+ka'i gdon 'dul khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon: 'brin las bskul mkhas gtun khung gnyis med rol phyag brnyan las mdzad

gzig dang khā mgo can: sbyor dang sgrol ba'i 'brin las mdzad phyir bskul: chu lha'i gdon 'dul dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal 'bar bas rgyas bdebs gtum mo bde bar rol:bsgrod pa thog med byi la pu shud mgo rjes chags gdul byar 'jug phyir thugs dam bskul: rlung lha'i gdon 'dul khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal ma rig g.yul 'jom mda' snyem dgyes par rol: mdzad 'phrin 'gyed mkhas spyang ku khra mgo can ma rig 'khrul ba kha lo bsgyur phyir bskul gnod sbyin gdon 'dul khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil: 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rlung 'byin gnyis med rol drag rtsal stobs ldan seng ge pha waṃ mgo gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul phyir thugs dam bskul: bgegs kyi gdon 'dul khro chen bams gsum rgyal mngon spyod thog med gsod byed chen po rol: 'khrul ba dbyings sbyor dom dang sre mong mgo: zhing bcu'i don snying 'byin phyir thugs dam bskul: sa bdag gdon 'dul khro chen stobs po che: gzung 'dzin rtsad gcod bskul byed chen mor rol log rtogs gnas stong dred dang byi ba'i mgo mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir gnad nas

8 6 bskul tshad med rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa 'phrin las can:pu shud mgo can srin bya khra yi mgo: rang rang sprul pa yang g.yog mu med bcas:'phrin las lhunagyis grub phyir thugs dam bskul:bye lcags kyisbyang ma 'jig pa'i mgo dgu ma:de la 'jigs byed shwa na chen mo zhon:sngags pa'i dam la nye ba'i drag rtsal can:zhing bcu'isgog rtsa gcod phyir thugs dam bskul: gser gyi 'phar ba 'jib pa'i lce brgyad can: de la 'beb pa'i sri ka chen mo zhon:nyams pa'i dbugs sdud las la rtsal theb pa dragatu bskul lo ma g.yel las la bzhengs zangs gyi wa mo mgyogs pa'i rkang gsum ma de la rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan sri las zhon:sngags pas tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod lagasakyis:zhing bcu'i bla la 'jab phyir gnad nas bskul: g.yu yi khyi mo zug pa'i sgra ldan ma:de la gtum rngams ku ku mu khas zhon:sngags kyi dbang phyug zhabs pad spyo bor len bdag nyid ma bzhi'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul:dzaḥlha la dbang bsgyur lha mo re ma ti: mgyogs pa'i rtsal ldan dril rta rkang gsum bcibs:mkha' la dbang byed nad

rims char 'bebs ma: sngags pas drag tu bskul lo las la bzhengs: bdud la dbang bsgyur bdud mo re ma dza: stong gsum sgra yis khengs ba'i 'brug mor zhon na ba rdeb pa'i gdug rtsub can: sngags pas drag tu bskul lo dgra la rbad: srin por dbang bsgyur srin mo re ma sdos thog med yud kyis bskor ba'i glogs la bcibs:khram la 'debs pa'i srog bdud ma: sngags pas drag tu bskul ma dgra la rgyugs: klu la dbang bsgyur klu mo re ma dzi: thog med bang rtsal ldan pa'i sbur la bcibs rtsis la 'debs pa'i shā rdil can: sngags pas drag tu bskul lo gsod gcod mdzod:dza rdorjeni sgog ldan ya byin chen mo ni chibs su stobs ldan bse stag da bcibs: bdud kyi don snying 'byin pa'i drag shul can sngags pas 'bod do mngon spyod las la bzhengs: dam tshigs ldan pa'i de byin mthu mo che: chibs su 'gros sman sha yu chung bcibs: nyes chad 'phral ston lo tog bcud len ma sngags pas 'bod do mngon spyod mdzad pa skyongs gsang ba'i sgog ldan bse byin dbang mo che:

shāka than gyi 'phrul 'gyed rnga mong bcibs: bstan dgra'i don snying 'byin pa'i dmar las mkhan sngags pas bskul lo mngon spyod las la rgyugs: bka' la nyan pa'i phag byin rdzu 'phrul can chibs su lcags byi spyang mo sha zan bcibs: sgrub gnas gtsug lag rnal 'byer drod nyul ba: sngags pas bskul lo zhing bcu'i dgra la chas:dza nyon mongs dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mthu rtsal can: gnam sa phyed kyi bdag po dung gi ging: skyes bu chen po seṅge dkar mo bcibs: dgra la rbad do ma g.yel myur du rgyugs:gdug pa'i don snying 'byin pa'i mthu rtsal can: ma la ya gnas lcags kyi skyes bu ni: rta nag bcibs shing srin po'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: legs nyes shan drangs 'byed pa'i dam tshig can: dgra la rbad do mthu rtsal khyad chos ston: sngon nas g.yar dam bzhes pa'i mthu rtsal can: bse ging 'bar ba bya rog gtsug 'dzin pa: me rta bcibs shing gza' nad thog ser 'bebs: dgra la rbad do lus sems 'brel thag chod: tha tshag snying la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor grogs: khro rgyal tā ki nag po me dbal 'jig: lcags kyi ser ba

thun gyi bu yug 'tshubs:dgra la rbad do rnam shes chos skur bsres:dza:rdo rje phur pa gsang ba'i drod 'dzin pa'i tsha ba tsha shod ma mo bcu gnyis ni:'byung lngar dbang za bstanapa'i so kha srungs gsang ba'i mtshan btags 'dre sde bdud srin gshed:sha za khrag 'thung dam la gdung sems can stong gsum yud kyis bskor zhing legs nyes gzigs bka' chad 'phral la ston pa'i khrims srung ma:'phrul bsgyur mig la dbang byed g.yin snang 'dren:ma sman sprul ba nyi rdul grangs mnyam rnams:rdo rje phur ba sgrub pa'i rnala'abyor gyis drag tu bskul lo las la da bzhe sa shig mngon spyod khyad chos ston pa'i 'phrin las mdzod:dzaḥrdo rje srin po'i bka' sdod pa:'phrin las phur pa sgrub pa'igrogs:srin mo smug nag tshangs pa dmar:lha chen dkar gsal gtogs 'dod sngo:gzhon nu dmar la brgya byin sgrug:rdo rje pha waṃ zhi ba dmar:bdud rtsi dmar ser zla bdakar:be con ljang la srin mo nag za ba dmar la dga' ba skrug:stobs chen dkar la srin mo skrug:'dod pa dmar la nor srung ljang:rlung lha sngo nag mi mo dkar:phag mo

tswakhri dmar la khā gdong mthing: sna chen dmar spug chu lha sngo khu byug dkar la ra gdong ser: seng gdong dmar la sbrul gdong ljang : ma sring dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: sngon tshe dpal chen spyan snga dza dbus la 'tshal ba'i skal med kyang: dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong dam mnos shing: phud la spyod pa'i gnas med kyang: lhag ma'i zhal chab rol dam bcas: rnal 'byer dbang phyug zhabs pad khur: ci bcol bka' sgrub dam mnos ltar: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegs: ri bo'i rtse dang rgya mtsho'i gting skyabs gsum sngags pa'i gur khang sogs gling bzhi srid gsum gar gnas kyang: skad cig rang dbang med par khug gzugs byang rū pā 'di la khug: spyor sgrol 'dren pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: ka rta ka ye dza ye: bhe dza ye: a tsi teX a pa ra tsi te mā ra sa na pra mar ta na ye ma ma rak+ka rasmo bh+yo: hṝX triḥ.a mu ga'i tshe 11ga la bod bye : do gal shin tu che ba las kun nas chen po byed mi rung byas na mthu che dbal bzod dka' dgra dpung pha lam yin ya 'jig rno nus gnam lcags thog dang 'dra phur srung rgya mtshos thub par

srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhig sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya zhes gsang ba'i sgrub pa zab mo'i cha rkyen du shes nyams ḍak+kis bskul ba dang mthun rkyen shog gu bcas dhe was mos blos bskul ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyisadabyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba' yi ge pa ni lung zin shrī tra bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma le
86 phur pa lha nag spu gri'i rgyud las: mngon spyod drag po'i bsgral las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bram ze'u pra bha hasti'i thugs bcud bzhugs so:

na mo gu ru shrī ku ma ra ya sa lazan/ rja / 0 shi// mi sdug srin po khros pa'i rnam 'gyur can sgegs bzhad rdo rje'i gad rgyang 'thug ltar sgrogs tshad med thugs rjes nyon mongs 'gro be+eḍūr lhun po ku ma ra la bstod skal lan sgrub par mchog brtson snying rus can sbyor sgrol thabs la mkhas pa'i bgo skal du mngon spyod drag po'i man ngag zab mo bstan gdul dka' bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i mtshonas ma mā dang po mdun bskyed bsgom pa la dkyil 'khor bca' bshams zhal shes ltar mdzes rngams brjed dang ldan par bkod rnal 'byor lta ba'i gdangs ldan pa'i e masnyo laX spyoḥ gabye da byed a dza stong dang snying rje chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu snang stong rig pa'i rang mdangs tsam du sprul pa go cha dang bcas pa ma4 mer gsal gdab pa'i mdun du ma tram̐ rū tra thal skya gtum rngams ma rung ba'i rnam 'gyur can rkang lag lcags gzer gyis bsdams nas gnas par bsam: 'gugs tu bya ma tre+e rū tra a phaṭa: rnam shes 'og min gyi dbyings su rgyas gdab: gnod byed ma tram̐ rū tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: bdag nyid dpal chen po'i thugs las mtshon cha sna

dzakhri tshogs kyi char spros pas gnod byed rū tra'i phung por 'dam rtsig gi khar skyog phog pa ltar khrol gyis zhig pa las:glebadz+ra mtshul spyo zhes brjod pas khogapa dpal gyi gzhal yas khang dur khrod thod mkhar sgo gru rta bab 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba dra phyed shar bu mda' yab gdugs tog dang bcas pa ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsalagadab: phyi nang kun tu ye shes kyi me lnga rab tu 'bar zhing khro chung bu yug ltar 'tshubs pa:rdo rje dang phur bu'i 'du 'phro 'gyed pas bdud dang dam sri tshar gcod par byed pa rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang de'i dbus su byol song gtso bo brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad zla dang nyi ma'i khar: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las yeshes sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs pa ni mdun bskyed dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi gyad kyis 'dor stabs subasgrad pa: dmar la zlum pa'i spyan dgu sdang mig bsgrad cing dur khrod dpal chas brjid par klubs pa: rtsa phyag ri rab kyi phur bu 'dril zhing de 'og g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga

gdengs shing: g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ dang me dpung 'bar ba bsnams pa: mche ba tshad med bzhi ru gtsigs shing: glog dmar lta bu'i ljags brkyangs bzhin drag po'i gad rgyang 3brug ltar sgrogs pa rdo rje dang rin po che'i gzhog pa gdengs shing mthing nag ral pa gyen du brdzis shing rdo rje rtse lngas mdzes par brgyan pa'o: de yi dgyes bskyed yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'deb ma sngo skya āt+pal dang dung khrag stobs shang zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked la 'khril ba: g.yang gzhi gzig sham thod sbrul rus pa'i rgyan drug rnam par spras pa'o de yi phyi rim 'khor rtsibs nyer gcig la dpal chen rol ba'i sras mchog rnams kyang mthing nag lcags phur 'dril zhing thod sbrul g.yang gzhi stag sham klubs pa'o: de rgyab masar lo rtsibs bcu'i steng du mthing nag hūṃ gis 'phro 'du las shar stod du khro chen hūṃ ka ra dang sgra 'byin ma: shar rtsibs su rnam par rgyal ba dang rdo rje snyem ma: shar lhor dbyugasngon dang rdo rje sder mo: lho rtsibs su gshin rje gshed po dang dur bdag ma lho nub tu mi g.yo mgon po dang gtun khung ma: nub rtsibs su dbang chen rta mgrin dang rdo rje gtum

mo: nub byang du 'dod rgyal dang mda' bsnyem ma byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang rlung 'byin ma: byang shar du kham gsum rnam rgyal dang gsod byed ma: na rgyal po dang skul byed ma: kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag phyag gnyis lcags phur 'dril zhing dur khrod kyi chas klubs nas zhabs gnyis phyogs skyongs pho dor stabs su bsgrad cing: g.yas g.yon las mdzad pho nya glog ltar 'khyugs shing phyag mtshan sgrol phur re 'dril zhing rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung sna tshogs ngomajari ba gnas stong kyi thod khrag re stobs pa'o: de rgyab sgo skyong ma bzhis brin las rab 'byams thogs med du sgrub pa: gzhan yang phur srung ma mo bcu gnyis ra phyug nyer brgyad dge bsnyen nyer gcig tsha ba'i ma mo bcu gnyis rnams: mngon spyod drag po'i las la glog ltar 'khyugs shing sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i 'phrin ‘de yi phyi rol du ging liṅga dur khrod bdag po rdo rje phra min sha za ro langs lce spyang gi tshogs bsam gyis: mi khyab pa rlu ltar 'phyo zhing thog ltar 'bebs pa'o

drogs de rnams kyi thugs srog sa bon las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin 'og min gyi gnas nas 'brin las phur pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim slo: sha chen gya dud pa btang zhing gi g.yab mo 'dor rdo rje srin po' rngams glus thugs dam dbyangs nas bskul ba niḥ hū hrīX srid pa'i phur bu sgrub lags kyi: rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings nyid las: ye ges khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs: dam tshig khro mo bde ba'i sprin: za gsod las mdzad glog ltar 'khyugs: bka' sdod pho nya rlung ltar 'tshubs sngon gyi thugs dam ci bzhin du du ra khrod gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: dgyes pa'i zhal bzang bstan pa dang : skal ldan byin gyis brlabs tu gsol: nyams dang rto gas pa 'bar ba dang : don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod: tshe badz+ra ku ma ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya tswa: rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs rnams sprin ser rlung gis bskyod pa ltar nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi gang bar spyan drangs nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'dor la bstim moḥ hūṃ hrīḥ rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: ro mnyam mchod pa 'bul

(khri ba ni ko ro tsa na gangs ltar chags ma hā tsit+ta rdza ltar bsnyel rak+ta khrag chen mtsho ltar bskyil: sha sna snying sna ri ltar spub sa keng ni ri ti'i gram khrod brdal: 'dod lnga'i longs spyod sprin ltar gtibs: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i bcud chen 'khyil: 'dod yon lha mos gar dang bcas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: a la la ho bde bar rol: tshims pa mchog gi rjes chags su: snying rjes 'gal zla tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las nus mthu'i dngos grub stsol : khro badz+ra rū pa shabha ghadhe ra sa spasne me sarak+ta tsit+ta ko ro tsa na ko ni ri ti ba su ta kha kha khā hi khā hi nyu trīX rdo rje srin po bdud kyi gshed: 'jigs byed gar dgu'i dpal gyis 'byud: snying rjes 'gal zla tshar gcod pa'i sgogs med rdo rje phur par bstod: bdag mdun gyi lha rnams dang phyi nang sgod bcud kyi khro bo dang khro mo thams cad kyis drag po'i sngags sgra ti ri ri sgrogs pas khams gsum3jig rjen gyi srid pa g.yo mgal byed cing nye ru ma'i gsang ba gsum du gros gdab par bsam la tso badz+ra sko 41kai la ya sarba brispre baṃ tram̐ phaṭa: lce spyang mdur rgyugs kyi rta la drangs nas ci

dus su bzlo 31 badz+ra shī li gī la ya dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: ka rta ka ye dza ye: bhi dza ye a tsi te: a pa ra dzi te ma ra sa na mar ta na ye sarba bisnye baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: pho nya las la bskul ba 'phur rtsal rlung gi rta 'dungs nas ci nus su bzla skyid badz+ra shī li gī la ya ma rasmo yaklo kwa la du pa garma ram̐ ram̐ gnod byed kyi snying rtsa la ye ye: srog rtsa la ye ye: snying la phril phril srog la chom chom tsit+tasgog la dung dung: snying khrag shad dza: thum ri li li: snying rtseg rtsegs: 'ur 'ur shig shig: 'gul 'gul: myags myags: sod sod dha ti ma ma garma dṛ hūṃ ka ra ye ma ra sa na pramar ta na ye sarba —sne baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: spu gri so 'thab pa' sngags 'di dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus gsum gtor phyir bzla'o de nas mngon spyod drag po'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la 'jug pa ni rnal 'byor pa rnams ltaba'i gdeng bskyed: drag po' lta stangs bsgrad la 'di skad do hūṃ hū hūṃḥ sgod kyi zhing khams me ri 'bar bcud ni dpal chen khro bo'i dal: gī la ya yi rang sgra sgrogs: byams chen thugs rjephyogs lhung bral: bdud dang dgra bgegs nye mi nus: ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ tshad med snying rje'i ngang nyid las: log rtog 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal: rdo rje phur pas stong khams gang

tswakho 'byung po dam sri'i 'khrul 'khor bshigs ma shirnyi: swā puṣ+ṭi: e wa sa: ha ma ra ya bdud tri sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭa: e bskyed na e maṇ+ḍal hūṃX mdun du gsod gcod gshin rje'i bsha' ra gru gsum lcags kyi khang sgrom kha dog la mthul yangs pa dug lnga rang gshed du 'bebs pa'i mtshon thun sna tshogs 'khrugs pa: pho nya dang lce spyang pang pos sod rgyob kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgogs pa: bka'i lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi nyes bsgrags kyi drag sngags sgrogs shing nyes chad kyi yo lang 'tshubs pa'i dbus su: rjeḥdang tre ཿlas bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi ru pa mdog sngo la mdangs nyams pa: skya ba ham pa: red pa: nyams thag dbugs dang bral rlo khad 3dar phri li li byed pa: rkang lag lcags gzer gyis bsdam shing bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa: kha ngu ba mig shi mig lag pa mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can sgra gzengs shing sme sngags shub bur sgrogs pa: snying rje'i gnas su 'dug pa gcig tu gyur de'i sa bon hṝḥtriḥlas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'jin rten gyi khams thams cad nas bstan bshigs

drom po lag dmar thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas liṅga la yang yang bstim: bdag mdun las spros pa'i pho nya lcags zhags sgogs dril thogs pa grangs med pas gang na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad la 'gugs 'ching sdom myos kyi las byed par bsam:bden brjod ni na mo:rig 'dzin grub thob brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dims kyi bden pa dang : yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang : ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs /mas kyi bden pa dang :rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : bka' gsang sngags rigs sngags gzung sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthus: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs pa'i lag dmar: dam pa'i chos khrims mgogs pa'i dam nyams: dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo gtor ba'i bdud sde: ri rgya klung rgya gtor ba'i shan pa tshe dang sgog la 'tshe ba'i dam sri: chos byang chub sgrub pa la bar du

〉〉 gcod par byed pa: nyams ting nge 'dzin la bar du gcod par byed pa: sa dang lam la bar du gcod par byed pa gang yin pa thams cad rang dbang med parakhya kyi li li nag sga ra ra bye'u chung khra yis ded pa ltar lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du ming gzugs liṅgar 'di la khug cig: badz+ra e gu sha dza: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho bdun nam nyeragacig dgu sogs ga skabs brjod 'gug thung ni na lnga mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum: bden gnyis bslu med bden mthu dang : 'phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs kyis yid labarnag pa'i dgra dang bgegs: lcags kyu 'bar bas snying nas zungs stobs ldan zhags pas mgul nas ching 'chor med sgrog gis yan lag sdom blo sems dril bus myosasu chug: rlung gi maṇ+ḍal gzhir khod la: las kyi liṅga 'di la khug: 'gugs ching sdom myos phrin las mdzod: hṝḥtri ༷badz+ra adru sha dza: dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: ci rigs brjod mthar phur ba'i lasamakhan dam can ma mo bcu gnyis dang bse lcags du gi skyes bu rnams kyis dgra bgegs 'gugs 'ching sdoms phyos su byas la bros thar gab yul— bams cad dang bral bar bsam gzu dpa gsol ba ni hūṃ bye (1gas ngas

nu sa gsum sangs rgyas dang :skyabs gnas baspu med dkon mchog gsum:yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang :rgyud sde'i lha tshogs gzu dang dpung:chos skyong dregs pa pho rgyud na nga :dam can srung ma mo rgyud rnams:skyes bu ging drug gtso 'khor g.yog:nor lha gter bdag gzu dang dpung:pha lha ma lha le'u'i lha:dgra lha phrag lha lus lha dang :yul lha gzhi bdag gzu dang dpung:dza gad khrag skyems 'di bzhes la:snyan gyis gson la spyan gyis gzigs:thugs kyis dgongs la sdong grogs mdzod:bdag ni ma nyes ma lan no rang khal bsgyur du ma bcug pas:bstan dgra dam nyams sdig can la:bka' chad ston pa'i dus la babs:dgongs pa mi 'gyur lta bas gcun:ting 'dzin 'od gsal sgrom dubacug:sngags dang phyag rgya mchog la bslab:dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid bsgom:ro mnyam spyod pa lam du khyer:chos kun mnyam pa'i tshogs ston 'bul:'bras bu sangs rgyas pam byed kyang:sdig can dgra 'dres ma ster bas ye shes spyan gyis ma gzigs sam ting 'dzin thugs kyis ma dgongs ngam:mthu rtsal nus mthu mi mnga' 'am:bdag gi

lha'i skyabs mgon mi mdzad dam:gal de mgon dang skyabs mdzad na:mthu rtsal thog 'dras nus pa bskul:snyigs ma'i bu sdug mi 'dor bar:rgyu 'bras bden tha chud ma gsanaḥlog lam bdud kyi sprin rgya gtor:dgra bgegs rnam shes mar me bsnub:skye med dbyings su dgongs rgyas thob ldog med byang chub sems rtogs nas gsal ba'i snang sems chos skur sbyor:thugs dam ma g.yel rtsa ba gsum:mngon spyod dus babs sa ma ya khrag skyems dang gtor ma mchod mkhyen dpa nga ni hūṃ bh+yo rgyal kun 'phrin las 5dus pa'i dngos:thal 'byen phur ba'i lha tshogs rnams:dgongs pa'i dbyings las mkhyen par gsol:ting 'dzin mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes:ye shes gzigs pas mkhyenatha ra gsol:rin chen gser skyems 'bul lo bzhes:kun gsal snyan gyis mkhyen par gsol:snyan gsan rol mo 'bul gyis bzhes:dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer chen gdab:'khor 'das stong srog 'phrog pa la:bdud bzhis skabs blta glag tshol byung:ting 'dzin 'od gsal sgron me sbar:bying rmug rtsi dang bral ba la:ma rig rū tra mal nas

snying po dgongs pa'i zhe phug bcug:gsang sngags grub pa bzhi ldan yang 'a17 drug g.ya sa'i sgong ba 'byung:ma g.yel ma 'phang gzigs su gsol:legs nyes drangasa'abyed du gsol dza gad dga' ston 'di bzhes la:dgra bgegs gnyis la bka' chad chod mngon spyod 'brin las grub mdzod cig:thugs dam ma g.yel dus la pa:drag rtsal khyad chos 'byung bar mdzod:dza gad skyems phud gtor ma mchod dang po 'gugs pa' las la drug gis bstan dza:dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs:rdo rje srin po'i dus la pa:bka' nyan pho nya'i dus la babs:phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs:mngon spyod drag po' dus la babs:mthu rtsal byung ba'i dus la babs gnad la bskul lo dam ga dgra bgegs sdig can 'dis:sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bshigs:dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad:rgyu 'bras bden pa khyad du bsad:bsgral ba'i zhing nge sa par tshang:thugs rje thabs kyis 'dzin mdzod cig nyes bsgrags go tshad med snying rje'i ngang nyid las:pho nya lcags kyu dkar mo ni:gcig las rang 'dra 'bum phrag

spros dgra bgegs zhing bcu tshang ba rnams: rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus: las kyi liṅga 'di la phob: ro nya spro ba'o oṃ badz+ra ki li ki la ya mare ram̐: gnod byed kyi snying rtsa la ye ye: sgog rtsa la yi yeḥ snying la phril phril srog la chom chos: tsat+ta sgog la dung dung: snying khrag shad dza: thum ri shā'ur 'ur: shig shig: 'gul 'gul: myags myags sod sod: dha ti ma ma garmā shrī hūṃ ka ra ye ma ra sa na pra marta na ye bla khug: ṣ+ṭṛ tri badz+ra e gu sha dza:nga dam can thams cad dmag la sbran nas stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams nas dgra bgegs nyes pa can thams cad rang dbang med par rgya khras byeng yang thim par dmigs:ting nge 'dzin gyi nga ngo dgra bo 'dirang dbang mer par khug cig: las kyi liṅga phob cig: ma shor bar btson du zungs shig: thubya mdzod cig:dmod bor ba'o gnyis pa bcing gi las la drug gis bstan dza dam chig chen pa 'i dus la babs: rdo rje khros pa'i dus la babs: sprul pa bka'

dus la babs: drag rtsal 'phrin las dus la babs: mngon spyod mdzad pa'i dus la babs: nus mthu ston pa'i dus la babs: gnad bskul lo nyam pa can gyi dgra bgegasa'adis: dang po sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig bar du dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad: tha ma gsang sngags 'du ra bshig: 'di ni bsgral ba'i zhing yin pas: mngon spyod phrin lasaston mdzod cig: nyes bsgrag go tshad med byams pa'i rang mdangs su pho nya zhags pa ser mo ni: gcig las rang 'dra 'bum phrag spros: dgra bgegs zhing bcu tshang ba rnams las kyi zhags pas dam du chings: gzugs byang ling gar dbyer med bcing: pho nya spros ba'o oṃ badz+ra ki li gī la ya ma rasmo yasmo kwa la rū pa garma ram̐ ram̐: gnod byed kyi snying rtsa la ye she: srog rtsa la ye yiḥ snying la phril phril: srog la chom chos: tsit+ta srog la dung dung: snying khrag shad dza: thum ri li li: snying rtsegs rtsegs: 'ur 'ur: shig shig 'gul 'gul skyags myags sod sod: dha ti ma ma garmā shrī hūṃ ka ra ye ma ra sa na pra marta na ye ha sa ya ra hrī da ya ching shig: sngags gyis gzer ro phur srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams las la bskul

bas dgra bgegs gang yin pas sgo gsum 'gul mi shes par byad thag sngo dmar gyis bcing bsdam byed par mos: ti nge 'dzan gya gzer ro dgra bo 'di mi ga: sgo gsum ching shig: gru gu'i mthul du chug cig: 'chor ba'i dus med pa/ra gyis shig: dmod bor ba'o gsum pa dbye ba'i las la drug gis bstan dza dam tshig chen : khrag 'thung khros pa'i dus la babs: bka' nyan pho nya'i dus la babs rdzu 'phrul can rnams dus la babs: sbyor sgrol mdzad pa'i dus la babs: maro na dus la babs: gnad bskul lo dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can 'dis: mi dge bcu po nyam len byas dge ba bcu yi khrims sma phab: mtshams med lnga yi bsgral ba'i zhing bcu nges par tshang thugs rje thabs kyis 'dzin mdzod cig nyes bsgrags pa 'o tshad med dga' ba'i ra mad sa su: kha kha hu lu mu kha ni ser gyem 'bum 'phro: dgra bgegs zhing bcu tshang ba rnams: 'go ba'i lha srung kun dang byes: gnod byed 'dre bdud kun dang sprod: pho nya spro ba'o oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya

smo yasmo kā la rū pa garma ram̐ ram̐: gnod byed kyi snying rtsa la ye ye: srog rtsa la ye ye snying la phril phril: srog la chom chos: tsit+ta srog la dung dung: snying khrag shad dza: thum ri lisnying rtsegs rtsegs 'ur 'ur: shig shig 'gul 'gul: myags myags sod sod: dha ti ma ma garmā hṝ hūṃ ka ra ye ma ra sa na pra marta na ye dgra bo lha dang shag phyes: sngags gyis ba'o dam can ma mo bcu gnyis dang sprul pa'i pho nya grangs med pas brub khung steng nas bro 'khrab gar bsgyur mtshon thun spros pas dgra bo'i lha srung ye shes pa dbyings su 'jin rten pa ri rab kyi zom dang gling bar mun pa'i gling du bsgrad par dmigs pa: ting nge 'dzan gyis gzir ba'o dgra bo 'di lha dang phyes shig: bdud dang sprod cig: skyabasabral bar gyis shig: bye'u khras khyer ba ltar gyis shig: dmod gdab pa'o bzhi pa myos pa' las drug gis bstan dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: zhe sdang rdo rje'i dus las: bka' sdod sprul pa'i dus la babs: a bhi tsar+ya'i dus la babs: mngon spyod drag po'i dus la babs: sbyor sgrol 'phrin las dus la babs: gnad nas bskul lo ma rig

: las skyes dgra bo 'di'i:rus pa zhe sdang pha las skyes:sha khrag 'dod chags ma las grub rig pa gti mug dbang gis 'khrul:nyon mongs las la rtag tumyos bag chags can 'di bsgral ba'i gnas:nyes bsgrags so tshad med btang snyoms rang mdangs su:ljang nag myos byed dril bu ma gcig las rang 'dra ljang nag 'bum:dmanyams dgra yi gshed du chas dug khrag nad kyi char ba phob:dgra bo 'bogs shing brgyal du chug:pho nya 'gyed ba 'o oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya:ma ma rasmo yasmo:ka la rū pa garma re re/gnod byed kyi snying rtsa la ye ye:srog rtsa la chum chum:snying la phril bril:srog la chom chos:tsit+ta sgog la dung dung:snying khrag shad dza:thum ri li li snying rtsegs rtsegs:'ura'ur:shig shig:'gul 'gul:myags myags sod sod:dha ti ma ma garmā shā hūṃ ka ra ye ma ra sa na pra marta na ye ja la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya myos shig:sngags kyis mthor ba'o phur srung da ma can bcu gnyis bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis dgra bo la spyo khrag dang dug khrag gi char dbab pas sgo gsum drag tu spyo zhing 'gul mi shes par ro thang la

ltar bsam mo: ting nge 'dzin gyis gzer ro dgra bo 'di spyo bar gyis shig: 'bogs par gyis shig: 'thib par gyis shig: brgyal bar gyis shig: dmod gdab pa'o de nas phur char dbab pa la bcu las hūṃ hūṃ mi gnas chos kyi dbyings nyid las khrag 'thung rngam brjid rol pa'i sku rdo rje khros pa snying rje'i ngang: log rtog zhe sdang gdon gyis gshed / 'khrul snang dgra la gdab: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spar: he ru ka yis sras su bskyed: slo badz+ra kro dha rā dza ki la ya phaṭa gtso mchog gi phur pa gdab hūṃ dza: che ga ni dza sa chas kyang: ma rtog sems can snying re rje: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: phung po rdo rjer gtam byas nas: rnam par shes pa chos skur: skyed badz+ra ki li ki la ya: sku ya sar ngoms skyed badz+ra gī li ki la ya: gsung gi gad rgyang mdzad skyo badz+ra gī li ki la ya: gdul bya snying rjes bzung ba'o skyed badz+ra 11 ta hūṃ ka ra hūṃḥ n+dhoḥtri a'od kyi dri ma sbyangs bsod nams dwangs bcud rnal 'byor pa la bstems rnam shes phur rtser blang nas dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med par bsre 'pho bya ba ste sras mchog gi phur pa gdab pa 'o hūṃ dam chig chen

po'i dus la babs: khro rgyal khrag 'thung dus la babs nyon mongs las ngan gnas stong phyir: ye shes lnga yi khongs su dril: tshe brnya gī la ya rbad: āḥpad+ma) hūṃ badz+ra kai la ya rbad: treḥrat+na gī la ya rbad: hā garma ki la ya rbad sras lnga'i phur pa gdab shā dam tshog chen po'i dus la babs: nyon mongs las skyes dgra bo 'dis la shes pa gnas stong phyir: nyi shu rtsa gcig grong khyer la: dpal chen rol pa'i sras phur gdab: 'khrul mi shes par bsre 'pho byed: tshe badz+ra ki la ya su ru su ru phaṭa la mu ru mu ru rna ba gnyis la dz+wa la dz+wa la phrag pa gnyis la pra dz+wa la: kha la garma ram̐: sna la ma ra ya na: spyo bo dang smin mtshams la ma haṃ kwa ra: dpung pa gnyis la dha ti ma ma: blabṛ hūṃ kā ra: rkang pa gnyis la yak+ka dz+wa la: bol gong gnyis la sarba sdo(45: gshang lam dang lte ba gnyis la gī la ya: phaṭa: gsang par gdab so zla gam la gnas pa 'i sras phur nyer gcig gis

/ra pa gdab par bya oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra: dpral ba bi dza ya: snying kha ni lan+dan+t+ra: dpung g.yas ya man+ta ga: lte ba ār+ya a tsa la dbung g.yon h+ya skṛ wa mgrin pa a pa ra bla g.yas a dṛ ta kusgoli: gsang ba tre+e lo kya bi dza ya: bla g.yon ma hā bā la hūṃ phaṭa gshang lam du'o khro gas phur ba gdab po hū dza dam tshig chen po dus la babs: ye shes khro mo yang: mngon spyod drags pos dus la babs: phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon dam sri la: shes rab mtshon chen gdab par bya oṃ kro ti kha kha dpral ba mu kha snying ga tsa dun:yon gha ta: dpung g.yas hu ya: mgrin pa kha ṭaṃ gsang ba bho ṭa: bla g.yas ༄65: bla g.yon tsarnya: gshang lam su kha: lte ba ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa khro mo bcu'i kur pa gdab poḥhū dza: dam na po'idus la babs za byed pho nya glogs ltar 'khyugs: ma rig las skyes dgra bdud bgegs: thugs rjes thabs kyis bsgral bar bya oṃ badz+ra ghadzha dpral ba ha ha da hā: dpung g.yas pa tsa: lte ba bhan+taḥ dpung g.yon hu lu mgrin pa tiṣ+ṭha bla g.yas tshin+ta: gsang ba bhin+ta bla g.yon sgo ṭa: bsdam mtshams su gdab mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa za byed pha

dzaX bcu'i mtshon phur gdab hūṃ dza: dam tshog chen po'i dus la babs: gsod byed ma tshogs thog char 'bebs 'khrul snang las skyes dgra dang bgegs: skye med da byings su dgongs rgyas gdab oṃ badz+ra kro ti ghadzha: dpral bar ha na: snying kha da ha: dpung g.yas: pa tsa: lte bar bhan+ta: dpung g.yon hu lu: mgrin par ti bla khyab tshirnya: gsang bar zernya: brla g.yon: sgo ṭa: bsdam mtshams su gdab po sarba bisne hūṃ phaṭa: gsod byed ma bcu'i mtshon phur gdab: ( dza dam tshog chen pos dus la babs sgo skyong phyag rgyas dus la babs tshod med 'phrin las rlabs po che: phyogs bzhi'i dgra bgegs tshar chod cig: tshe badz+ra gī li ki la ya bid+dha ya: lag g.yas na ma sa man+ta trīng hrīng: lag g.yon su ru su ru pra su ru nga g.yon mā ra ya: rkang g.yas su gdab po sarba rū tra sha hūṃ shur hūṃ rbad sod: sgo skyong phur bu gdab po hūṃ dza: dam tshog chen po'i dus la babs: bka' sdod sprul pa'i dus la babs: shwa na bdag nyid sa bdag ma: bse lngags bung gi stes bu yis: dag dpung thal ba rngal bu rog: bgegs ste ming tsam med par mdzod: snyen badz+ra d+ma snyim ma tho 3: lca bzhi la gdab ma

rdo sa na: tshag bzhi la gdab ma rta nya ka ra: mthil bzhi la gdab pra marta na ye: 'bur bzhi la gdab sarba bisne baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: phur srung bcu drug gi phur pa gdab mchen las ni hū hūṃḥ 'jam dpal rdo ) sgon po yi: mtshon chen gcod pa'i 'khor lo yis: rten 'brel grong khyer rgyun gcod phyir: zo khog tshal ba bcu gnyis byed: ma chags pad+ma can gyis sar: bde stong zung 'jug thus su byed: sarba rū tra pra be sha ya a phaṭa: spu gris tshal bar gtub par bya ga brdung na dza: dam rtsig chen tho'i dus la babs: mthu rtsal phyungs ba'i dus la babs: bdag ni rig dzin sgrub pa pos: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob byas: dgra bdud dam sris ma ster bas: 'di la mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: khro tho 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: rdo rje tho bas brdung byas nas: lha yang rung ste rdul du rlog: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis tshe badz+ra gī li gī la ya dgra bgegs ta thā ya ta thā ya ska ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa: dmar spring ni dīḥ lcang mor bcas pa'i bhan+ta phu nyong mongs bsgral ba'i khrag mtsho bskyil 'khor ba dbyings su stong bya'i phyir: dpal chen tshogs kyi zhal du

'bul: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bstab pa ni sno dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang : yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: sras dang ye shes khro bo bcu: za gsodabazhi la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngams pa'i rkan sgra bcas te rol: 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo chos skur shig: ma hā me sa khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: maspyo ma hā ko ro tsa na khā hi: ma hā ke ni ri ti khā hi: ma hā ba su ta khā hi bcol gtad ni hūṃ dpal chen khro bo rol pa'i dal bdud 'dul phur pa'i lha tshogs la: dgrago lus rgyan bcas gtad: dam du zung la mi 'chor bar chos kyi dbyings su bsre 'pho mdzod: bh+yo gdab ni bh+yo rang byung bstan pa'i snying po la: bdag cag zhugasapags kyang: dgra bdud dam sris ma ster bas: 'di la drag po bh+yo yis thob: lha klu gnyan gyi dmod mthu yang nyam pa'i dgra bo 'di la bh+yo: lus ngag yid gsum

padzad pas: dgra dpung brlag par gyis shig: bgegs dpung gzhom par mdzod cig: mtha' mi'i dmags sna bzlog cig: dus kyi 'khrugs pa gzhom shig: mtshon cha'i rno ra rdul zhig: sna tshogs brgyur cig mu ge'i rgud pa sol cig bkra mi shes pa'i phyogs rnams thul zhig sngags pa rgyal bas dpa' rtags 'byung bar mdzod cig rgyal khams bdeskyed rdzogs ldan ltar 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig: de ltar drag po mngon spyod las gnad kyi rdzong 'phrang srog ldan pas dus bzhir nyamasasu blang ba'i mthus rtog pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang thugasarje gzhan rgyud grol ba'i thabs snyang rjes bsgral bas dam tshag yan 'og mas skyon du blta mi dgos gsal ba gsum gyi so ma nyams tshad med rnam bzhis chingasam chad log sdug 'byams gsum mtha' la gtad 'tshengs ba lnga dang rdon gyur na bsad bsad 'dren pa'i sangs rgyas yin 'di yi dam tshag ma srung na sngags pa dam las cis mi nyams de bzhin mngon spyod thugs dam mdzod thal 'byin phur bu mtshon du brten bdag med ral gri so byung gyis nu ga gsum thub pa'i e khaṃ 'chongs zhing bcu thugs rje thabs kyis zungs bsad pa chos skur 'pho rgyas 'debs pad+ma'i rgyud 'dzin dam ldan yin sa ma mā e ma kho mo mtsho rgyal thugs dam 'di gnam skas brag dang ldang lha'i

:|dzo brag seng ge'i brag gsum las sbas pa'i gter gyi bcud du sbas pa yin mkha' spyod dpal rar pheb pa'i nyin thugs kyi ti ka bu mo 'dis mthang shog la ni gser gyis bkod mkhar chu'i a tsar nag por gtad dus kyis snyigs mar gyur pa na kho bo sngags pa gcag da 'phrad 'gro don 'phrin las bsam mtha' yas sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya lang gros sprul pas rgya bkrol bas dus kyi rgud tshogs zhi ba'i rten 'brel du gyur cig sarbamosgo 'a ma

dzakhri phur pa lha nag spu gri'i 'khor lo las bzlog pa rkyen snang tshar gcod mtshon cha'i tsakra bzhugs dzakhri na mo gu ru shrī kro ta rā dza ya:྅hāglasgothodzotswabye6yi dus kyi snyigs mar gyur ba na mi srin gdug pa 'i mgo 'pha nga mtho nad mug maza cha'i gzengs pa lang bzlog byed thabs 'ad gces par zungs sa ma yā gtor gzhung ma tram̐ bris pa'i khar gtor ma gtso 'khor rdzogs par bkod khra thabs gtor nag rtsa mtshes brgyan gdugs dang ru mtshon 'jigs rngams bya bdag mdun bskyed bzlas bskang gsol byed mngon spyod drag po' las gzhung bsring bsgral stabs grub rjes bzlog pa ni rngams pa'i yus kyis brjod par bya hūṃ sbyong gru gsum mabyang nag e yi klong dkyil nas dpal chen yongs 'dus rdo rje gzhon nu ni:mthing nag khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud:g.yas dkar g.yon dmar sku gsum lhun gyis grub smra smin me 'bar mthing sngon ral ba brdzis:rdo rje gtsug rgyan dur khrod dpal chas klubs:ye shes drug ldan phyag gi dkyil 'khor las:phar phyin mdzad ston phyag 'tshan rnam lnga 'chang zhabs bzhi bsgrad pas skye bzhi kha lo

bsgyur: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog hūṃ du 'bar: gzung 'dzin dbyings bsregs me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs sbyor ba'i yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril mthing skya ut+pal dung khrag yab la stobs: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang srid zhi gnyis med rol: in+t+ra'i ral 'phyang thod sbrul zhing lngags spras: gnyis med mnyam rol drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs: 'phrin las lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal bstod: sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mtha' mi kla sgo'i rdzas sbyor rbod gtong bzlog: ljang nag gru gsum e yi klong dkyil du: zhing bcu log 'dren dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i khar thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra ki la ya: mthing nag mi sdug khros pa'i rnam 'gyur can: phyag bzhi tho ba spu gri lcags kyu dang : gdab pa'i mtshon chen phur ba dgra la 'gril: khro chung las mdzad mang po glogs ltar 'khyugs sbyor sgrol mngon spyod las la rnam par dgyes: tshad med thugs rje'i zhal gyis gdul bya 'dzin: dbal ni lcags phur me yi tsha tsha 'phro rtse mo e nyid stong pa 'dren stobs ldan srid par

dza 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad kun: thabs kyis bsgral ba'i skal dang mi ldan yang: shugs kyis 'dren pa'i 'phrin las tshad med gter: sras mchog gī la ya la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la byad phur sri bdud mtha' dmag bzlog tu gsol phyogs bcur gnam lcags 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas dbang phyug chung ma phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i khar hūṃ shar sgra 'byin phag dang smig bu'i mgo: yang sprul khro chung nam mkha'i mthar mnyam pas: lha gdon la sogs byad phur rbod gtong bzlog: khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal ba ni: rdo rje snyems ma stag dang bya rgod mgo: me long ye shes klong nas 'dir byon la: dri za la sogs byad phur rbod gtong bzlog khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po ni: rdo rje sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo chos nyid klong las gnas 'dir sku bskyed la: me lha la sogs byad phur rbod gtong bzlog: khro bo chen po gshin rje'i gshed po ni dur khrod bdag mo sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo mnyam nyid ngang las thugs rje'i rtsal g.yos la: gshin rje la sogs byad phur rbod

gtong bzlog khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon po ni dgyes bskyed gtun khung gzig dang khā ta'i mgo: bde chen rol pa'i klong las 'dir byon la srin po la sogs byad phur drod gtong bzlog khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal po ni:rdo rje gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo: sor rtogs dbyings las thugs rje thabs kyis bzhengs chu lha la sogs bya phur rbod gtong bzlog:khro bo chen po 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni:dgyes skong mda' snyems spyang ku khra yi mgo:thogs med stobs dang ldan pas 'dir byon la:rlung lha la sogs byad phur rbod gtong bzlog khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ni dgyes bskyed rlung 'byin seng ge pha waṃ mgo:nan tan chen po'i ngang las 'dir byon la:gnod sbyin la sogs byad phur rbod gtong bzlog khro bo chen po kham gsum rnam par rgyal:dgyes skong gsod byed dom dang sre mong mgo: bya ba mthar phyin klong nas 'dir byon la dbang ldan la sogs byad phur drod gtong bzlog:khro bo chen po stobs chen rgyal po ni:skul byed chen po dred dang byi ba'i mgo:mngon spyod lhun grub klong nas 'dir byon la: sa bdag la sogs byad phur

tswakho rbod gtong bzlog: khyed rnams sngon tshe ma tram̐ bsgral ba'i dus: log rtog gdul dka' 'dul ba'i tha tshig bzhin: do nub ma tram̐ bsgral ba'i gnas 'dibyon: dug gsum rnam dag gtor ma 'di bzhes la phyogs bcu'i gdon gyi yo lang 'khrul 'khor dang : rgya 'dre srin po mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog: dkyil 'khor khyamal gnas pa'i tha tshig can: bdag nyid chen mo 'jigs pa'i mgo brnyan can: re ti mched bzhi dus bzhi'i gnas nyul ma sa bdag bse yi bu mo drod 'dzin bzhi: tsha ba tsha shom mo bcu gnyis bcas rdo rje phur ba'i bka' 'khor dam mnos ltar: da lta rnal 'byor sgru po'i grogs su byon: khrag skyems thugs mthun gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbagegs dam sri'i g.yo ba byad mar bzlog: gnam sa phyed kyi bdag po dung gi ging gnam lcags ma la ya nas lcags kyi ging: gzas po'i sgog dbugs sdud pa zangs ging: legs nyes shan drang 'byed pa'i tā ki rgyal: 'phrin las pu shud gang ga srin bya khra: dge bsnyen nyer gcig sdong lha mched gsum dang : dbang phyug nyer brgyad dge bsnye

snying dkrung btsad:'byung po sna yon sa bdag gdug pa bzhi sngon gyi dam bzhin sgrub pa mchog la 'dus:dam rdzas skyems mchod gtor ma 'di bzhes la:phyogs bzhi'idamag dang smon log dgra bgegs bzlog:thams cad zhi zhing stong par mdzad du gsol:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las mi g.yel bar:dus 'dir phun tshogs grub paramadzad du gsol:sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo:bzlog bzlog khro bh+yo dus gsum sangs rgyas 'phrin las gcig rdzogs pa:khro bo che btsan ye shes ga ru ṭa:thog med rdzu 'phrul stobs kyisa'adir byon la:'dod yon lnga yi gtor ma dgyes par bzhes:rnal 'byor rten 'brel nyams snang nyes tshogs bzlog byad dang byur sri gtad khram g.yo ba bzlog sa nad me'abar gnyan nad chu khol bzlog:gegs 'bras skran rigs lhog pa skrang lo bzlog:mdze dreg grum bu chu ser nad rnams bzlog:mo rtsis rmi ngan than dang cho 'phrul bzlog:nagapo sum spril rkya ya rgyugs 'gyel bzlog:rgyu bshal rgya 'brum phol rmug gnyan rims bzlog:nad gdon bkra mi shis pa'i phyogs rnams bzlog:snang srid 'jig rten khams

8 9 rnams bh+yo yis thob: ba dan rtse gsum brdab pas lha srin 'dul pho mo ma ning gdon rnams thal bar bzlog: mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grub mdzod cig: 11 ga 〈co ṭa hūṃ phaṭa: sa ma yā rje bh+yo: bachosag bachosag: 'ad yis mi bzlog gang ya med byad ma 'bum thub gdam pa yan nus pa sa gnam lcags thog kyang bzlog pha lam yin ya 'a ga par nges bka' 'di phur srung rnams la gnyer dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhig sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya zhes pa'ang slob bu dhe wa'i shog gu' mthun rkyen bcas te bskul ba da sgrub pa zab mo'i cha lags du nye bar mkho phyir nus ldan mkha' spyod gling pa sa ye shes kyi 'phrul brda las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa na lung zin me cas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma la
86 dam tshas thugs kyi gter kha las phur pa lha nag spu gri 'khor lo'i zor las gnam lcags thog gi mde'u dgra bo'i snying 'byin dmar po bzhugs so:

lhakhri na rmo gu ru shrī kro ta rā dza ya: ge/sa/za/shā sgo1 mi bsrun khros pa'i gad rgyang can gdug pa bdud kyi dpung tshogs 'thar 'jags byed dus mtha'i me lta bus bsreg la 'dud mngon spyod drag po' gzhung bsrings nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum mthar phyin nas smad las dug phur nag po dang bsgral gzhung mtshon cha'i 'khor lo ltar bzlog pa'i 'phran las tshad them tshe:bskul ba ni hūṃ dza: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo sems can don la bskul: mdzod cig mdzod cig mngon spyod phri khrag skyems gtor ma'i yo byad phun tshogs sgrubs mi mngon chos dbyings gshegs bzhud bral ba nas: rgyal kun 'phrin las gsum bsdus he ru ga rdo rje ga 'khor gsum ldan dal: dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings las g.yo med kyang: rnam rol thugs rjes gzigs pa nub med par: che ba'i stobs bskyed gar dgu'i nya3ye shes khro bo'i tshogs spros nam mkha' gang : dam tshig khro mo'i tshogs kyis stong khams 'gengs khro chung las byed bar snang rdul ltar 'khrigs: rlag byed mtshon

sgo'i ltar khol: sna tshogs thun gyi bu yug skyogs ltar 'thor: za byed lce spya tshogs ni bu yug 'tshubs: shā phaṭaXsod rgyob sgra ni 'brug stong ldir:pa'i khams rnams g.yo 'gul byed: do nub mngon spyod las la gtor zor bskul: phur srung dam can rgya mtshos lhag par gzigs: gtang rag khrag skyemabazhes la: thun sna zor sna dmag sna dgra la ya: thad lang zhing bcu tshang ba ma gtogs pas nyes med snying rje'i gnas la dbal mi gtad: yo drang bden rdzun thob: spu gri'i mthar dgra bgegs byad ma'i bla tshe srog gsum la thun ya zor ya phob dza: shes rab gzhu mo blang la e: ya mchog stong pa chos kyi dbyings: ma mchog dal: rgyud ni zung 'jug byang chub sems: gzhu skud ye shes lnga yi lam: dug lnga'i yul la thugs rje 'jug: de ring gsang sngags rgyal po dgugs: phur srumachog bsten: phur pa'i lha tshogs grogs la sbran: thugs dam ma g.yel dus la babs: shar du phra men khra sgro can spri te shā tshad med snyeng rje'i rang bzhin can: rje

yis brgyan: mngon spyod las la thogs pa med: zhes sdang dgra la shag shag dza: lho ru 'ug sgo can spring te rdi tshad med byams pa'i rang bzhin can: las byed chen mo 'ug rgyan can /mngag pa'i yul la thogs pa med nga rgyal dgra la brang tshal rbad nub tu pha waṃ sgro can spring te niḥ tshad med dga' ba'i rang bzhin can: pho nya chen mo 'phur rgyan can bang rtsal mabul rno ngar bcas: 'dod chags dgra la pra dun shag: byang du bya rog sgo can spring te swā tshad med btang ste mas rang bzhin can : mgyogs ma bya rog rgyan can khyed: glog lasamagyogs pa'i bang rtsal bcas: phrag dog dgra snying shag tshal gtub: ster du gasgo' sgro can spre te hū byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las: rten 'byung bslu ba med pa'i mda' chosadabyings nam mkha'i sang la spreng: gti mug 'khrul pa'i sgong rgya gtor: 'og phyogs su glags sgro can spreng te phaṭa: rdo rje khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: mtshon chen shes rab thogs medamada' nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i sems can gyi kun bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor chos skur bzhigs: hūṃ badz+ra pra mo ha tshal tshal shag shag srog tig rbad: pha rol phyin drug mdzad pa yis rigs

dzaX drug sems can gnas nasa'adren nyon drug 'khrul ba kha lo bsgyur ye shes drug gi dgongs klong sbyor sa ma wā dgra bgegs dam sri'i lisgo de ri bong thod pa ra bcug nas dgod 'gugs 'ching sdomamyos dbye las gzir de nas phur thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo dus gsum sangs rgyas gzi dang dpang: phur pa'i lha tshogs dpang por bzhugs dam can rgya mtsho dmag la sbran: yul lha ba zhe bdag grogs su chas mngon spyod drag po'i phur zor 'di gnam lcags zhun ma las byung zhing : khrag zhag thal tshom rtags su bkod: dug gsum gdon gyi gshed du bsngags/mtshon cha sna tshogs tshwa tshwa 'phro: dug dang khrag gis ngad pa g.yo lce spyang mang po sha la rub: stong khams 'gengs bar byed pa'i zer: nyes med yongs la mi 'phen no: smon logadagra bdud dam sri la: btab pas mgo 'gas snying yang tshig: lus sems rgya phrol rdul du rlog: spu gri'i sngags mthar dgra bdud dam sri smon log pho mo'i sgog snying la phob dza phobadza: yi zor gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo: lha rnams thams cad gzu dang dpang: 'jig rten dregs pa dmag la sbran: brtan skyongs mo sman grogs su chas: nyung zor thog gi mde'u 'di: ging

rdo skar mda' bzhen du chad: geng nag thog ser bzhin du 'tshubs: dug zer tshwa la thor thor 'phro: rgya 'dre srin po'i rigs can dang : 'byung po dam sri'i tshogs la 'ang dang gsod pa dus mnyam nas: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol sbu gri'i sngags mthar dgra bdud dam sri smon log pho mo'i srog snying la phob dza phob dza: khrag zor gdab pa ni ma tho mkha' 'gro gzu dang dpang: brtan ma bcu gnyis grogs su chas sha za ma tshogs las la rgyugs: rten 'brel gnas stong khrag zor 'di: bskal ba'i me las da nga: gtor byed rlung las zer ngar 'khrigs: pha rol mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog: las pa las la bskul bar byed ling pa ling la hab rgyugs rol: byad ma stong thub 9 'di smon log dam sri bdud la 'deb: lus ngag yid gsum tshal bar gtubs: rnam shes 'khrul ba bral bar sbyor: mngon spyod 'phrin las dus la babs: spu gri'i snga dgra bdud dam sri smon log pho mo'i sgog snying la phob dza phob dza: mtshe zor gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo: dregs pa'i dmag tshogs gzu dang dpang sde dpon bco brgyad grogs la cha

:she pho nya yang g.yog dmag la sbran: mtshe mda' las kyi thun zor 'dis: rtse na ye shes me dpung 'bar: bar na bskal ba'i rlung nag 'tshubs: 'dab na dugachu thog ltar khol: sri bdud dam sri'i snying la 'deb: lus sems gnyis kyi rgya phrol nas: rnam par shes pa chos skur bsre phung po lhag ma med pa ra brlag: mngon spyod dragapo'i dus la babs spu gri'i sngags mthar dgra bdud dam sri smon log pho mo'i srog snying la phob dza phob dza dug zor gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo ma hā ka la gzu dang dpang: dregs pa sde brgyadalas la chas: snang srid lha 'dre dmag la sbran: dug zor nad kyi rkyal ba 'di: dbal ngar gnam lcags thog las che: rno nus dug gi rlang pa 'thul: mthong reg zer tsam btabapa na: phung po bsreg cing tshal bar 'thor: rnam par shes pa rten med byed: de nis chos sku'i dgongs par bsre: mngon spyod phran las de ltar sgrub: spu gri'i sngags mthar dgrabadud dam sri smon log pho mo'i srog snying la phob dza phob dza: ru tso snying zor gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo: he ru ka dpal gzu dang dpang: zhi khro rab 'byams grogs su chas: dbang byug ma

tshogs las la chas: ma tram̐ bsgral ba'i snying zor 'di'i: rtse na lha dmag bu yug 'tshubs: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i 'khrul 'khor bskor: bar na gnyan dmag thog ltar khol thun gyi 'khrul 'khor 'phrul bsgyur 'gyed: 'og na klu dmag mtsho ltar khol nad rlang dug rlang bu yug 'tshubs: dregs pa'i dmag gis 'tshubs ma 'khrugs: kun kyang mngonaspyod las la chas: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bdud bgegs: dam sri phung bar byed pa'i rigs: ming tsam med par rdul du rlog lus kyi ri bo tshal bar thong: ngag gi na bunamakha' la gtor sems rtog kun gzhi'i mun pa sangs: he ru ka dpal thugs dang bsre mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod: spu gra'i sngags mthar dgra bdud dam sri smonalog pho mo'i srog snying la phob dza phob dza: spu gris ri bong mdzes dkar gzugs dang bcas ba tshal bar galo la hū bh+yo: nga ni mi g.yo mgon po ste: ye shes khro bos nam mkha' gang dam tshig khromos sa gzhi khyab khro chung las byed bu yug 'tshubs kun kyang mngon spyod las la bzhengs mtshon chen ye shes ral dri 'di: rtse mo ram las me dpung 'bar: dbang chen rta

tswa khri mgrin khro rdul 'khrigs rked par ye las rlung nag 'tshubs: 'khrul snang lag na rdo rjes bshigs brtsa bar baṃ las rgya mtsho khol 'ja nus srid rtsa gcod: spu gris so ngar thog las rno: byad ma 'bum brlag mtshon thun 'khrugs: dgra la rbad de tshal bar gtub: bgegs la gdab po rdul du rlog:ming med kyis: mngon spyod phrin las lhun grub cing drag po chen po'i drag rtsal grub a bhi tsār+ya'i las mdzod cig: spu gri'i sngags mthar dgra bdud dam sri smon snying la phob dza phob dza mdun bskyed gtor chen bzor la hūṃ bye nga nigang shar rang grol he ru ga: thal 'byin 'phrin las stobs rdzogs ku ma ra las byed phur sru'aphro 'gyed: do nub gtor zor sdang ba'i dgra la rdeb: sngags kyi nus pas tshe srog tshal bar gtubs: ma tram̐ rū tra'i srung gur gnas mal gzhom: lus sems bacha'i 'khal 'khor bsor: ngag bangang ngam si ming tsam meng par bzob: ngag la che ba'i khang chos zal khams sogs mngor song ngas po'i mtha la thos la

pa'i dpa' rtags rgyal rnga kun tu ldir chos skyong dgyes pa'i gad mo lhag lhag ngoms:gzas po'i khams gsum 'khor ba stong par mdzod:spu gro'i sngags mthar dgra brdodam sri smon log pho mo'i srog snying la phob dza phob dza:dmod bcol bsdus pa ni ho:'gro ba'i skyabs mgon pad+ma rgyal po'i bka' tha tshig la gnas pa'i phur srungs ma mo bcu gnyiskyes bu sde dpon sum cu:'jigs byed dregs pa bco brgyad 'dzam gling brtan ma bcu gnyis rdo rje gsang ba'i dam sgog can khyed rnams kyis:ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dṛgazigs:ting nge 'dzin thugs rjes dgongs:mngon par shes pas mkhyen par gsol:bso dmar chen khrag gi skyems 'di la rol:sha khrag rus pa'i gtor ma la stobasmre sngags gdung ba'i yus tshig 'di la gson:bdag rnal 'byor ba'i blo phug ni dkon mchog gsum la gtad:srog snying o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang zhal mi gnyis ngarje btsun bla ma la gtug:bka' bzhin bsnyen sgrub snying po'i nye lam la gnas:khyed chos skyong srung ma grogs su brten sngags kyi don rtags lus la 'chang:bshad rji

dzaX bstan pa'i gzhi bzungs: 'gro ba'i bde skyid ci nus su spel ba la: bstan dgra sdig po can mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung langs nas ma ster bas: 'di lanyes chad sna dgu'i char ba phob cig: rgya 'dre gdug pa'i 'khrul 'khor gzhom zhig: smon log sde dgu'i lus srog phrol zhig: lho byang sngon po'i dug sna bsgyur cig: dam sri nagamo'i ral ba chod cig: phung byed mgo dgu'i mig rtsa gcus shig: dam sri gdug pa'i tsit+ta gtub shig: rgya 'dre me zhon la chu thog rgyob cig: 'byung po rlung zhon la rgyog dbalaphob cig: sa rdo'i rta mchog 'gro shes gzhom zhig: lcags kyi bya pho 'phur shes rgya mtshor bsgrubs shig: mi min sngon po'i mgo bo rdog pas non zhig: mngon spyod drag po' khyadachos myur du ston cig ho: bsad bsad chos skur bsre ba'i rnal 'byor bas drag po mngon spyod kyi mdzad pa mtha' ru phyin nas: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar shar: semasacan gyi bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi snang ba: rnal 'byor ba'i chos srid gza' skar ltar du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'brin las dam pa 'byung bar gyur cig: a la la lha rgyal lo: gtor

brdung bya zhing khrag skyems rdeb sgra bsigs dmod bor thal mo sdeb dgra dpung pha lam yin yang 'jigs bgegs dpung brag nga ltar yang bshigs nus mthu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam bskal ba'i me las dbal ngar tsha bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma shā rgyal kun 'phrin las chig rdzogs pa'i phur ba lha nag spu gri' sheng thog mtha' bar gsum las mtha' bcas kho mo'i srog gi ti ka yin gces pa snying las btsa' shes gyis 'dodasred can la ma shor zhig phur srung rgya mtshos thub par srungs sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring nas pheb pa'i phur ba lha nag 'di mkhas grub rat+na gling pas phur pa sbu gri'i zab don bsdu pa logs su bkod par snang ngo sems can gyi bde skyid spel phyir kho bo nus ldan mkha' spyod gling pa sa 'gags med mkha' 'gro'i bdo las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin mi tras bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lo

(kho rnal 'gror pa'i rgyal dbyangs ni (ཿ mngon spyod las byed rnal 'byer pas: snang grags rig gsum lhar shes nas: sgyu lus rdo rje phur par sgrubs: khro tshogs go cha'i dpal du bzhengs: khams gsum zag pa rdul tsam dag: bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor grub: pha sngags pa rgyal ba'i rgyal rtags yin: bdud bzhis mi tshug dpa' bo nga: rtog pas bdag bsgral ngo mtshar che bya chub sems kyi phur pa'i gdangs: sras mchog badz+ra ki la shar nyong mongs dug lnga'i dgra bo bsgral: ye shes lnga yi khongs su brub: thal 'byin mngon spyod las la dbang: phur pa sras kyi dkyil 'khor grub pha sngags pa rgyal ba'i rgyal rtags yin: 'gro ba drug gi g.yang sa stong: thugs rjes gzhan bsgral ngo mtshar che: 'khor 'das srid pa phur bur shar ye shes khro bos nam mkha' gang: dam tshig khro mos sa gzhi gang: khro chung rdo rje'i rdul du spros: snang gsum srid zhi'i zag pa zad: dge dang mi dge'i mi g.yo grol: phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor grub: pha sngags pa rgyal ba'i rgyal rtags yin: ma rig 'byul ba'i dgra gsum sod bdag

gzhan gnyis med ngo mtshar che: ma tram̐ log pa'i ral ba bcing: thal 'byin phur pa mtshon du brten dug gsum brub pa'i e khaṃ 'chang: log sdug mtha' gtad man ngag 'dzin bsad bsad chos skur bsre 'pho byed: pha sngags pa rgyal ba'i rgyal rtags yin rdo rje khros pa'i bro zhig brdung: me long ye shes gar chen bsgyur: skye 'gags bral ba'i glu dībye pa ༷r+sha :ldaṭ+wāṃ pa/ ṭ+wāṃ~X ༷ byāb don rtags yin: su ma mgu yang zhe blo bde: don kun grub pa'i rgyas rnga brdung rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo: phur nag gi rgyal dbyangs 'ad byams los

phur pa la nag las dngos grub bzhengs gsol gdab pa ni sbos bsregs rol mo snyan pa' glu da bcas te hūṃ dza bzhengs thegag bzhengs chagag rnga yab gling nas bzhengs: bskul 31 min gnas nas bskul: bskyod cig bskyod cig mkha' spyod gling nas bskyod: rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging laṅga: thal 'byin phur pa'i phyag rgyar rab bdag cag mos ldan sgrub mchog pho mo la: dngos grub mchog gi nyi ma sbar du gsol: bsnyen sgrubs bsgom bzlas kha skongs bcas mthar phyin: da ni thugs rje bar: myur bar dgongs pa'i klong las rtsal bskyed la: phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag 'tshan rnam pa yis: bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas dang yo byad la: grub pa mchog tshan bzang ston tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin mchog thob pa'i mchog dang thun mongs gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol: zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma wā: zhes sngags mthar kā ya sidhi tshe: wak+ka sidhi ā: tsit+ta sidhi hūṃ: sarba sirnyi hrī: brgya rtsa brjod la stong tshig gas mchod bstod bya tho ra sa 'ad lta ra snyan gsan bya kye: spyo na che dngos grub

/ dbang bskur byin brlabs dgongs pa can: srid pa rdo rje 'khor bcas dpal: gnyis med mnyam spyor he ru da: 'og min gnas nas dgongs pa bskyod: deng sang 6ra la nye dngos grub sprin phung ci bzhin gtibs nyams rtog nyi zla'i 'od ltar sbor grub pa'i rtag mtshan brgyad la 'byor: mchog gi dngos grub lha dang mnyam:sa mar smin pa'i rgyu he ru ka dpal mchog thob mdzod rtsa sngags mthar dngos grub bskul sngags btags nas ci 'grub brjod la rol ba'o sman mchod na dngos grub kyi rdzas de las da zer dbang mdog lcags kyu lta bus bskul te: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal yon dwangs bcud ma lus pa bsdus nas bhan+ta stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du /ra dmar mthing ga'i rnam pa 'bru gsum yi ge'i tshul du 'dus par dmigs la rtsa sngags mthar skyed sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta spe pra be sha ya a be sha ya a ā:rjes su gu gul bdug shā bzha'i sngags dang gha ta ya sder ma'i sngags kyis bsgrad khro bcu'i sngags kyas srung rgyas gdab pa ra byas la shā ā hūṃ: chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen de mchod do oṃ ā (: long

rdokho sku rdo rje sems dpa' de mchod do oṃ ā /: sprul sku lag na rdo rje de mchod do oṃ ā 〉: bre ze'u bha haste de mchod do oṃ ā /: gu ru rdo rje thod 'phreng de mchod do oṃ ā /: dgyes sde ye shes mtsho rgyal de mchod do oṃ ā nyu: phur thogs sangs rgyas ye shes de mchod dothan ā&: gnub ban nam mkha'i snying po de mchod do oṃ ā hūṃ 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug de mchod do oṃ ā nyu: mkhon rje klu yi dbang po de mchod do oṃ ā hūṃ: a tsar dpal gyi gzhon nu de mchod dotsan a3: lang gro dkon mchog 'byung nas de mchod do oṃ ā hūṃ: rje 'bangs paṇa grub rgya mtsho de mchod do oṃ ā 〉: phur pa sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin de mchod dotsan ā/ bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma de mchod do oṃ ā hūṃ: 'phrin las phur pa'i dkyil 'khor de mchod do oṃ ā hūṃ: sras mchog badz+ra gī la de mchod do oṃ ā (: phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor de mchod dotsan ā& bka' nyan pho nya'i lha tshogs de mchod do oṃ a hūṃ: byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma de mchod dotsan āhūṃ dngos grub gter mdzad yi dam de mchod dotsan ā hūṃ: bdestong dpal blun mkha' 'gro de

mchod do oṃ ā :: 'phrin las kun sgrub dam can rgya mtsho de mchod do o ā hū 'dor 'das mnyam nyid rgyal ba'i zhing mchog de mchod do oṃ ā hūṃ skabs 'dir bshags pa gang rung gi ༵jug nyubadz+ra sa ma mā dza dang yi brgya nyer gcagaḥ phud rtsa gsum la stobs dngos grub kya zhal gso tshogs pa yongs la 'gyed cing dngos grub mchog gi ya mtshan dam pa thob pa ra bsam mo 'di yang cha lag su nusaldan pas

dza dngos grub bskul ba ni ho: bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dang : thal 'byin srid pa phur bu bdag sgrub kyis rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po dang bcas nas: 'phur ldan gshog pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i stobs: sa 'og gter mthong rdzu 'phrul rkang mgyogs sogs: thun mong grub pa brgyad kyi dngos grub gter: ma 'khyang myur bar rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: gī la ya yi brin las stobs rdzogs shog zhes dang ho: lha klu drang srong rig pa 'dzin: bdud rtsi sman dang rig sngags grub: kun kyang sngon gyi dam dgongs la: 'ja' 'byugs dri bzang me tog bcas: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi gang: gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang skur: mchog thun dngos grub char ltar thob: sirnyi pha la oṃ aX hūṃ trīX dngos grub ya mtshan chen po thob pa ra bsam mo 'ad yang nus ldan dpa' bos so

dza ༷ lo rgyus sna ba dbang sdud ni bdag nyid chen po rdo rje bsregag rgod rtsal gyis dus snyigs ma lnga yi tshe sems can rnams sdug bsngal zhing nyams thag pas gdung ba drag po zhig gis mnar ba'i dus 'byung 'gyur du gzigs nas: 'gro ba blo rtul rnams kyis nang nas skyes pa'i snying la pho 'dre zhugs bu med kyi snying la mo 'dre zhugs: byis pa'i snying la the'u rang zhugs: ban+de'i snying la rgyal 'gong zhugs spyi mthun snying la rgya 'dre zhugs: the'u rang bla mar byed dus bod khams shin tu sdug bsngal ba'i skabs 'byung ba la zhi dab rgyas pa'i phrin las kyis gdul bar gzigs nas: las can rje 'bangs rnams kyis nang nas lang gro lo tsā ba dkon mchog 'byung nas dang mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mo: rdo rje bdud 'joms: dzña na ku ma: be+e ro tsa na: g.yu sgra snying po: rdo rje spre'u chung sogs nyer gcig la gnas chen gnam rdzong brag gi phug par byi nang gsang ba'i tshogs ston rgya cher spro skabs: thugs kyi yang zhun 'brin las mngon spyod kyi lha: bi to ta ma la'i zab bcud: phur pa lha nag gsang ba spu gri'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba gces nor dang rgud

gsos dpal du gnang ngo: lha 'di ni mi shigs pa'i rdo rje ste bdud bzhi dang dgra gsum g.yang sa drug gi nyes pa nye mi nus pa dang : mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje ste dug gsum dang 'khora'adas gnyis chos su bsgyur bcos gang yang mi dmigs pa dang : mi 'gags pa'i rdo rje ste 'phrin las nus mthu gang la bskul kyang thogs med du 'jug pa tshad pa'i nad la ga thur gyis rgyas theb pa dang 'dra'o: phur pa ste chos kyis dbyings spros mtha' thams cad dang bral ba las ma g.yos bzhin du chos can gyi snang ba gang la yang phyag rgyas rnam par btab pa la bya'o: gzhon nu zhes pa ste ye shes snying rje chen po 'di skye 'gags 'gyur ba med par log lam phyin ci log tu 'khrul ba dbang med du kha 'khyol ba la thabs mang da ga' ba med par rol gar bsgyur bas cha nas so 'phrin las kyi lha ste srid pa dbyings su ma stong bar he ru ga'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa mi nus pa'i cha nas btags pa'o: phur tha rdo rje gzhon nu de nyid lha nag gi phyag rgyar bzhengs pa'i don ni: snyigs ma'i gdul bya'i blo sems nag cing spyod pa nag po: chos la gshe ba: sdig la rngams pa na rag

86 sgrub pa rnams thugs rje chen po'i yar bar 'dor ma spob par phur pa lha nag gi dkyil 'khor du bstan pa yin: gsang ba zhes bya ba dus gsum gyi rgyal bas ma gsung mi gsung gsung bar dka' ba'i man ngag zab la rno nus dang ldan pas cha nas so: spu gri zhes pa gang la gdab kyang rno nus ngar stobs mthu byin tshad med pa dang ldan pas cha nas mtshan du gsol ba lags so: 'di lta bu'i sgrub pa zab mo ya : da lta bsags sbya sa spel gsum tshad du 'byel bar byos shigs: de nas dgyes sde mos brda yi ris su thob la ldang lha gnyen po mched gsum bar bka' gtsig gi phyag rgyas sdom la mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring du sbas rgya thob dang : dus snyigs mar nad mtshon mu ge'i gzengs pa lang pa'i skabs su lang gro lo tsā ba'i sprul pa las can gcig dang 'phrad nas gdul bya'i rgud pa skyobs par 'gyur ro: zhes gsung so: rje 'ab sa rnams kyis tshom bu tshogs sgrub mdzad nas mchod tshogs rgya cher spros: bsags spel bka' ltar byung rjes brda ris su bkod nas gu ru rin po che'i bka' ltar skrub par byas la rin chen gter du phyag rgyas btab po: mthar

rten 'brel dus la bab tshe chos kyi bdag po rdo rje'i ming gi cod pan can sngags kyi dbang phyug dam pa de nyid kyis tshogs ston rgya cher lho brag mkhar chu'i dgon par phul du gzhugs pa dang : bal mo ting ting ting lo sman gyis sngar gnas rjes su dran par brdas bskul ba dang : dus kyi ru 'dzing rtsod pa'i gzengs pa rnams kyis bskul nas kho bo gsang sngags mi bskyod gling pa de nyid kyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda bde blag nyid du 'byor ba las dag par myur bar phab nas longs dang bstun par gnas gsum nas rang gi sgrub pa nyams len rtags thon byas te rjes su gdul bya yongs la gsal bar byas so: 'di nyid kyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sbyin pa la bdag dpon slob gyis bgyi 'os rnams yongs su grub zin pas: da khyod rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur ba'i maṇ+ḍal spro 'tshal: dbang ga go rim ma la'i bar sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rje tsho bskur de nasasgrub la rang dbang 'byur 'jigasapa kun la rnam par rgyal bkrashis dpal che mthu btsan zhing 'khor 'ad spyi dpal dbang thob shog sam pā rgya rgya rgya gu gye brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang nusaldan pasabasgyur ba dge zhing bkra shasaso
